Berdasarkan laporan, the marvel legendary 2nd edition core box improves on the original in nearly every way, delivering what remains one of the best classic deck building systems out there. For Marvel and deck builder fans that may have missed out on the original box, this is an incredibly easy recommendation, but for folks that may just want to replace their old box, you will need to weigh whether the elements here are worth it.

One of the best cooperative deck builders out there.

Some great new art and the new neoprene playmat is a nice step up.

Includes improvements that were originally added expansions are now included right from the start.

Compatible with already released Marvel Legendary products.

Did not really improve the storage solution or alleviate setup/teardown hassle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why you can trust gamesradar+ our experts review games, movies and tech over countless hours, so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about our reviews policy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it comes to the deck building genre of card games, these popular options have featured all manner of different properties and styles over the years, with one of my favorites being legendary: a marvel deck building game (henceforth referred simply as marvel legendary) from upper deck. In fact, this was where I first got my introduction to the deck builder landscape; ever since watching Wil Wheaton's Tabletop episode featuring it, this has been one of my go-to types of games to play.

Diungkapkan bahwa now, upper deck has released a new edition of the base marvel legendary, bringing with it some refinements and updates that the team has picked up in the past 14 years since the original box came out, along with fan-favorite mechanics that were introduced in later expansion content. All of this results in superior, yet still very familiar, new starting point for anyone wanting to assemble some Marvel heroes and save the day – and one of the best card games overall for Marvel fans.

Diungkapkan bahwa this new 2nd edition of marvel legendary retains the same cooperative deck-building mission as the original, now with a nice neoprene mat gameboard, replacing the classic folding cardboard one. Prior to the game starting, players pick the heroes that they will build their decks with, a total of 15 choices, followed by the villain you will face off against, what their dastardly scheme will be, and the various henchmen and other foes assisting them.

Berdasarkan laporan, from there, in typical deck-building fashion, over the course of numerous rounds, players will purchase and enhance their decks with hero cards from a shared pool, taking out villains, rescuing captured civilians, and thwarting enough of the mastermind’s schemes and bashing them in the face until either the heroes or villains come out victorious. It’s a tried-and-true formula that has served Upper Deck for many years and many spin-offs, and it all began with Marvel Legendary, and it still is just as fun today.

Players: 1-5Ages: 14+Game type: Deck-buildingComplexity: ModerateLasts: 30-60minsDesigner: Devin LowPublisher: Upper DeckPlay if you enjoy: Gwent, Magic: The Gathering.

Berdasarkan laporan, legendary adopts a rotating and ever shifting marketplace of cards for folks to pick from, an approach more akin to ascension as opposed to a static shop like dominion. Having each power of hero card feature its own unique piece of artwork is a great touch, that while fixed in later expansions, was sorely lacking in the original core box. It’s an approach I have always favored, and considering all of the new redone art in this box, I appreciated this direction even more, since it lets me see more cards. Same with the various schemes you will contend with.

Berdasarkan laporan, by and large, all the new artwork is an improvement, though some fall a bit flatter, with the “wound” cards that will clog your deck. Previously, these featured a gruesome image of Wolverine getting blasted, his body contorting with pain as his classic X-men costume is shredded. Now, it’s just Iron Man in pristine looking armor holding his shoulder like he threw a slightly too-fast baseball, and pulled a muscle. I mean, I guess that’s a wound…technically?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for folks that don’t own the original core box of marvel legendary, this new box is an amazing and spectacular jumping on point for one of the most established deck builders out there. Even if you never touch any of the previously released expansions (that are compatible with this new box, by the way), you still have a fully stocked game that will keep things exciting for years to come. I. At $100 msrp, it’s a hefty price tag for what is basically new artwork, some rebalanced cards, a couple and card types like sidekicks and S. H. Things become slightly more complicated if you do already own the older box. E. L. D Officer Specialists being included (originally released in expansions).

Hardware nerds unite, sign up to our free tech newsletter for a weekly digest of the hottest new tech, the latest gadgets on the test bench, and much more from the team at GamesRadar+.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even when it comes to the heroes and villains being offered, there is a good deal of crossover between the two boxes. On the heroes side, Deadpool from the OG box has been swapped out for Miles Morales, and Doc Ock has been added to the Mastermind list to represent the web-head’s rogues gallery, along with some adjustments to the henchmen and villain offerings. Again, all of this is great for new players, it’s just something for returning owners to be aware of before they drop the cash on the new box.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s a reason that marvel legendary would go on to spawn tons of expansions, and with the legendary series spinning off to feature other properties like the matrix, predator, and now even dc. It’s just a damn good game that has withstood the test of time.

Berdasarkan laporan, sure, it can still take a bit to set up and pack up, thanks to all the various little decks of cards you need to shuffle together, but the end result has always been worth the hassle. I look at my dinged up, faded, and scratched original core box sitting on my game shelf and remember back to all the fun game nights that it’s been a part of, and this new 2nd Edition Core Box will let the sweet prince finally rest. It’s served its time, and I can’t wait for the future game nights this new box will make.

Diungkapkan bahwa ✅ you like deck building games and don’t have the original core box: if you're a fan of the genre, you owe it to yourself to try this. ✅ You're looking for a thematic cooperative game: Want something memorable to bring to your next game night? This is it.

Berdasarkan laporan, ❌ you already own the original box: you will need to weigh whether or not the new art and rebalanced cards are worth the price tag. ❌ You prefer your deck building games to be purely competitive: Marvel is full of teams, so it's no surprise this spin-off follows the same formula.

#906. This 3D Pet SIM You Never Played Has Over 12,000 ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ Reviews

📅 14 Nov 2026

This 3D Pet SIM You Never Played Has Over 12,000 ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ Reviews

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/wobbledogs-3d-pet-sim-steam-overwhelmingly-positive/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, have you ever wanted to raise your own genetically mutated pup? well, there's a steam game focused on exactly that, and it probably deserves more success than it's managed in the four years since it launched. Wobbledogs, from developer Animal Uprising, is described on Steam as "a 3D pet simulation where you raise your own hive of mutating dogs. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's as much a comedic game as it is a simulator, for two reasons. Firstly, the dogs look ridiculous. They're made up of an amalgamation of shapes, including lengthy, cuboid torsos and enormous tails, somewhat reminiscent of the creatures in the early noughties British children's show Bamzooki.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, secondly, wobbledogs has some wacky physics in play, which means it's a good laugh just observing your pets. "Two dogs with separate body structures will experience the world in different ways," reads the "about this game" section on Steam.

Berdasarkan laporan, impressively, each wobbledog also has a simulated genetics system. "As they age, they periodically enter a pupal state and physically mutate. The foods they eat fill their guts with different flora… [which] influence the dogs' mutations, letting you craft and mold them to fit your own idea of canine (im)perfection!".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wobbledogs is very much a make-your-own-fun sort of game though, so there are no explicit goals other than enjoying yourself. You can create and design habitats for your dogs, and you'll unlock more cosmetic decorations and objects as you play. "Give your dogs a relaxing place to sleep, set up a maze, or even cultivate a garden. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i fed a family only doritos for like eight generations to try to give them long legs and they ended up incredibly orange," reads one positive review. "This game is absolutely amazing. I get struck with waves of happiness every time I play," reads another.

Diungkapkan bahwa it can also be an alarming game, however, as this review explains: "got my first dog pancake. Played with him, fed him, loved him. Was best friends with Randy. Got some more dogs for Pancake. Always happy and playful. Pancake played with them. Watch Pancake grow older & change with the minutes. I loved Pancake.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "proceeds to die right in front of me. My other 4 dogs then come over & eat his dead body right in front of me, all while I'm still in shock that dogs can die in this game. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rest in peace, pancake. 99, but regularly goes on sale for as little as $4. Wobbledogs is currently $19. 99, so I'd recommend putting it on your wishlist and holding fire until it drops again.

#908. Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/apple-sci-fi-thriller-masterpiece-severance-one-of-the-best-seasons-in-tv-history/

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2022, apple was three years into its streaming experiment and still trying to find its footing. Aside from Ted Lasso, the tech giant hadn't released any breakout hits. And while a few sci-fi shows like For All Mankind and Foundation had fans, they weren't exactly mainstream success stories. Then everything changed when Apple took a bet on an unknown showrunner (with backing from an A-list actor) to create something revolutionary.

Berdasarkan laporan, dan erickson and ben stiller didn't just change apple tv with severance, which firmly established the streamer as the home for groundbreaking new sci-fi. They also delivered a perfectly timed anti-work masterpiece at exactly the right time, tapping into the cultural zeitgeist with a perfect season of television that still hasn't been surpassed (even by the show's own very good second season).

Berdasarkan laporan, while both seasons of severance are phenomenal, it’s hard to describe how expertly erickson’s first nine-episode season conveys the despair of the “work-first” attitude prevalent in modern society. Erickson, who worked in a literal door factory while writing early versions of the series, takes that attitude to its most literal extreme: imagining a dystopian future where companies surgically split their employees' consciousness to create an "innie" who knows only work and an "outie" who has no idea what their own job entails.

Berdasarkan laporan, the series opens with helly (britt lower) waking up on a table in one of the company’s main offices. Waking up at work already sounds disastrous, but like Helly, audiences learn from the disembodied voice of fellow innie Mark Scout (Adam Scott) in real time what being a Lumon employee means for her: a lifetime of all work and very little play. Naturally, Helly does not vibe with the new life her outie has chosen for her and does everything in her power to escape.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the line between personal and work has grown increasingly blurred over the years, further exacerbated by the covid-19 pandemic, which forced us to reckon in real time with how little consideration is given to workers and their lives, as long as the numbers go up. This way of thinking drives Helly to be fundamentally opposed to anything and everything her bosses at Lumon try to get her to do.

Berdasarkan laporan, yet every time helly rages against the machine, she remains trapped in the system. Her outie wants her to be there, creating a truly odd juxtaposition where, despite sharing the same body, Helly is wrangling with her own psyche for control. Each time she tries to escape, she is forced back into that sad, narrow corridor. It’s a little like arguing with yourself over whether you should get takeout, only with much more dire circumstances.

Diungkapkan bahwa though there is a level of attraction to such a literal divide of work and pleasure — mark uses the severance program to avoid the grief of the death of his wife years before — it comes at a great cost. In an attempt to create a healthy work-life balance, Lumon and those who choose to be severed have instead condemned their inner selves to lives devoted to work, pursuing goals they neither understand nor chose.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this leaves us with several compelling questions that the nine episodes of severance’s first season try to answer. Who is real? Is it our outer selves who agreed to take on this severance procedure, or is it the innie that’s been condemned to a life of toil? Is there really a true divide?.

Diungkapkan bahwa through helly’s acts of insurrection, she stirs something in her fellow innies that those in charge at lumon (all of whom, notably, are not severed) can’t fully suppress. Even before Helly, innies like Mark, Irving (John Turturro), and Dylan (Zach Cherry) had a vague interest in their outer selves. By the time Helly starts pointing out the imbalance between their lives, rebellion (big and small) is all but inevitable.

Diungkapkan bahwa severance season 1 unfolds as a maze of shifting identities, false starts, red herrings, and untrustworthy narrators, with each episode leaving you feeling as though your emotions have been tossed into a blender. The series is disorienting by design, constantly keeping you guessing about what’s real and whom you can trust, all while building to a mind-blowing cliffhanger finale.

Sebagaimana diketahui, severance’s second season is just as tantalizing as the first, but feels less cohesive overall, spending more time with the outies and lumon’s inner workings. Although those elements are compelling, some storylines introduced in season one — like Burt and Irving’s strange but sweet relationship — fizzle out in an unsatisfying way. Season 2 is still very good, with some high highs and few lows, but it doesn’t hold a candle to the masterpiece that was Severance season 1.

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/capcom-reveals-why-it-didnt-remake-resident-evil-1-first/

Sebagaimana diketahui, capcom's recent lineup of remakes started with resident evil 2, throwing us back into the chaos of a raccoon city under siege by zombies, tyrants, lickers, and even alligators. It might seem like a weird place to start, rather than the inciting incident where Jill Valentine and Chris Redfield skulked through Spencer Mansion, but longtime series producer Jun Takeuchi has revealed that the team worried it would alienate modern audiences.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the reason we didn't choose resident evil 1 as the first remake is because it's such a stoic game," takeuchi said in nikkei entertainment!'s celebration of the series' 30th anniversary (translated by fandom). "Because it focuses so heavily on the horror derived from its stoicism, we were concerned that it might not resonate with today's game fans.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "furthermore, the raccoon city incident is essentially the starting point of the resident evil saga, so we felt that experiencing that was the best way to introduce the origins. ".

Of course, there was a remake of Resident Evil in 2002 for the GameCube, which was remastered for PS4, PC, and Xbox One in 2015—but it remains dutiful to the fixed camera angles and tank controls of the original, unlike the newer remakes, which adopt an over-the-shoulder viewpoint.

Berdasarkan laporan, fans have been clamoring for another resident evil remake in-line with the newer games, and given the slower, more methodical horror of grace ashcroft's sections in requiem—and just how well that was received—i'm not sure the argument holds up anymore. But just because Capcom shot down a Resident Evil remake once before doesn't mean it has been completely ruled out.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to reputable leaker dusk golem, who first reported that leon kennedy would return as a playable character in requiem, the original resident evil is getting a remake, with full production set to begin after veronica has wrapped up. "RE1: is just recently entering development, so it's likely anywhere from 4–7 years out from releasing, presuming it comes out at all since it's in early development and RE games get scrapped all the time," he explained.

Berdasarkan laporan, dusk golem also alleged that a resident evil zero remake is underway, corroborating an mp1st report. It'd be a little odd to tackle the prelude to the Mansion Incident, following STARS Bravo Team en route to the Arklay Mountains to investigate the same cannibalistic murders, and not the first game it leads directly into.

So, while Capcom may have feared that the original game wouldn't resonate with new fans, rumors suggest something has changed, and after Veronica in 2027, we'll be revisiting Spencer Mansion—again.

Requiem is the closest Capcom has ever come to capturing the paranoia of the original Resident Evil games.

#911. 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/battlestar-galactica-season-3-exodus-20-year-anniversary-adama-maneuver/

The Adama Maneuver wasn’t even the most spectacular part of Battlestar Galactica’s greatest space battle.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to liberate the humans trapped under cylon occupation, admiral william adama (edward james olmos) jumps the titular battlestar galactica directly into the atmosphere of new caprica. The warship plummets toward the settlement and deploys Viper fighter jets amidst the chaos before jumping back into space moments before it would have crashed, likely obliterating the planet on impact.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two decades later, this spectacle from battlestar galactica season 3’s “exodus, part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi tv. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.

Diungkapkan bahwa minutes later, while the galactica is damaged and surrounded by enemy ships, lee adama (jamie bamber) arrives aboard the pegasus. He buys his father enough time to escape, evacuates his own crew, and transforms the most advanced remaining warship in humanity's fleet into an enormous battering ram. Pegasus tears through one Cylon basestar, explodes, and sends a flaming flight pod spinning into another. It’s both a spectacular death scene and the decisive blow in the battle to liberate New Caprica.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in one extended sequence, “exodus, part 2” ends the most frustrating period in battlestar galactica’s story, reunites its scattered cast, and restores the series’ core premise: one battered battlestar protecting the remnants of humanity as they search for earth. No one is able to recover from the trauma that easily, perhaps least of all the visual-effects artists who were forced to destroy the Pegasus.

'Pegasus' transforms what looks like a miracle into a total nightmare.

Diungkapkan bahwa “exodus” was initially conceived as a single episode, written by bradley thompson and david weddle and directed by félix enríquez alcalá. And most of that happened in the first part of “Exodus. Against the backdrop of this militarized occupation, there was also the resistance’s ongoing ground operations, Sharon Agathon’s (Grace Park) infiltration of the Cylon compound, Kara Thrace’s (Katee Sackhoff) imprisonment by Leoben Conoy (Callum Keith Rennie), and Ellen Tigh’s (Kate Vernon) betrayal, which led to her being poisoned before her execution. But the rescue of New Caprica eventually became too large for one hour. ” There was simply too much story happening — and honestly too much to fully recap here.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to moore, who talked about the production on a series of podcast episodes released alongside the show, splitting “exodus” into two episodes also helped the production absorb the considerable cost of the new caprica storyline. The opening of season 3 required new sets, location shooting, large numbers of extras, and significantly more visual effects than an ordinary episode. By turning the material into a two-parter — episodes 3 and 4 in the overall season — the producers were able to stretch that expensive infrastructure across another hour of television.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that history helps explain the rhythm of “exodus. The resistance prepares for its uprising. Samuel Anders (Michael Trucco) discovers that Ellen betrayed the resistance to save her husband, Saul Tigh (Michael Hogan). Adama orders Lee to protect the civilian fleet and continue the search for Earth if Galactica doesn’t return within 18 hours. ” Part 1 is full of tension as it essentially tightens the spring. Sharon retrieves the launch keys for the civilian ships. Then Part 2 releases all that tension almost all at once.

Berdasarkan laporan, saul poisons ellen rather than surrender her to the resistance for execution. Anders rescues Kara from Leoben’s apartment. The civilian ships begin to launch. Laura Roslin (Mary McDonnell) retakes Colonial One. The uprising begins. That’s when Galactica falls out of the sky.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during his podcast commentary, moore watched the sequence and remarked that the episode had better win the emmy for visual effects. The episode also received Emmy nominations for its direction and sound editing. “Exodus, Part 2” won the 2007 Emmy for Outstanding Special Visual Effects for a Series, along with the Visual Effects Society award for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Broadcast Series. Less than a year later, it did. But the episode still had a larger spectacle in reserve.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once galactica jumps out of new caprica’s atmosphere, adama discovers that four cylon basestars are waiting for him. Already damaged by the free fall, the ship has little chance of survival. As he often does when facing certain death, Adama quietly tells his crew that it has been an honor to serve with them.

Berdasarkan laporan, except lee disobeys a direct order and jumps the pegasus in to assist. Lee orders the crew to abandon ship, sets its weapons to fire automatically, and pauses on the empty bridge to offer his command one final “Thank you. Pegasus immediately destroys one basestar and draws enough fire to allow Galactica to escape. ” Then he and the dwindling crew set it on a direct collision course with the enemy ships.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, destroying pegasus had always been part of the general plan for the new caprica storyline, even if the writers changed the circumstances across various drafts. At one point, the creative team considered destroying Galactica instead and moving the military crew onto the newer, better Pegasus. But that would have meant abandoning the title of the series.

Berdasarkan laporan, the pegasus sets occupied valuable studio space, and maintaining two capital ships forced the production to divide its personnel and background performers between separate locations. The creative team also wanted to build new Cylon basestar interiors for the stories that followed. There just wasn’t enough room to do it all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the visual-effects team nevertheless became attached to the ship. When its artists learned that Pegasus was scheduled for destruction, they hung a large “SAVE THE PEGASUS” banner outside their workspace, directly across from Moore’s office. “It was very funny and it was really endearing,” Moore said, “but we destroyed the Pegasus anyway — so goodbye, Peggy. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the ship’s destruction became an enormous undertaking for atmosphere visual effects. Because its ships, explosions, weapons fire, and debris interacted so extensively, much of the work couldn’t be simplified through pre-compositing. Lead compositor Brenda Campbell later recalled that the climactic sequence contained roughly 250 to 300 elements in each compositing flow, spread across approximately 10 shots. Campbell had about a week and a half to finish it.

Diungkapkan bahwa the scale extended into the background. Some battle shots featured hundreds of individually animated Cylon Raiders that hadn’t even appeared in the original previsualization. The artists then added camera movement, flares, and the unusually heavy layer of grain that helped Battlestar Galactica’s digital effects match the show’s handheld, documentary-inspired photography.

Diungkapkan bahwa the collision destroys the first basestar outright. Then one of Pegasus’ burning flight pods breaks away, careens through the battle, and strikes another. Humanity may have lost the Pegasus, but at least it took out three Cylon basestars in the process.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a way, “exodus” delivers a satisfying reset to the show’s original structure. But its characters return to that version of normalcy carrying more trauma than ever before. After spending four episodes grounded on New Caprica, Battlestar Galactica resumes its familiar “scrappy military ship on the run” format. The occupation is over, but the damage it caused has barely begun to reveal itself.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s what separates “exodus” from an impressive hour of action television. The heroes escape, but they cannot return to who they were before New Caprica. It delivers the enormous catharsis its story demands, but it never pretends that liberation alone is a simple fix for anything. Neither can the fleet: Humanity is free again, but it has sacrificed its most powerful warship to get there.

Berdasarkan laporan, twenty years later, it’s easy to understand why the visual-effects artists wanted to save “peggy” — and why the writers knew they couldn’t. The Adama Maneuver may be the image everyone remembers, but the destruction of Pegasus gives “Exodus” its emotional climax. If the artists couldn’t save their favorite ship, they could at least give it a death spectacular enough to ensure nobody would ever forget it.

#912. Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

📅 14 Nov 2026

Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-link-past-retrospective-35-years/

Sebagaimana diketahui, by now, you’ve probably had time to play the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake on the nintendo switch 2. You’ve marveled at what a great job it does of bringing the classic Nintendo 64 adventure to a new generation, with visual improvements and quality-of-life changes to make it more palatable for that new audience. Maybe you’ve even run through it a second time.

Diungkapkan bahwa as good as ocarina of time might be, however, it’s just one game. Once you’re finished with that grand adventure, you’ll need to decide what to play next. And assuming you’re not tired of Hyrule and Zelda just yet, there’s one game you definitely should consider for your next conquest. It can’t keep you busy forever. That game is The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, and it did a brilliant job of introducing key elements that players loved about Ocarina of Time several years later, including an intricate world that changes over the course of the epic adventure.

Diungkapkan bahwa incredible as it may seem, the legend of zelda: a link to the past is already 35 years old. How can so much time have passed already? I have vivid memories of terrific games I played before Link’s first Super Nintendo outing ever occurred. 21, 1991. It arrived in Japan on Nov. Time clearly flies as fast for some of us, every bit as readily as it did for Link in Ocarina of Time.

Berdasarkan laporan, when a link to the past hit japan in 1991 and then launched in north america five months later, it provided the most meaningful update the zelda series would see for decades. Up to that point, there were only two console releases. Both of them were wildly different. A Link to the Past cemented what a Zelda game should be, offering its grandest open world yet, stuffed with thrilling dungeons built on a foundation of everything that came before them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the game began with link following his uncle out into the rain in search of the imprisoned princess zelda. He freed her and then began a search for three magical pendants, the better to someday vanquish an evil wizard. As his quest neared its apparent conclusion, Link learned that it had really only just begun. He soon found himself traveling frequently between two realms: the Light World and the Dark World.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the dark world is a link to the past’s grandest innovation. Players spent hours exploring every corner of Hyrule, from the warm desert sands in the southwest to the cascading waterfalls and mountains in the north. Sand dunes turned to fetid swamp. A lake became a glacier, and a thriving village turned into a hideout for bandits. They might have thought they knew everything. Then another dimension came along and turned all of that on its head. Truly, the alternate realm lived up to its title.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the dark world offered more than just a dreary aesthetic. Actions Link took in one realm allowed him to make progress in the other, in ways large and small. A Heart Piece might rest on a ledge that lay out of reach. Players got to know the landscape more intimately than ever before, or else they could never reach some of the places where their greatest adventures waited. Or a dungeon entrance might lie out of reach, but a trip between worlds would reveal a new path. A trip between dimensions added a walkway that finally granted access. In the end, Link’s ingenuity and bravery provided the strength necessary to defeat a familiar foe: Ganon.

Berdasarkan laporan, ocarina of time built on much of that same design, with just enough differences to make it all feel fresh. He meets Zelda early in his adventure. Link wakes to find an insistent fairy by his side, instead of having his dreams disturbed by a telepathic plea. Instead of traveling to another realm, the lad simply wakes in a different time period. Three dungeons later, circumstances force them apart. It is a dark one, every bit as disastrous as the Dark World in the previous game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’ve just finished exploring that structure in ocarina of time, the time is right to experience the super nintendo version that pioneered its best attributes. You’ll be able to better appreciate just how much impact a classic 2D game had on the series as it evolved into 3D. They often represent an evolution of everything that came before them. It should serve as a reminder that the best entertainment experiences of today don’t come from nowhere. For people who enjoy the evolution of a medium, there’s true joy in exploring those roots, even now. And few games deserve your attention as much as A Link to the Past.

Zelda's ability to endure over decades is a miracle.

Berdasarkan laporan, the idea of dark souls pvp has always scared me a tad. You can replace Dark Souls with Bloodborne or Elden Ring, I've typically just been a coward when it comes to the idea of fighting another, real person. They're probably going to be better than me! I don't use tactics in Souls games, I use brute force until I get my way! That being said, I do have to admit I quite like the look of Rasen, a game that is essentially just the PvP component of Dark Souls (or PvE if you just want to take on some computer-controlled enemies) that just launched into early access.

Diungkapkan bahwa to say that it is just straight up dark souls combat would be unfair, from the looks of things. And blades a plenty they have, ranging from your classic sword, to scythes, to halberds and all sorts. For one, it looks more like it leans a tad towards Sekiro with a blades-only kind of affair, whether that be big or small. It's a much flashier looking affair too, with fancy slashing effects that seem to buff moves and a pace that seems much faster than Souls games tend to be.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can take part in matches with up to eight people, which presumably extends to ai (not that kind) enemies too, in "atmospheric duels, clashes, deathmatches and more. " It looks neat! And best of all, unusually for a 3D arena fighter, it has rollback netcode. For those unfamiliar, and to try and explain it simply, this is essentially a bit of tech you'll find in predominantly 2D fighting games that predicts every possible input you could make in a given moment, helping to reduce lag time and allow for tighter matches (and less rage quitting).

Diungkapkan bahwa that's a bit harder to do in a 3d environment given that you have a lot more options at your disposal when it comes to movement, so if it works that's some impressive stuff! and we could all quite easily find out together, as a demo for rasen is available to try out. Or, alternatively, you can just pick it up whole hog on Steam right now, as it's available in early access.

Sebagaimana diketahui, social improv games like those in jackbox's party packs can have vastly different vibes depending on who you're playing with. Meemaw isn't likely to appreciate the phrase "glup shitto" the way your PC gaming friends will, and those sorts of high-variance dynamics are something Jackbox Games has to stay acutely aware of, according to CEO Mike Bilder.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i mean we do a ton [of testing] internally, but then as games get greenlit, we'll bring in external groups," bilder told pc gamer associate editor ted litchfield in a recent interview. We want to make sure these games are playing well. "We want to make sure that we're not just local-biased with our own opinions on things. ".

Something that makes it especially hard to tell whether a game is funny or they're just having a good session is the fact that they work with comedy writers—people who can make a boring game seem funny just by cracking jokes while they play.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we get a lot of false positives because we have such funny people here that work in the office, and they make games shine," said bilder. "No matter what the concept is, you're gonna laugh, or the way they're hosting or emceeing the game, the pitch is hilarious, and it's like, can the game do that? Or is it just [studio creative director Arnie Niekamp]? Arnie's funny … a lot of times it is just Arnie. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the same interview, bilder also commented on generative ai. "The comedy, the writing, and the art, all that is done by people, and we have no intention of changing that. "The people are what make this product," he said. ".

If the cheers that bellowed through the Barclays Center in Brooklyn are any indication, diehard fans of the franchise are ready.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, riot left most details of this major overhaul to the imagination. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but the company isn’t ready to share their real game plan just yet. Sebagaimana diketahui, this is terminally online: pc gamer's very own mmo column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice.

Diungkapkan bahwa i've been having a pleasant time with wow: forever (and by that, i mean it has consumed nearly every waking moment of my life). One thing, however, has been made pretty clear: Mob tagging, that is, only giving kill credit to the first player (or group) to damage a mob, is divisive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one side of the fence—my side, i'm afraid—does see mob tagging as a necessary evil in an mmo that's trying to drive social interaction. Videogames, particularly ones that are incentivising you to group up, are kind of meant to be a pain in the butt sometimes; if you've got a "kill 20" quest and there another person there, the fact you might get in each other's way if you don't group up, and have a jollier time if you do, is a net good.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i have more complicated thoughts on item drop quests being bad in a group, sure. But, overall, I'm all for it. Nearly every single person I've thrown an invite to has grouped up with me, and I've even (gasp) had conversations with strangers. And I'd like it if Blizzard's layering technology was a little more merciful. Pleasant ones!.

Some of them are even on my friends list now, and it is, I think, a point in my favour that I would have largely ignored every single person I am now regularly chatting to if mob tagging wasn't a thing.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, i do get the other side of the fence, in that it is absolutely a pain in the ass. Particularly in a game that's just launched, where the playerbase is nowhere near as spread out as it needs to be. There's a thin difference between good social banter being encouraged and "for the love of god, I just need one troll fetish, why are these mystics spread 30 feet apart, thank god I farmed my mount before I did this".

Sebagaimana diketahui, a difference, it's important to state, that is more often broken in a game that's so wildly popular as forever is right now. Mob tagging holds up when it's you and a handful of other players in a questing environment: It's less defensible when there's 30 of you and it's a "loot X" quest so grouping wouldn't help, anyway.

So I ask you, fine readers of Terminally Online: Do you think tagging mobs is fine in an oldschool MMO, or is it an archaic thing of the past to be done away with?.

#933. How to get and use Cargo in ROB RUN

📅 14 Nov 2026

How to get and use Cargo in ROB RUN

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/how-to-get-and-use-cargo-in-rob-run/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are plenty of things to sell in rob run, and managing your cargo efficiently will make you richer in no time. These items are harder to manage since you can’t fit them in your backpack.

However, knowing what to do with them will save you time and make you more money.

Berdasarkan laporan, unlike specific loot, cargo is an umbrella term used for any item that you can’t fit inside the bag. Hence, the only option is to carry it in your arms. This creates an issue since you can’t equip any weapons when you’re carrying Cargo.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, there’s a possible way to mitigate this problem with the use of vehicles. If you have free space in your vehicle, you can then shift the Cargo to that spot. This will now free up your hands without having to leave the valuable loot behind.

So, how do you get Cargo in the first place? There are several ways to obtain them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cargo has one, and only one, use in rob run. You should sell it to smugglers for profit. When you find a Smuggler, approach their vehicle and place the cargo in the trunk.

Diungkapkan bahwa to get your money, you have to confirm the sale. Make sure to check the price before you do so, since the rate varies. Once you receive the payment, transport it back safely to your base. Otherwise, you run the risk of losing it to other players or having it confiscated by the police.

#934. Mini Review: Tape To Tape (Switch) - A Great Roguelite For Underserved Hockey Lovers

📅 14 Nov 2026

Mini Review: Tape To Tape (Switch) - A Great Roguelite For Underserved Hockey Lovers

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/switch-eshop/tape-to-tape

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you are a hockey fan with a switch, you have been poorly served by the system’s library. And then you chance upon Tape to Tape drowning in the weekly AI slop eShop releases, a curiously labelled “gorgeous roguelite hockey world" affair. Odd really, considering how well hockey itself translates into video game form. Is this it? Is this the hockey game of my dreams?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tape to tape did not sprout magically overnight. It has been a labour of love for several years and has been feeding off a lively player community with feedback to shape the version now in our hands. Forget about offsides, penalties, and other obtuse rules (unless you pick the Modern Squad): this is hardcore old-school hockey the likes of which we haven't seen since NHL Hitz and that is a very good thing indeed.

Berdasarkan laporan, while this is strictly an offline couch multiplayer affair with all the expected gameplay modes up to four players, the real meat is found in the campaign mode, where its roguelite nature shines. You start with a choice of three teams, with another 16 unlocking as you make progress and meet unlock conditions. Each comes with their own gameplay quirks, with some being significant advantages while others rapidly become heavy handicaps.

Berdasarkan laporan, in my dozen or so (not all of them successful) runs, there were no two alike, thanks to the sizeable amount of possible combos of team, star players, bench-warmers, unlockable team relics, and individual player skills. A successful run will expose huge chunks of delightfully silly lore and can run to over an hour while you pick your path between opponents' stadiums and a cast of oddball individuals that will (mostly) help to bring out your team's potential.

The other unexpected stars are the opponent teams, from stereotypical spoofs like the soccer team (with easily recognisable caricatures of real-life players) that doesn’t even use sticks to play to the Canadian team that requires tariffs (translating into huge handicaps per period) and has their heads animated in unmistakable South Park fashion, all the way up to the hockey nemesis themselves, the club wielding Golfers in the final campaign act.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and the less said about the cheating officials team, the better. Having a clean run end abruptly because the official grabs the puck and shoves it into the back of your net might be part of the fun, but it still stings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, overall, this is a refreshingly addictive take on hockey, with tight gameplay, humour that lands, and rewarding unlockable content. The Switch edition offers something not found on other versions: the option to throw a Joy-Con at other players and have a quick match in tabletop mode. If you grew up with Ice Hockey and Blades of Steel on NES, Mutant League Hockey on Mega Drive, and the all-mighty, all-conquering NHL Hitz on sixth-generation hardware, this game was made for you.

If you have never played a hockey game in your life before and have zero interest in the sport, this game is also for you! Tape to Tape is not just a great hockey video game - it is a great video game, period.

#935. 32 Years Later, Star Trek's Most Important Movie Is Officially Free on Streaming

📅 14 Nov 2026

32 Years Later, Star Trek's Most Important Movie Is Officially Free on Streaming

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/star-trek-generations-streaming-free-november-2026/

Berdasarkan laporan, there are few things star trek fans love more than a good crossover. Bringing together characters from different eras of the franchise is practically guaranteed to generate excitement, particularly when those characters happen to be two of Starfleet's most legendary captains. But what happens when the movie designed to unite them doesn't quite live up to expectations?.

Berdasarkan laporan, released in 1994 and now streaming free on pluto tv, star trek: generations brought captain james t. The result was a movie that divided fans, delivered one of the franchise's most controversial deaths, and destroyed one of television's most beloved starships. Kirk (William Shatner) and Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) together on the big screen for the first and only time. Yet more than three decades later, Generations deserves another look, particularly for what it has to say about growing older, accepting loss, and knowing when it's time to move on.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the film opens with kirk, montgomery scott (james doohan), and pavel chekov (walter koenig) attending the maiden voyage of the enterprise-b. Kirk is retired, although it's obvious he hasn't entirely adjusted to life outside the captain's chair.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when kirk discovers that the ship's helmsman is demora sulu (jacqueline kim), daughter of his former crewmate hikaru sulu (george takei), he's surprised his old friend found time to start a family. Scotty reminds him of something Kirk himself has always said: If something is important, you make the time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's a seemingly insignificant exchange that establishes one of the movie's central themes. Kirk has spent his life exploring the galaxy, but what has he missed along the way? He's saved countless lives and made history, yet he's struggling to find purpose without the Enterprise.

Diungkapkan bahwa decades later, picard faces his own reckoning with mortality after learning that his brother robert and nephew rené have died in a fire. The tragedy leaves him confronting the possibility that his family line will end with him, along with the realization that the life he chose came at the expense of another he might have had.

Diungkapkan bahwa both captains eventually find themselves inside the nexus, a mysterious energy ribbon that offers its inhabitants a seemingly perfect existence. Kirk finds himself back in a peaceful home, with the opportunity to reconnect with a woman from his past. For Picard, that means experiencing the family life he never had. Perhaps Edith Keeler?.

Diungkapkan bahwa the temptation is understandable. Who wouldn't want the chance to revisit a happier moment or correct a regret? But Generations makes the case that a meaningful life isn't necessarily a perfect one. Sometimes it's the choices we make, and the sacrifices that come with them, that give our lives purpose.

Diungkapkan bahwa none of this means generations is without problems. Far from it. Tolian Soran (Malcolm McDowell), wants to return to the Nexus so badly he's willing to destroy entire star systems to make it happen. The movie's villain, Dr. While McDowell brings considerable menace to the role, Soran never quite becomes the memorable antagonist the story needs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then there's kirk's death, which remains one of the most debated moments in star trek history. After surviving Klingons, Romulans, Khan, and countless other threats, the legendary captain meets his end beneath a collapsing bridge. For a character who spent decades boldly going where no one had gone before, it's not exactly the grand farewell many fans imagined. And yet there's plenty here to appreciate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stewart delivers some of his finest work as picard struggles with grief, particularly during a quiet conversation with counselor deanna troi (marina sirtis). The destruction of the Enterprise-D is also genuinely shocking, especially for viewers who spent seven seasons watching the ship become almost as much a character as the people aboard it.

There's also the introduction of Data's (Brent Spiner) emotion chip, which provides some welcome humor, even if the movie occasionally leans a little too heavily into the android's newfound feelings.

Diungkapkan bahwa most importantly, shatner and stewart make the film's long-awaited meeting worthwhile. Their scenes together aren't built around elaborate action sequences or clever one-liners. Instead, they feature two captains reflecting on what it means to make a difference. It's a quieter approach than some viewers might have expected, but one that feels appropriate for these characters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond its story, generations occupies a unique place in star trek history. It was the franchise's first theatrical film built around the cast of Star Trek: The Next Generation, arriving just months after the television series concluded its seven-season run.

Berdasarkan laporan, for years, kirk and his crew had been the faces of star trek on the big screen. Kirk begins the film as a celebrated former captain watching a new Enterprise depart without him. Now it was Picard's turn. The movie makes that transition literal. By the conclusion, he's helping Picard save millions of lives and making one final sacrifice before leaving the future in another captain's hands.

Berdasarkan laporan, the destruction of the enterprise-d reinforces that transition. The ship that carried Picard and his crew through seven seasons of television adventures is gone, clearing the way for a new chapter. The Next Generation cast would return in three more films, beginning with 1996's Star Trek: First Contact.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's something fitting about a movie so concerned with the passage of time serving as the bridge between two eras of star trek. The franchise was changing, just as its characters were learning to accept change in their own lives.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, generations may not be the best star trek movie, but beneath the spectacle, questionable decisions, and collapsing bridges is a thoughtful story about two men who devoted their lives to making a difference. When Kirk gets one last opportunity to do exactly that, he doesn't hesitate. For all the movie's imperfections, it's hard to imagine a more appropriate final choice for the captain of the Enterprise.

Berdasarkan laporan, star trek generations is free to streaming pluto tv. You can also watch it on Paramount Plus.

The wait for GTA 6 is even more astounding when you remember how things used to be.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Diungkapkan bahwa game development has changed substantially since the '90s. Hit games were often assembled by small teams in a couple of years – sometimes months – and you'd often see new entries in major franchises every single year. For a 12-year span from 1997 through 2009, that's exactly how the Grand Theft Auto series was, which throws the 13-year wait for GTA 6 into sharp relief.

Berdasarkan laporan, these days, rockstar encompasses many studios around the world, but lead development on the gta series is handled by rockstar north. The Edinburgh, Scotland studio was once known as DMA Design, and it was under that name that it released the first three Grand Theft Auto games. The first entry launched in 1997, and the sequel followed in 1999.

Diungkapkan bahwa those early top-down entries were moderate successes, but gta as we know it wouldn't arrive until grand theft auto 3. Its massive, 3D open world was a revelation in 2001, and the game became an industry-defining hit. Other publishers started chasing its open-world design and M-rated appeal in the years that followed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dma itself became rockstar north, and the follow-ups were nonstop. San Andreas in 2004. Vice City in 2002. British studio Mobius Entertainment came under the banner, transforming into Rockstar Leeds and creating the PSP spin-offs, Liberty City Stories and Vice City Stories, in 2005 and 2006. Rockstar North released GTA 4 in 2008, and a pair of expansions that were eventually put together as the standalone Episodes from Liberty City in 2009.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's a total of 10 games released in a 12-year span. The gap between GTA releases would soon expand dramatically. And, incredibly, it's been a whopping 13 years between the releases of GTA 5 and GTA 6. It would be four years before GTA 5 finally hit. Rockstar has, admittedly, filled the gap with the incredible Red Dead Redemption 2 – but it was also developing non-GTA titles at a far more prolific rate in the series' heyday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the issue of protracted development cycles leading to interminable waits between series entries is hardly unique to rockstar, and other developers are often paying the price. Final Fantasy's Naoki Yoshida reckons that the long wait between games is making it harder for younger players to connect with the series.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, it doesn't seem like the gta 6 hype has died down at all because of the 13-year wait – if anything, the gap has helped the anticipation get even bigger. But the prolific release schedule through the '00s helped make the series an institution in the first place, and it's a reminder of just how much the game industry has changed in the past few decades.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, weird weekend is our regular saturday column where we celebrate pc gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Rick and Ted have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager.

Diungkapkan bahwa what's the fastest you've ever fallen in love with a game? i think i have a new record: about 0. Perfection. Chef's kiss. 3 seconds into CultGame, when launching it from Steam spawned not a regular game window, but a command prompt instance. No notes.

Berdasarkan laporan, like the bay 12 games (dwarf fortress and especially liberal crime squad) it clearly takes inspiration from, cultgame is gloriously text-based. Its art is ASCII, its options selected by tippy-tapping the numpad, its maps are carpets of symbols: lurid at signs and hashes as far as the eye can see.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's a management game, first and foremost. Once you have generated a world and a history for it, you choose the precise nature of cult leader you wish to be: Defector Cleric, Occult Scholar, Con Artist, or Lunatic, and off you go. I was Gideon Faircloth, the fallen cleric, and my object of reverence was a 'World's Best Grandpa' Cup whose domains were blood and fire.

Berdasarkan laporan, cultgame lets you rewrite basically everything, including the deity type you follow; it does not protest, i learnt, when you write some absolute nonsense in there. I learnt this lesson again when the game asked me to choose a creed for my nascent faith and I wrote "Opinions are not those of my employer".

Sebagaimana diketahui, like dwarf fortress, cultgame will procedurally gin up an entire worldmap for you at the game's start and speckle it with locations of interest. There are barren plains and thick, unpeopled woodlands aplenty, but also dense urban spaces, pre-existing religions, political factions and more, all just waiting for you to get in there and start corrupting the populace. As a former preacher, I already had some skill points in preaching, so on turn one I set up shop in an area the game had named "The Friendly Wilds of Evil" to begin hollering at the hoi polloi.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, my charisma and probably-airtight cup-centric theology quickly won the crowd's adoration. Before long, I had my first recruit—not just a passive follower, but someone I could directly control and recruit just like Gideon. He was called Leopold Blackwood and he soon got to preaching, doubling my monthly followers. As the masses converted, they began generating followers themselves like a religious Roth IRA. Before long, I was accruing ~60 followers a turn. Soon, a new recruit, more preaching, more followers, and so on.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the tithes i was extracting from the rubes gathered in mountains. Even the indigenous religion didn't mind me so much: when its apostles had challenged my preaching, I succeeded in a skill check that made them rather like me. I had closets full of gold, and before long I was initiating grand public works in the areas of my preaching—shrines and gardens about town that made me look very generous indeed. I was munificent and popular—a beloved figure.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of the labours you can set your cult minions about in cultgame's demo is ritual-making. Depending on your deity's chosen domain, you get access to a set of thematically appropriate magic tricks you can expend resources to cast. Our World's Best Grandpa Cup started off as a blood-domain deity and added fire when we got enough followers to branch out. This meant our cardinals were very good at reworking the flesh of man and could, if you catch them in the right mood, raze a city with a targeted meteor strike.

Berdasarkan laporan, so we got about doing that, mostly just to see what would happen. Well done, Isabel. Our flesh rituals were powered by blood, which meant we had to induct some recruits we might normally have turned away due to their poor stats and start converting them to non-renewable energy. She did a great job. I put a recruit named Isabella in charge of the abattoir; her ritual-casting ability trumped everyone else's. Everyone say well done Isabel.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before long i had converted two underperforming cultists named john and sarah into a single, flesh-joined creature named jorah the grafted, who met expectations. Isabel also summoned a blood demon, a new employee named Morfangrag whose stats were off-the-charts good to the extent that it made everyone else in the cult look like additional potential fleshgrafting candidates. Morfangrag was incredibly useful, and would not kill us so long as he got a monthly dose of blood, which was fine: we still had plenty of low-quality recruits knocking on our door looking to sign up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, things were going very well, but i had yet to check out the demo's crusade feature, whereby you can dispatch a follower or followers to set heathen areas aflame with the light of the true faith. I sent Morfangrag to a cave. He easily dispatched the skeletons, spiders, and so on within. And yet….

Berdasarkan laporan, just before morfangrag set out, the cult of the world's best grandpa cup levelled up to the point that it could adopt a new belief. I picked the one that let us speak to animals. Possessed of a perhaps religious vision, I sidled Morfangrag up to an escargatoire of three snails and hit the Flirt option.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my blood demon successfully charmed all three snails, who collectively became his girlfriend and, thereby, minions of the cult. They didn't even mind that he took them on (free) dates to the local dump instead of (expensive) dates to a fancy restaurant. They were into it, if anything.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anyway, they were all eventually sacrificed to fuel some more fleshgrafting. CultGame is a very good time.

#940. Opinion: Nintendo Made Ocarina Of Time's Best Moment Even Better

📅 14 Nov 2026

Opinion: Nintendo Made Ocarina Of Time's Best Moment Even Better

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/features/opinion-nintendo-made-ocarina-of-times-best-moment-even-better

Before launch, I didn't think it would be possible for anyone to spoil Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 for me.

Diungkapkan bahwa i've played through the n64 original more times than i care to admit, and know it better than just about any other game out there. That said, if someone had told me about the Master Sword moment in the remake before I got to it, I would have been really upset.

Diungkapkan bahwa and so, let's consider this a formal warning. If you haven't made it to the moment when Link first pulls the Master Sword from its Temple of Time pedestal in the Switch 2 remake yet, then stop reading right now and only return once you have seen it for yourself. It is spectacular, but it's something that warrants going in completely blind to really hit home. You have been warned.

Diungkapkan bahwa you know what, i'm even going to stick a picture of darunia below, just so that the coming paragraphs aren't spoiledfair does by an over-zealous scroll. This is your last chance to turn back!.

Okay, all clear? Let's talk about how incredible the new Master Sword cutscene is.

Berdasarkan laporan, this moment in the original is one of my foundational gaming memories. The score, the blue lighting, the threat of Ganondorf's giant looming face. It's all just chef's kiss levels of fantastic.

Sebagaimana diketahui, knowing full well that my partner didn't know the mid-game twist — and desperate to show her the first walk out of the temple of time and the source of so much childhood trauma — i called her in and promised her a slice of "peak gaming". I thought we had seen almost all of its new form in the remake trailers.

Berdasarkan laporan, but i was very wrong. Even in a game as well-known a quantity as this, Nintendo still had a surprise up its sleeve.

Berdasarkan laporan, and so, we sat together as link first pulled the master sword from the pedestal. I had a little cry as he swung the sword around, and I was ready to move straight to the Chamber of Sages lore dump. What I didn't expect was a full-blown cinematic from the gates of the Sacred Realm, some bonus Ganondorf content, and an image so threatening that it definitely would have given me nightmares for weeks had it been in the original.

I'm talking about rocky Link, petrified with the Master Sword in hand as Ganondorf taunts him while sauntering his way to the Triforce.

Berdasarkan laporan, it follows the already stunning image of link opening the door to the sacred realm itself, awash with dreamy lighting and colouring, making the pivot to dread all the more impactful. I'm a particular fan of the Ganondorf motif sting right as Link turns to stone. It's all so chilling!.

I was seeing one of my most-replayed games from a new perspective.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what a fantastic surprise, as well. I've loved all of the little extra cutscenes in the remake and the bonus context they provide (a particular shoutout to the Kokiri watching the Great Deku Tree's leaves fall), but this one felt like the first moment that I was seeing one of my most-replayed games from a new perspective. My imagination had filled in Ganondorf's menace and Link's helplessness in the N64 original, but never quite like this.

Diungkapkan bahwa it was made all the more special to be watching it with someone who had no idea what was coming next. While I gasped and cried at seeing images that I had only ever imagined, she did the same, witnessing all the drama for the first time. Honestly, there's nothing quite like seeing someone's jaw drop at their first realisation of the time jump.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, such a special moment is carried into its follow-up scene. After returning to the Temple of Time and meeting Sheik, you walk into Hyrule as you now find it, destroyed and crumbling at the hands of Ganondorf.

While there's something innately unsettling about the N64's handling of this moment (the silence of the Temple courtyard contrasted with the first scream of a ReDead is wonderful), the remaster dedicates another short cutscene to highlighting everything that's gone wrong.

Sebagaimana diketahui, panning over the decimated rooftops to ganon's castle in the distance, it really showcases just how broken the world has become in link's seven years away. There's an argument to be made that everything is more sinister if you're forced to imagine it (look at how scary Jaws is before you see the shark), but man, what a feeling it is to finally see it realised after decades of keeping it in my head.

Berdasarkan laporan, the remake isn't something that i want to rush, so i'm making sure that i go slow. I still have some of my favourite temples, bosses and puzzles to come, but if this is how it handles my favourite moment in the game (maybe in all of gaming), then I'm going to need to buy another box of tissues.

What do you make of the new Master Sword moment in Ocarina of Time? Let us know in the comments.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's a simplified take on the story—one that skips the wilderness years spent fighting for funding before arkane partnered with bethesda. Berdasarkan laporan, "when arkane was independent, very often people would come in and they would try to get us to work on some game that was not in our wheelhouse," he says. We don't know how to do them well, and we think that game is dumb. '".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, arkane very nearly did go under, pursuing its dogged goal of making immersive sims. But eventually, that doggedness was recognised by its peers in the games industry.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are many ways to fail, many ways to succeed. But specialising in what you love is not a bad path.

"And we never should have been working on a games-as-a-service game, to be honest. "That was a game that did not come together," Smith says. ".

Getting back to what we do best was the number one priority. For Harvey and myself, for the folks at Arkane and now at Black Pony, this is what our focus is. "That turned into a huge thing where people came and said, 'Oh, how come this isn't 60 fps at launch?,'" Horne says. "And so there were all of those things that were happening that we were trying to manage, but I think the bigger issue there is that we were working on something that was just outside of our expertise. ".

Sometimes it blows up in our face, and sometimes it results in Deus Ex or Dishonored.

#944. Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Actually the Perfect Way to Introduce Kids to Nintendo

📅 14 Nov 2026

Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Actually the Perfect Way to Introduce Kids to Nintendo

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-ocarina-time-first-nintendo-kids-game/

Berdasarkan laporan, walk into the legend of zelda: ocarina of time’s kokiri forest, and it feels like you’re walking into a picture book. Then you walk into the Great Deku Tree and spiders start falling from the ceiling. Everyone is friendly, everything is beautiful, and the world both feels safe and makes sense. Kokiri children are rhythmically attending to their tasks. My daughter screamed. Fairies flit about. Especially in the remake, everything is moss-green and dappled with light. I jumped, too, and I knew they were coming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since zelda: ocarina of time returned nov. Some players say the new graphics make the spiders and the ReDeads worse. Others played at age eight and turned out fine. A few parents are playing with their kids, but skipping whole dungeons in an effort to save their children some nightmares. 5 with its splashy Switch 2 remake, parents on Reddit have argued over how scary (read: appropriate for kids) it is. All fair strategies, and they raise the question: Can a game with a screaming zombie in an underground mausoleum be a kid's first Nintendo game? Parents of kids as young as 4 and 5 are asking, despite the game’s official E10+ rating.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’ve played the three child-era dungeons with my 4-year-old. But so are the tools for fighting it. Fear is quite present in this game. Which makes Ocarina of Time — The Legend of Zelda’s fairy tale — the perfect way to introduce kids to Nintendo.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the redead’s paralyzing scream, dead hand reaching up through the floor of the well, the long walk through the shadow temple: parents who grew up with the n64 ocarina of time tend to have the same laundry list of nightmares. Most of these live in the later dungeons, though, and there’s a fair chance that nearly three decades of remembering these seminal gaming experiences have amplified the dread.

Parents of kids playing for the first time in 2026 report smaller, easier-to-navigate fears: 4-year-olds who panicked at the first boss and lit up at the second, spiders that terrified them until they learned to hit back.

Diungkapkan bahwa good fairy tales have always been a little scary. G. Chesterton wrote that a baby has known the dragon "intimately ever since he had an imagination," and that what the fairy tale supplies is "a St. " Here, we have a tiny Link — a peer to my child — facing something scary and fighting back, with appropriate tools to deal with the fun-sized dangers at hand. K. George to kill the dragon. The child-era half of the game is there for a reason: It's not not scary, but kids are largely good with it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, eiji aonuma describes hyrule as a world with a bright side and a dark side. Link comes from the bright part, Aonuma told one interviewer, and Ganon from the part with "a lot of scary things. " The remake's tools could make something "very, very scary" if the team tried, he said, but the game is "supposed to be for all kinds of players. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, art director aya shida wanted a hyrule convincing enough to believe in without being literal about it. Her team reached for puppet shows and practical-effects films because both make fantasy characters feel real without reproducing reality exactly. The setting "feels somewhat dark," she said, and the colorful, quirky characters who live in it give the game its "mysterious, almost dreamlike charm. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in a world built that way, the dark stays a fairy tale's dark: frightening enough to feel real, and charming enough to keep playing. (How did it get in there? My kid wants to know. You’re running away from the spiders, but running toward the opportunity to free a squawking chicken from a wooden box. So does Navi. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa after link pulls the master sword from the stone and ages seven years, the game does get darker. (I find this deeply relatable; same on both counts. Some are holding the Well and the Shadow Temple back, and commenters in some Reddit threads suggest waiting until kids are 8 or 9 before starting at all. Parents of young children have come up with strategies to match. Others report a 4-year-old who lit up when Link grew up and a 15-year-old who cried at the ending. ) Reading comes up constantly, with parents reading the dialogue aloud for the youngest kids and some crediting the game with teaching their kids to read.

Berdasarkan laporan, whether any individual child is ready for this game is, of course, an individual decision, one that every parent will make based on their knowledge of their unique kid. But, for me, experiencing the remake along with my child made the sense of wonder Child Link feels as he steps out into this world palpable — and it gave me a new appreciation for the honestly very kid-friendly framing of the first half. The Great Deku Tree hands Link a mission with stakes he can understand and provides tools he can wield. By the time he meets bigger perils, he’s ready.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that’s all i can hope for my kid when she, too, is ready. That temple and the grown-up half of the game will be there when she’s ready for it. She laughed at me when I did a belly-flop into Kokiri Forest’s lake the first time I tried the dedicated jump button. She immediately clocked that the Keaton Mask looks like her beloved Pikachu, which is going to make following this game up with Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Super Mario Bros. I’ve gone on to play the Forest Temple without her, and, yes, it’s scarier, but it’s also longer and has more backtracking than she’d have patience for. She cheers “fight, mommy, fight!” when a Skulltula descends, thinks Jabu-Jabu’s Belly is gross — correct — and has fallen for Young Princess Ruto. We’re still in the first half on our playthrough. Wonder, and Pokémon: Let’s Go! so, so easy. I can’t wait to watch her grow into it, even if I’ll miss the days when only the child world had her full attention.

#947. Twitch Increases Monetization For Playing Adult Games Like GTA 6

📅 14 Nov 2026

Twitch Increases Monetization For Playing Adult Games Like GTA 6

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-twitch-monetization-changes/

Diungkapkan bahwa grand theft auto 6 has already been having a massive impact on the gaming landscape even before its release, with numerous games moving their launch dates away from the gaming giant or seeing how they can replicate its financial success. While not all of these have been positive so far, like the switch away from physical discs, GTA 6's sheer popularity is having one surprisingly helpful change for Twitch users.

While adult games like GTA 6 have always struggled to find a foothold on Twitch thanks to their strict gameplay guidelines, the newest updates and partnership between the streaming giant and Rockstar will not only alleviate some of the biggest hurdles, but also offer monetary incentives for anyone streaming the game.

As noted by Jake Lucky on X, Twitch is making some experimental changes to monetization on the platform which will "allow streamers to make MORE money while playing mature games like GTA," in addition to giving brands more freedom for which categories they want to advertise within.

With the information paraphrased from Bloomberg's interview with the Twitch CEO Dan Clancy, who describes GTA 6's release as "our biggest moment" for the company, the announcement has already been going over incredibly well with fans who are taking it as a "big win" for the platform that previously shunned players streaming adult games like Grand Theft Auto 5.

Even though Twitch has been under fire lately for feeding streamer data to AI and introducing a controversial new age-verification system, the change will also address the massive influx of streamers that have been abandoning the platform for other streaming services like Kick due to the lackluster monetization offered to games like GTA 5 and its massively popular roleplay streams.

While only time will tell if these changes are enough to convince previous users to come back to the platform, GTA 5's Nopixel server overhauls combined with the monolithic release of GTA 6 will make the franchise one of the most watched categories for quite some time, which Twitch seems more than ready to capitalize on if these recent changes are anything to go by.

Xbox has announced the first update for Halo: Campaign Evolved since August, one which will add Firefight to the remake's overhaul of the original game's story.

Sebagaimana diketahui, firefight is halo's cooperative pve mode which debuted in halo 3: odst. It's a round-based defence affair where players must survive as long as possible against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies. Following ODST, the mode appeared in every subsequent Halo game with the exception of Halo 4, which featured a mode called Spartan Ops instead.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in its announcement, xbox was extremely light on details regarding the addition of firefight. But the company said it'll share "additional details" about the Firefight update during Halo Fest, which takes place over the weekend commencing December 12.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm pleased to see campaign evolved getting some more features, but the announcement also increases my sense that xbox really doesn't know what to do with halo at present. Campaign Evolved itself felt like a collective shrug from Halo Studios, a glossy but unambitious overhaul of the original game, with three new levels that nobody liked and shorn of the multiplayer that the PC version so enjoyable in the early 2000s.

Sebagaimana diketahui, morgan park felt similarly in his halo: campaign evolved review. "It was cool to see another interpretation of a game special to me, but the glitzy coat of paint primarily highlights how right Bungie got it in 2001, and how its modern stewards are nudging Halo in an unremarkable direction," he wrote back in July.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a firefight mode, coming nearly six months after launch with almost complete radio silence since august, smacks more of "we need something for halo fest" than the start of a bright new future for the remake. Not that I expected it to magically rejuvenate Halo. But that lack of expectation, of anticipation, is in itself part of the problem.

Berdasarkan laporan, i could be wrong, of course. As part of Xbox's "reset"—which has included laying off thousands of staff and saying sayonara to several studios—Xbox also handed control of Halo over to Activision. Some have suggested that Xbox wants Halo to be a more Call of Duty-like experience, which would certainly make sense from Xbox's perspective. So perhaps bringing back Firefight is the first step in Activision's plan—whatever that is. Whether Halo can actually be that is, of course, another matter entirely.

Diungkapkan bahwa what does that mean in practice? well, according to a press release, founding partners are "the highest tier supporters of the f1 japanese grand prix," where they "bring additional value to the event while helping to shape the direction of its growth.
