Berdasarkan laporan, with the newest installment of gta on the horizon, some players are wondering what they might be able to expect from a new gta online mode if it comes about. The biggest and best draw for GTA Online was the major heists that made players really feel like a career criminal.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while some players may enjoy simply running a criminal enterprise in san andreas, many are hoping to see some new and engaging heists appear in gta vi. It may not be far off but it can always be important to remember where you started when you get where you’re going.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for that reason this list will encompass all eleven heists, counting the doomsday heists as three individual heists, and rank them from worst to best. A lot of what makes heists so much fun is how different they are and how they can appeal to some very different styles of play.

Diungkapkan bahwa of all the heists in gta online the prison break heist is arguably the odd man out compared to a lot of the others. As one of the original heists added during the heists update back in 2015, it’s definitely been played enough for players to come to a decision about it.

Berdasarkan laporan, unless you were coming prepared with a team who knew what they were doing this heist could get very annoying very quickly. While prison breaks may be a popular trope in movies it seems that it’s not quite as popular to participate in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, added to the roster of heists in 2017 this is the first part of the three part heist in which players are introduced to the doomsday storyline and meet the eccentric cast of characters. As contractors the players will attempt to stop an attack on government servers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the heist is pretty good, but being the first of the overall storyline means things really only get better from there. This puts a bit of a damper on the heist itself as it's really a precursor to some much better and more interesting heisting.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when your very favorite insane person shows up and asks you for help establishing a drug running operation you’re obligated to help. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the biggest issue is that the finale simply isn’t as interesting as many others, since it’s entirely about defending a position from waves of attackers. Many players enjoy what Trevor brings to the table but the heist doesn’t close itself out well enough to satisfy.

Rockstar is adding official support for GTA Online roleplay and plans to reveal more details September 8.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the very first original heist opened up the floodgates for players to enjoy an all new way to play gta v. With just one other player, you were tasked with helping Lester on a small job to rob Fleeca Bank before making your getaway in the Kuruma.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since it is the introductory heist, it stays relatively grounded and simple. That isn’t a bad thing, but when compared to the other heists it just doesn’t stand up despite the feeling of nostalgia the heist gives players.

Berdasarkan laporan, as the second part of the doomsday heist things start to get a little more interesting with this heist. Players will find themselves investigating a Russian submarine to uncover a crazy conspiracy and engage in some underwater infiltration.

Diungkapkan bahwa the memorable setting and story do a lot of the heavy lifting for this heist before the inevitable finale which earns it a stronger reputation. Unfortunately, the prep for this one isn’t as engaging as some putting it a bit lower on the list.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the most recently added heist having been added in 2026, the kortz center heist is a classic old school art job. Scout the museum, figure out the best way past security and make off with some very pricey paintings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the few heists that you can complete solo gives it a major boost, but also becoming an art thief is incredibly cool. The big issue here is that you won’t get even close to being able to do this heist until you’ve managed to wrack up enough cash for a mansion with an Art Studio.

Diungkapkan bahwa another of the original heists, the humane labs raid is an intricate and entertaining heist that sees players engage in a bit of serious seal team six work. Players will infiltrate a secret research facility to steal data after activating an EMP to go in under the cover of dark.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the standouts of the original heists, it really nails the feeling of infiltrating a secret facility. The finale is pretty incredible but many would argue that the setup missions are tedious though that doesn’t stop it from being a favorite amongst the originals.

Berdasarkan laporan, the final culmination of everything the doomsday heist has been building and the payoff is well worth it in every sense. Players will be attempting to stop the true Doomsday Scenario, but with a bit of a twist that we’ll leave for now just in case you haven’t played it yourself.

Diungkapkan bahwa arguably one of the most challenging finales of all of the heists, this one really puts you in the shoes of an action hero as you fight your way through the heavily armored enemies. That’s also what makes it a little divisive given how difficult the finale can be.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this heist, introduced in 2020, was the first heist to allow players to complete it entirely solely earning it a lot of leeway in terms of appreciation. Breaking into a fortified private island of a drug lord in a lot of different ways certainly helped too.

Diungkapkan bahwa many people adored it for being completeable solo, and earned it a good reputation since you no longer had to rely on others for help. Some did have things to say about the prep missions and overall stealth mechanics of the heist.

GTA 6 Online could arrive sooner than expected, according to the Twitch CEO.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the pacific standard job is the culmination of the first line-up of heists added to gta online. Players prepare themselves to rob the Pacific Standard Bank in a true and classic heist that really encapsulates what GTA Online heisting is all about.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s no denying that of all the heists in the game, this one evokes that sense of being a career criminal better than any other. With the actual job being an incredible experience and the getaway being a particular high point.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at the very top of this list sits the most interesting heist in the whole game added way back in 2019, the diamond casino heist. Players break into the Diamond Casino in a few different ways and make off with tons of cash from the casino in a truly epic fashion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with three different kinds of entries, all of which are incredible, there’s a good amount of flexibility in how to approach it. Each entry has its own perks but all are memorable and really make you feel like you stepped into a casino heist movie.

PSA: Don't get disconnected after winning the token.

Berdasarkan laporan, fortnite player and reddit user michoh44 was lucky enough to find it, but something even more unlikely happened: they were disconnected after getting the token and lost it. Their thread includes a clip where we can see them playing normally, and suddenly, there's a treasure reward pop-up, revealing the Pirate Shop Access token, presumably after a team member opened the lucky chest. They say they resolved the issue and got the reward by logging out and back in on a different device.

Diungkapkan bahwa game crashes do happen sometimes. The best way to avoid losing the token and ending up in the same position as Michoh44 is to intentionally die in-game after obtaining it. This can be done easily by jumping from a tall structure. This will put extra pressure on players while hunting for the Pirate Shop token. If you're playing Squad fills without voice chat, it can be harder to signal others to do this, so you can use the chat box to notify them of the bug and get all of you to safely leave the match and guarantee you get the reward.

While a popular anime getting its own gaming adaptation isn't exactly much of a surprise at this point, with countless low-quality spinoffs or games that fail to take full advantage of their original premise, the latest announcement coming out of this year's TPRG Summit in Tokyo offers one upcoming release that is definitely worth looking forward to.

Aiming to adapt none other than the explosively popular Witch Hat Atelier, which saw its own anime series drop in 2026, the series will be getting its own fully playable tabletop game based on its deep fantasy setting and colorful cast of characters.

Although scarce few details are currently available about the project outside of its initial teaser, there is currently an official website for the game by Hobby Japan that lists nothing besides some key art shared by WitchHatUpdates on X and a reminder of its currently expected release sometime in 2027.

Having initially been teased with an illustration at the start of November, the key art itself shows off a colored version of Qifrey's house, which was also released alongside a poster featuring Coco and her Brushbuddy surrounded by portraits of her classmates and Qifrey, all in front of a map of its fantasy world.

Although there are painfully few details currently available about the project so far, compared to the typical mobile, gacha, or fighting games that most trending anime tend to get these days, a full-blown tabletop RPG feels like the perfect fit for a grounded fantasy franchise like Witch Hat Atelier.

Despite the excitement from fans, however, we'll likely have to wait quite some time before more details are revealed about the upcoming TTRPG, let alone find out if it will be available internationally or exclusively for Japanese fans closer to the actual release date of the anticipated gaming adaptation.

Since the announcement, the Treasure Hours that increase Fortnite's Pirate Token and Gold Item spawns have been increased by two hours, as noted by ShiinaBR on X, which will now run until 6pm ET (11pm GMT).

Fortnite's second Treasure Hours weekend is now live, running from 2–4pm ET (7–9pm GMT), and we know a little more about how it works this time around.

Berdasarkan laporan, after last week's event and mounting backlash, epic games finally confirmed the odds of finding a pirate shop token. You've probably spent the entire season scouring for one, but for the uninitiated, these are super rare drops that, when activated, make the entire Item Shop free for two weeks.

Diungkapkan bahwa typically, you have a 1 in 137,500 chance of finding a token, but during treasure hours, drop rates are boosted by a minimum of 1. 5x (equal to a 1 in 91,667 chance). However, last Saturday, the second Treasure Hours window saw a 2x boost — so perhaps we'll see something similar today.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the weekly gold outfit drop rate, meanwhile, is boosted by 7. 5x during Treasure Hours, while the Weekly Vehicle & Decal drop rate is boosted 10x.

During tonight's Treasure Hours, everyone will start with Lil Uzi Vert's SMG, which should be a little less chaotic than the A$AP Rocky RPG-fest.

Like last week, everyone will also drop with a self-revive, so you'll need to kill downed players if you don't want them surprising you in the middle of another gunfight.

If you miss the first Treasure Hours tonight, there's another at 9–11pm ET (2–4am GMT).

Sebagaimana diketahui, even with a 1. 5x-2x boost, the odds of finding a Pirate Shop token are incredibly slim, but it's still the best time to grind chests. "For players in Asia, especially countries like India, these events happen around midnight. ".

Epic’s big Item Shop gamble seems to have already paid off, with players flocking to get into Fortnite's new mini-season.

Likewise, across X, commenters voice their annoyance that "the average person in Europe won't even be able to play the game since the Treasure Hours are at 2-4am," calling for either region-specific time slots, or a Treasure Day instead, with account-based hour caps for boosted odds.

#962. 'The Body' Ending Explained: Is Grace Possessed? Netflix Showrunners Talk Season 2

📅 14 Nov 2026

'The Body' Ending Explained: Is Grace Possessed? Netflix Showrunners Talk Season 2

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/the-body-ending-explained/

Also, how White Chicks influenced a key scene.

Diungkapkan bahwa the body, netflix’s new campy-horror tv series, came out this week. But based on a quick social media browse, it might as well have come out months ago. The high school thriller inspired passionate fan debates among viewers and dozens of fan cams dedicated to favorite characters long before a single episode aired. Now that The Body has finally arrived, however, fans are having an entirely different debate that hinges on its wild cliffhanger ending.

In search of answers, we turned to co-showrunners Quinn Shephard and Gina Gammell, who admit they don't even know where the series is headed next and that they enjoy the conversation the finale has inspired.

"We are amiable and gullible and don't have an answer either," Gammell tells Polygon.

Below, we break down some of The Body's biggest season 1 mysteries with Shephard and Gammell, and discuss where the story might be headed next.

The following contains spoilers for The Body season 1 ending.

Diungkapkan bahwa broadly, the body follows a high school dance team who may or may not have sacrificed a girl’s soul to qualify for their regionals competition. Through its eight episodes, the show explores the shifting dynamics and allegiances between its three main characters: Anya (Kristina Bogic), Lisbeth (Geena Meszaros), and Elise (Sara Boustany).

Sebagaimana diketahui, season 1 ends with anya confessing the sins that had been eating at her all through the season, including both her sexuality and the fact that she feels responsible for the series’ inciting incident, where grace (sofia wylie) fell into a coma after taking some ecstasy at a halloween party. Anya reveals that, when Grace started feeling sick, she decided to drive her to the hospital, only for Grace to seemingly die in the back seat. In a spur-of-the-moment decision, Anya returns Grace’s body to her bedroom and tucks her in, hoping to cover it all up without having to deal with the consequences.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, following anya’s confession, grace wakes up, stunning everyone, and says, “i’m god. ” It’s the season’s final line of dialogue and one heck of a cliffhanger.

“It was the place we were always aiming towards,” Shephard says.

Shephard and Gammell agree that what they enjoy the most about the season finale is the fact that it can inspire passionate debates.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we want people to feel similarly at the end to the way you feel at all of the biggest turns of the show, which is a continued curiosity about what is really going on, and a certain autonomy to influence that in your own watching," shephard says. ' I think those are our favorite conversations to witness. ' And then someone else is like, 'No, in the last episode, they said that she could hear stuff in the coma. "A certain ability to be like, 'No, I know for sure that she's possessed. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the question of what’s real and what’s imagined lies at the core of the series, which is constantly pitting religion against reality. The many supernatural appearances and occurrences that take place could be part of a mass delusion, or they could be a miracle.

Berdasarkan laporan, gammell says that the theories that people share with them “entirely convince us each time. ' We're like, 'You're right. ' And someone else is like, 'No, no, she has a drug interaction. That is correct too. It doesn't matter. It is the devil. Depending on who we're speaking to, we're like, 'You're right. '".

If the show gets renewed for season 2, one thing is clear:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "grace will be awake," gammell says. She and Shephard are excited to write new dialogue for Wylie beyond "I'm God. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whatever comes next, shephard and gammell seem to want their show to continue to straddle the line between science and religion. At least for now, they want no clear-cut answers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we’re both people who believe in science and ghosts,” shephard says. “So I think that we fall in the middle. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, much of the body works because it’s at its best when navigating tones that seem opposite, at least on paper. Shephard began writing the show’s pilot as a drama; it was only after some time had passed and she and Gammell began working together that they landed on the campy tone that makes the series so memorable.

“I think the satire and the comedy of the show was very much born from our working collaboration on it, and Gina finding the stories of things that upset me as a teenager quite funny,” Shephard says.

Sebagaimana diketahui, an example of this is a scene that depicts our three lead characters in the car together, with tensions at an all-time high. Shephard reveals that after she had written it and finalized it, she got an idea for the scene’s tone from watching White Chicks.

“I sent a still to my DP and said, ‘I think this is how the scene should look: them in the convertible: White Chicks,’” Shephard recalls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you’ve seen the body, you know exactly what scene shephard is talking about. While the actors play it like a serious drama, the tone makes it one of the show’s funniest moments. The result is a marriage of two seemingly opposing sensibilities.

#965. 10 Best Indie Video Game Boss Fights of 2026

📅 14 Nov 2026

10 Best Indie Video Game Boss Fights of 2026

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/best-indie-video-game-boss-fights-of-2026/

Ronald is a video game journalist with more than 10 years of experience in the industry, working on several of the most important Spanish websites.

Year after year, indie video games constitute an increasingly significant portion of the best experiences the interactive medium has to offer, regardless of your favorite genre.

Whether you prefer horror, action-adventure, or RPGs, especially when it comes to niches like boss rushes or Metroidvanias, the ever-reliable indie developers are always ready to satisfy your gaming needs.

For the past couple of generations, I've personally focused more on these kinds of products than on big-budget blockbusters because I find them more exciting, which allows me to talk about them at length.

So, to start wrapping up the year and reflect on the great adventures we've enjoyed—and be warned that there will be spoilers for the games mentioned below—here are the ten best indie video game boss fights of 2026.

As a fan of games that simply throw memorable enemies at you with no filler in between, Gurei was one of my most pleasant surprises of 2026.

The idea of creating a boss rush where the foes vary in difficulty and complexity depending on the order in which you choose to face them, also affecting the abilities you have at your disposal, is fascinating, and this is most evident when you face the Beetle Kami.

This force of nature is an enjoyable fight, whether it's your first or last encounter, as it perfectly embodies the kind of battles that rely on learning precise movement patterns, leaving no room for error if you want to emerge victorious.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in all my gurei runs, i rarely dared to leave the beetle for last because the ability it gives you is powerful, but also because its difficulty spikes dramatically. In any case, it's clear that all his versions offer a satisfying clash between two honorable warriors, which is the best kind of duel.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kernel hearts is a game i admire more for its story and soundtrack than its gameplay. However, its bosses are the exception, especially thanks to the presence of entities like God.

Fighting at the edges of reality with an immortal being that constantly changes shape and name becomes fascinating in a matter of seconds, particularly because of its strange fighting style that perfectly explains why it's the deity of the game's world.

It's a grueling two-phase encounter that demands meticulous control of positioning and attack windows, all while avoiding beams of light, giant cubes, spiritual representations of your teammates, and the constant onslaught of its divine claws.

Like any good roguelike, the power level you reach when facing the final boss is what truly determines how much you'll suffer, but whether it's easy or difficult, God offers a magnificent fight.

As we approach the midway point of 2026, let's take a look at some under-the-radar indie gems that already feel like cult classic video games.

While Replaced didn't quite live up to my expectations, I wholeheartedly consider it among 2026's best action games, with The Commissioner being the greatest showcase of its precise gameplay.

Specifically, the second encounter with Cole Carpenter exploits all the title's mechanics to their fullest potential, forcing you to dodge, parry, and shoot as the situation demands in order to keep up with him.

The burning environment and tense soundtrack also perfectly complement the encounter, which highlights the magnificent animations and choreography that Replaced brings to its simple yet visually stunning combat system.

Overall, the game's roster of main enemies is good, but due to its narrative weight, audiovisual presentation, and elegant flow, The Commissioner is undoubtedly the most memorable one.

Well Dweller dedicates its entire campaign to pitting you against terrifyingly well-designed enemies in incredibly creative fights, eventually pairing you with The Queen so you can free your family (and the kingdom) from her yoke.

Striking the face of this abject royalty as you watch her gradually deform is a stunning sight, even when you're too busy dodging her countless projectiles to notice that you're slowly revealing her true form.

After hours of honing your skills and learning to maneuver Glimmer, Well Dweller tests your ability to jump, dodge, glide, and bounce without pausing for a second, forcing you to be so precise that you'll only succeed if you enter a state of flow.

Unlike the bosses in most modern Metroidvanias, which are heavily influenced by the Soulsborne philosophy, The Queen belongs to the more traditional action-platformer formula, and that makes her sensational.

Hack and slash games have been on the decline for many years, which is quite a shame for those of us who are fans of great fights, yet sporadically we get gems like SoulQuest that remind us of the genre's greatness.

Despite being conceptually simple, the way it adapts the gameplay style to two dimensions is compelling, as is the showdown against Morrigan, a feast of visual spectacle and stylized mechanics that fully exploit the title's strengths.

With all your combos and abilities unlocked, it's not just that you tackle a fast and multifaceted boss that attacks in numerous ways and directions, but also the fact that you can particularly counter them with a plethora of magnificent moves, fully settling the power fantasy.

Defeating a good boss is satisfying, but doing so with a deliberate use of interconnected attacks for diverse purposes to push your style metric to the limit is much more, so we have to thank SoulQuest for bringing back Devil May Cry's magic.

If you are feeling nostalgic, take a look at these 10 best boss fights of the PS1 era.

Never underestimate how much an excellent presentation can elevate the experience of a boss fight, especially when you have examples like the final encounter with Dolores in Crisol: Theater of Idols.

Thanks to her stunning art design, fighting her leaves you completely captivated, but even more so when you notice the Resident Evil inspiration behind the encounter, based on methodical positioning and remarkable aim to target her weak points.

Furthermore, the emotional component also plays a significant role because, without going into detail to avoid spoilers, the dialogues that unfold during the confrontation are heartbreaking, providing a powerful conclusion to the game's compelling story.

Crisol: Theater of Idols perfectly captures the essence of the genre's greats while forging its own unique identity, and it's impossible to finish the campaign with this fight and not be convinced of its remarkable quality.

Future Knight is, without a doubt, among the most original experiences I've had in 2026, and the fight against the Lady from the Past is just the icing on the cake of a game that only needs three hours to win you over.

Although all the bosses are bizarre and incredibly fun in their own way, finally facing the leader of the cult that brainwashed the world is special thanks to all the layers of the skirmish.

Facing an elderly woman who throws bombs from her hands, summons tiny old men who shoot everywhere, hurls flying underwear at you, and fires glitched paintings while distracting you by counting sheep is not the kind of memory that fades easily.

The secret boss in Future Knight would also be a strong contender for this distinction, though I'm sticking with the Lady from the Past because I still laugh when I think about her, thanks to how improbably entertaining the fight was.

One of the main reasons I believe MIO: Memories in Orbit belongs on the list of the best Metroidvanias of all time is its roster of bosses, with Shii leading the pack due to everything that her encounter entails.

The final challenge that separates you from the true finale is precisely the entity that has accompanied you throughout the journey, proving to be an incredibly powerful being that perfectly showcases the game's dynamic approach to boss fights.

Between its teleportations, position changes, rapid charges, variety of attacks, and diverse projectiles, it's a clash that compels you to use every tool at your disposal, making positioning just as crucial as knowing when to dodge.

If you add to that the ending it gives you access to, the lore of its background, and the remarkable soundtrack that accompanies it, Shii becomes the ultimate icon of MIO: Memories in Orbit, which is saying a lot considering the existence of fights like those of Ati, Sol & Vin, and Nabuu.

These 10 Easy But Impactful Boss Fights prove that challenging encounters aren't always needed to be a memorable boss.

Boss fights in horror games are highly functional but also linear in their execution, unless your name is Tenebris Somnia and you deliver a confrontation as impressive as Lacuna's.

All the bosses in the game boast incredible design, both in pixel art and FMV, but this one in particular is a string of gameplay and visual surprises that keep you amazed until the very last second.

Honestly, I want to keep descriptions to a minimum to preserve the element of surprise, yet I will say that it's among the most incredible bosses in the entire genre for how it uses the environment, story, and mechanics to create a sense of being in front of an actual supernatural force.

It's true that combat isn't Tenebris Somnia's strong suit, but bosses like Lacuna know how to overcome limitations and turn their simplicity into a strength, as it allows you to focus on the fight's terrifying and immersive exhibition.

Mina the Hollower is a game that will surely be remembered as one of the finest in the entire indie scene of this decade, as it exudes such generational quality that every sequence is a masterpiece.

Nevertheless, facing Baron Lionel in his various forms is the campaign's clear highlight, boasting such inventive gameplay that you'll want to lose on purpose just to have another chance to fight him.

Whether in his standard form, which you face in the typical fashion the game has offered so far, or in his radiant form, which takes full advantage of the glorious tower-climbing mechanic to add verticality and perpetual movement to the fight, you'll be so satisfied that you won't want to fight any other boss for a good while.

Diungkapkan bahwa divine pixel art, superb music, an entire narrative sequence that defines the campaign's plot twist and reveals its treacherous nature, two independent phases that exploit the best of each of the game's gameplay facets. Yes, Baron Lionel is the whole package, and perhaps even more.

Thus, the most villainous villain in Mina the Hollower stands as the best indie video game boss fight of 2026, as it is also the best written, the best presented, and the best visualized of all the contenders.

If you want to catch up on the best releases of the year so far, I recommend the ten best indie games of 2026 (so far).

It might seem obvious that Nintendo would remake Majora's Mask after Ocarina of Time, now that it has the same foundation it did in 1998, but leaker Shepshal Nick dashed those hopes earlier this week, claiming that no remake is in "any form of production" right now.

However, that doesn't mean Nintendo won't ever go back to Majora's Mask, and in fact, former Nintendo of America marketing and PR leads Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang believe it's inevitable.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i still think yes," krysta said on the latest episode of their podcast (via gamesradar+). "They couldn't have been on the fence because they probably already started making it. I don't see why you wouldn't. ".

The ceiling has not yet been realized on Majora's Mask. ".

Zelda was "selling like nothing" until Breath of the Wild came along, according to Kit & Krysta.

Diungkapkan bahwa kit and krysta speculate that nintendo wants a zelda game every year, alternating between 2d games, 3d games, and remakes. Majora's Mask offers an easy way to get the ball rolling, given how much the original took from Ocarina of Time. Though while many point to the fact that Majora's Mask launched just a year after Ocarina of Time on the N64, the 3DS remasters didn't follow that same schedule.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ocarina of time 3d launched in 2011, and majora's mask 3d launched four years later in 2015, so it's possible we'll see a similar timeline with the remakes — a new mainline zelda game, followed by majora's mask, to plug the gap between it and the next entry. The Resident Evil approach.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, this is all speculation — even if the pair has extensive experience with nintendo — so it's worth taking their comments with a grain of salt. Still, while Shepshal Nick claims that Majora's Mask is not in development right now, as Kit and Krysta said, it's a "foregone conclusion" at this point, especially with Nintendo promising more remakes in the future.

Just don't forget to port Twilight Princess, yeah?.

Strauss Zelnick says that Nintendo "should be very proud" of the Ocarina of Time remake.

#970. 26 Years Later, Charlie Brown's Final Quote Is Still a Comic Strip Classic

📅 14 Nov 2026

26 Years Later, Charlie Brown's Final Quote Is Still a Comic Strip Classic

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/charlie-brown-final-peanuts-line/

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlucky in love, lucky in. absolutely nothing else.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, charles schulz's retirement took the world by surprise. Following a period of failing health, Schulz announced on Dec. He could no longer see clearly and had been diagnosed with colon cancer. 14, 1999 that he would end Peanuts. He needed to focus on his health. As a result, Peanuts came to a relatively sudden stop nine weeks later once newspapers had worked through Schulz's existing backlog.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, schulz passed away in his sleep on feb. At its end, Peanuts had run for roughly 49 years and 4 months and a total of 17,897 strips. 12, 2000, the day before the last strip ran in newspapers. He had never taken a sabbatical or had any assistants.

Berdasarkan laporan, the last few weeks of peanuts' run can best be described as "business as usual. " Fans had speculated for years about what might happen in the final days of Peanuts, as much of the strip was built around failure-themed running gags. Would the Great Pumpkin finally show up? Would Charlie Brown finally kick the football? Maybe the often-mentioned/never-shown red-headed girl would show up, or Charlie Brown would finally manage his team to a winning baseball game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, none of that happened. It just stopped. There are a couple of strips in the final run that can be read as having some subtext on the subject, most prominently Peppermint Patty's last appearance, but Schulz didn't get the time to set anything up. Schulz had to retire faster than he ever thought he would, so Peanuts never came to any sort of organized conclusion. All we received was the goodbye, because it was all he could give.

Diungkapkan bahwa in his last televised interview, schulz recounted the story of drawing the last peanuts strip to al roker and mentioned he'd had an uncharacteristic fit of regret. "All of a sudden, I thought, 'You know, that poor, poor kid, he never even got to kick the football!'" Maybe Schulz might've done something with that if he'd had more time. Sadly, we'll never know.

Berdasarkan laporan, charlie brown and snoopy's last appearances in peanuts are technically in the first two panels of the feb. 13 strip, but that's little more than an optional introduction to Schulz's farewell message. (The first two panels in American newspapers' Sunday comics are often written/drawn as a disposable throwaway gag, in case a local paper's layout team needs to rearrange the strip on the page. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the last full peanuts strip ran on february 6, 2000, which is the final appearance of sally brown and charlie brown's last starring role. It's a Valentine's Day strip, and as usual for Peanuts, it's about Charlie Brown wrestling with his own lack of romantic success.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the last installment of one of peanuts' sadder running gags, charlie brown is once again waiting outside his mailbox to see if he gets any love letters. Naturally, he doesn’t.

Berdasarkan laporan, this time, he's making sure to scrub it down. "The inside of a mailbox should always be kept clean in case you get a love letter," Charlie Brown tells Sally, right before a sudden storm chases them both inside.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once they're both dry, charlie brown continues to explain how these things work to sally, including why he's not going out in the rain to check the mail again. "When it's raining, the only letters you get are those that say, 'I never want to see you again!'".

"You seem to know a lot about love letters," Sally says.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "if i ever got one," charlie brown says, "i don't know what i'd do. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, if this wasn't so late in peanuts' run, it'd just be another self-effacing strip about charlie brown's permanent losing streak. It's also another strip that runs off of one of Peanuts' core pillars, which is about how little kids will sometimes make up their own "rules" on the fly. Charlie Brown, Love Expert, is here to tell you how it all works. He doesn't actually know, but he sounds really certain.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is a certain extra layer of pathos with this one, though. Charlie Brown leaves the world the way he came into it, doing his best to stay positive in a setting built around his misery.

#974. 10 Best Romance Anime Where Falling in Love is the Easy Part

📅 14 Nov 2026

10 Best Romance Anime Where Falling in Love is the Easy Part

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/best-romance-anime-where-falling-in-love-is-the-easy-part/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, usama mehmood is a senior writer at dualshockers with more than five years of experience in the video game industry. He has been writing professionally since 2021 and covering games since 2022, with work spanning guides, lists, reviews, and features across action-adventure games, JRPGs, open-world titles, racing games,.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the romance genre in anime is evidently meaningful and important to countless fans, myself included. Most romance anime also have a habit of making falling in love look like the hardest part of a relationship. From obsessively reading Horimiya (better than the butchered anime) to bawling my eyes out at the peak that was Clannad and then its After Story. After several episodes of awkward encounters, stolen glances, misunderstandings, and finally working up the courage to confess, you'd think the two lovebirds had overcome their biggest obstacle.

If you're tired of dumb misunderstandings and love polyhedrons, here are some Romance Anime for People Who Hate Cheap Drama.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, the real work begins after that phase. You see, feelings can be mutual, but that doesn't mean two people automatically know how to navigate each other's insecurities, conflicting personalities, or the unexpected challenges that life throws their way. Thankfully, some romance anime understand that there's considerably more to love than the excitement of a first confession. So, armed with my extensive cult following of this genre since my teenage years, here are the best romance anime where falling in love is the easy part, from one-off slice-of-life seasonals to the more emotionally demanding dramedies.

Diungkapkan bahwa for all my fellow video gamers, i thought i’d reel you in with my love story with yamada-kun at lv999. After discovering that her bf has been cheating on her, she meets Akito Yamada, a notoriously indifferent MMO gamer who initially seems uninterested in anything outside his favourite hobby. Getting over a breakup is never easy; I can attest to that, but Akane Kinoshita definitely wasn't expecting to find her next romantic interest through an online RPG. Their clashing personalities couldn't be more different, but their friendship gradually develops into something considerably more meaningful.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s a 13-episode show that beautifully explores emotional maturity and the importance of understanding another person rather than simply expecting them to reciprocate your feelings. The only downside I have to mention is that the anime doesn’t fully cover the story, so you might need to binge the manga to get the full experience here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as someone who originally read the manga on and off on his phone, “i have a crush at work” (2025) stayed on my radar as soon as i heard it was in production. Workplace romances are complicated enough without having to pretend you're not dating the person sitting a few desks away. But then you have these two coworkers, Yui Mitsuya and Masugu Tateishi, who start a relationship but decide to keep it secret from their colleagues. That arrangement, in turn, creates an amusing contrast between their professional behaviour and how they act together when nobody is around them.

Fair warning: It’s a little more comedy-based, but beneath that layer, the show neatly tackles a relatable problem: how do you maintain a healthy relationship when you spend so much of your day together, yet can't openly acknowledge it? And that’s exactly where this show will make you adore it wholeheartedly.

Berdasarkan laporan, we’re keeping the workplace romance streak going, and this is the perfect time to give some appreciation to one of my and everyone else’s all-time favorites in this sub-genre of romance anime: wotakoi. I genuinely think it needs little introduction, given how widely popular it is, whether it's the show or even the web manga. Two adults who are hopeless romantics in theory, but who actually have absolutely no idea how to navigate an actual relationship? This show literally answers that question with childhood friends, Narumi and Hirotaka.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and not just them; you also get a healthy dose of screen time with their respective co-workers, and if i’m being honest, i may slightly prefer hanako and kabakura’s cute moments to the two main characters. But again, we’re in a similar problem where the anime and OVAs don’t fully adapt everything, so either go read it or, like me, hopelessly wait for a follow-up season.

Like what My Happy Marriage has to offer? Well, here are some of the best shows that feature somewhat of a similar theme.

Diungkapkan bahwa this next one’s from my nostalgic vault because, like wotakoi, golden time is a popular romcom anime that’s beloved by (almost) everyone. And that’s the easy part. You’ve got a fairly simple premise at the beginning: our MC, Banri Tada, is settling into college life when Kouko barges in, and the two fall for each other quickly. The bigger elephant in the room is that Banri has lost the memories of his hometown and past after an accident, and the real kicker is what that gap does to a relationship once the honeymoon glow wears off.

Diungkapkan bahwa what i like is how mature the drama feels between these two characters and the rest of the cast, especially at a time when i thought all romance anime felt the same, with their usual high school settings. The show obviously isn’t a masterpiece or anything, but if you want an anime where the feelings are the easy part and the baggage drives most of the plot, it’s worth the 24 episodes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we’re taking things old-school here, back to the golden age of the late 2000s, when the shoujo series itazura na kiss aired. Look, a lot of romance anime are happy to wrap things up once the two leads finally get together, but this show gives you a broader look than your typical lovey-dovey couple story. It follows Kotoko and Naoki from their school days into adulthood, showing how their relationship changes as they navigate college, marriage, and just life in general beyond their adolescence.

Now, given that it is based on a 1990s Shoujo, Naoki’s behavior and character may be slightly concerning, but trust me, the show is genuinely a wholesome treat, especially when these two start living under one roof, getting through their daily frictions of life, and then eventually build a family together.

Diungkapkan bahwa tonikawa, or rather, as i prefer to call it, tonikaku kawaii, is easily one of the sweetest romcoms i had the pleasure of reading long before the seasonal anime adaptation premiered. What’s so great here is how the show totally skips the confession part: Nasa meets Tsukasa, falls for her, and they then get married very early in the story. From there, the series focuses on the joys and growing pains of newlywed life, as the pair learn more about each other while adjusting to living together.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's honestly a bit more lighthearted than you’d expect from the other entries i’ve mentioned here, but oh man, i’d be lying if i didn’t mention how almost every single moment of these two puts a gigantic smile on your face. Apologies in advance to any hopeless romantics out there, but trust me, this show is a massive ball of sunshine to help cheer you up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, falling in love for the first time is one thing, but then figuring out how to make that relationship work is an entirely different challenge. It’s a universal experience almost all of us go through when we’re young and full of these different aspirations. Yet Tsuki ga Kirei captures that awkward transition beautifully through Kotaro Azumi, an aspiring novelist, and Akane Mizuno, a track-and-field enthusiast, who grow closer during their final year of middle school.

Berdasarkan laporan, their relationship begins with these little tender yet familiar moments, but the show doesn't treat getting together as the finish line. Instead, it explores everything that comes afterward with jealousy, parental expectations, and the looming uncertainty of moving on to high school. It's a sincere coming-of-age romance that understands exactly why staying together can be harder than falling in love.

These 7 romance anime capture the quiet moments that linger long after the credits roll, perfect for when your heart needs a little extra love.

Berdasarkan laporan, my days of avidly consuming manga or watching almost every interesting anime in my piled-up backlog on mal/kitsu are long gone, but when a show like “you and i are polar opposites” comes along, it instantly reminds you why this medium is still alive and kicking for you. It quite literally lives up to the title: on one hand, you have Suzuki, an energetic and sociable high school girl; on the other, you have Tani, her quiet, straightforward classmate who’s just the epitome of the silent-treatment energy at first glance. Despite their contrasting personalities, they develop feelings for each other and eventually take the plunge, starting a relationship.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and it’s not just about them; you get to see their everyday lives grow together alongside their wildcard cast of friends/classmates. It has those high school romcom tropes going for it, but trust me when I say the writing and character dramedy are exceptionally well done, and almost every episode feels like a joy to watch, with no filler.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nana is one of my favorite anime and manga series of all time. I’ve got Nana Osaki as my avatar across most of my socials, and it's mainly because of how much this show means to me. What starts as a story about two young women navigating life in Tokyo slowly becomes one of the most emotionally complex explorations of love, friendship, and heartbreak I've ever experienced.

Berdasarkan laporan, the series doesn't romanticize the idea of finding someone and living happily ever after; instead, it showcases two bittersweet parallels: hachi's search for affection and stability, which often leads her into situations that make her question her own worth, while nana's fiercely independent exterior hides a vulnerability she struggles to confront. I sometimes obsess over Ai Yazawa's writing in this series because nobody feels entirely innocent or irredeemable; almost all of these flawed young adults make messy decisions, hurt people they care about, and occasionally sabotage their own happiness.

Berdasarkan laporan, to some of you reading, i hope you can relate to me on one thing: there’s some media you just can’t revisit with all earnestness because it’s left an emotional scar. That’s exactly what Clannad: After Story did to me, and I both love and hate it for doing that. While the original Clannad does a wonderful job establishing Okazaki and Nagisa's relationship, After Story takes things several steps further by exploring what happens once the sunshine of adolescence is over. It’s also where the show takes a full-blown descent into heartbreak.

Diungkapkan bahwa the two are no longer simply teenagers; they're young adults trying to figure out what it means to build a life together. That one entire episode dedicated to Okazaki realizing and forgiving his Father has absolutely scarred my heart. The overall show and the OG VN are important to a lot of fans in the medium, almost being iconic for how the story beats were presented in it, like a train wreck. Marriage, parenthood, financial struggles, grief, and letting go. It's a bittersweet yet painfully gut-wrenching narrative, and one I still find hard to revisit without getting a lump in my throat.

Love isn’t always simple, but these 7 best romance anime on Crunchyroll capture its magic, heartbreak, and everything in between.

How To Get To The Mountain Of Imprisonment In Phantom Blade Zero

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/phantom-blade-zero-reach-mountain-of-imprisonment/

You're getting close to finally finding out where that weeping is coming from.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of all the areas in phantom blade zero, the mountain of imprisonment is challenging because of the prerequisites you must meet to reach it. Luckily, those become clear as you play through the main story, but it's best to be fully prepared when you reach it so you're ready for what's to come.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's not the final area, but it's the penultimate one, so you'll want to be ready to take on a challenge when you reach the mountain of imprisonment. You'll face familiar enemies from the Weeping Creek Valley, but scaled up, so you'll need to be, too. Here's how to get to the Mountain of Imprisonment.

Diungkapkan bahwa on the meigu lake map, the mountain of imprisonment is on the northeast side of the water, but from the docks where you start, it's directly across the lake. You'll have to take the Sha Chi boat to get through this section of the map, and you can dock it at the various islands throughout the lake.

You don't need to visit every island in Meigu Lake to unlock the Mountain of Imprisonment, but it'll help you gather resources and prepare.

Diungkapkan bahwa to get there, follow the marker for the whence the weeping quest line, which will take you directly to the mist barrier to reach the mountain of imprisonment. You can also follow the marker for the Pillars of Kunlun, since both quest markers will take you where you need to go.

Sometimes, the truth comes at a great cost.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to reach the mountain of imprisonment, first get to meigu lake. After you go through the city of Pangzhen and reach the Pavilion of Knowledge Crossroads bell, you'll find a dying man on the ground who tells you that, to get to the docks, you have to take the long staircase next to him.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you don't need to pursue that immediately, but when you do, it'll take you right into meigu lake. From there, you'll need to use the Sha-Chi-powered boat to cross the lake, past Meigu Village and the White Serpent house.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, the main quest you need to complete is illusory pipa, because without that phantom edge, you won't be able to get past the mist barrier to get to the mountain of imprisonment. Because of this, you'll first need to go to the island with the Meigu Songhouse to fight Yan Qiansui, The Zither Maiden.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once you've beaten her, you can take the pipa's strings to myst's tavern as long as you've also got the head, neck and body, and she can repair the pipa for you. Only then can you clear the weeping mistgate and begin ascending the Mountain of Imprisonment.

Magic Is Bringing Back Its Most Controversial Creature Type

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/magic-the-gathering-new-sliver-cards-tease/

Magic: The Gathering's Aaron Forsythe tells Polygon he knows when more Sliver cards will come to the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa whether you love or hate sliver decks in magic: the gathering, you should prepare for more sliver cards to make their way to the game soon. Vice President of Design Aaron Forsythe revealed as much during an in-person interview with Polygon at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during an interview at magiccon, polygon mentioned how a couple of sliver-related cards that were part of edge of eternities, and asked if the magic: the gathering team is thinking about bringing the cards back in a big way or if they are too broken to actively support. In response, Forsythe confirmed that "we know when they’re coming back," although he wouldn't share a specific timeline for their return.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "they will be back," forsythe elaborated. "We know when they're coming back, and I'm not going to tell you. But we know people love them. They are hard to develop. They are hard to make work unlimited, but we have a plan. ".

#979. 35 Years Later, Tim Burton’s Greatest Love Story Is Officially on Streaming

📅 14 Nov 2026

35 Years Later, Tim Burton’s Greatest Love Story Is Officially on Streaming

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/tim-burton-edward-scissorhands-love-story/

35 years ago, Burton delivered one of his quintessential films.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what makes a love story work? for it to transcend, a love story needs more than good-looking actors, chemistry, and romantic dialogue. There’s no set formula, but it must sweep you off your feet. A touch of sadness and wistfulness never hurts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 35 years ago, tim burton delivered one of his quintessential films. After directing Batman and finding box-office success, he had a blank check for his next project. He made one of his most personal stories, one that he’d been dreaming of for years: a Gothic fairy tale and one of the strangest films to enter the mainstream. Edward Scissorhands came out in 1990 and has since become one of Burton’s staple movies. It’s also a timeless love story.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite how much i love it, this movie has a pretty weird concept: caroline thompson, the film’s screenwriter and one of burton’s key collaborators, described burton’s pitch as “the stupidest idea i’d ever heard of. ” It marked their first collaboration, with Burton sharing that the idea of an artificial man with scissors for hands came from one of his high school drawings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thompson had written a book about a monster fetus, which burton was a fan of, feeling like it had similar themes to his own work. And despite the silly premise, Thompson understood Burton’s idea and why it was so effective. “It was just so clean and so stark in its meaning. “I knew it was brilliant,” she said. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, edward scissorhands begins with a framing device. His most impressive invention is an artificial young man he names Edward (Johnny Depp). We enter the fairy tale itself, set in a Gothic castle atop a hill, where we meet the Inventor (Vincent Price), an aging man who lives alone amidst his creations. An elderly lady tells her granddaughter the story of why it snows on Christmas. Before he can finish Edward, though, the Inventor dies, leaving Edward with scissors as placeholders for his hands.

Sebagaimana diketahui, years later, peg (dianne wiest), a kind avon lady, visits the castle, intent on finding a new customer. Despite his terrifying appearance, he uses his hands for good: keeping their neighbors’ yards perfectly cut and making stunning topiary creations. She meets Edward, and when she sees his loneliness, she offers him a place to stay. Edward makes a positive impression on his neighbors. He moves on to hair, applying this same care to the suburban moms of the area. He also falls in love with Kim (Winona Ryder), Peg’s daughter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, burton and thompson have a perfect grasp of tone in edward scissorhands, one they’ve returned to in films like the nightmare before christmas and corpse bride. It’s a film full of whimsy, with a pastel color palette that allows for its darker, Gothic elements to stand out, whether it’s Edward himself or the revulsion he inspires in the town because he’s not normal.

Diungkapkan bahwa edward scissorhands feels like a film that was fully formed in burton’s head years before production began. That duality is what makes the character work. It makes sense for this version of Kim to be attracted to the sweet Gothic outcast rather than her loud all-American boyfriend Jim (Anthony Michael Hall). The casting of Winona Ryder also works because of her off-screen persona. The role of the Inventor was written for Price, a horror icon, known for his work in films like House of Wax and The Fly. Kim is a blonde cheerleader, a stark contrast to Ryder’s status as the ‘80s goth queen. Kim ends up being a Winona Ryder character; we just meet her right before she gets there.

Sebagaimana diketahui, edward and kim’s relationship is the heart of the film, though they start on opposite ends. In the film’s most famous scene, Edward carves an ice statue of her for Christmas, with Kim dancing amid the snow shavings. It’s the high point of their relationship but also its end. Edward is in love with her from the beginning, longingly looking at a photo of her before she’s even introduced. Kim hates that there’s a weird stranger in her house and takes advantage of his innocence and the fact that he seems to like her so much. After Edward takes the blame for a break-in she talked him into, Kim finally sees him. The town pursues Edward shortly after until they run him back to the castle where he came from.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the film ends with the reveal that the grandmother from the start is kim. Like the best love stories, the fact that it's incomplete is what makes it memorable. Despite all the years that have passed, it snows every Christmas, making it clear that Edward is still up on the hill, carving the ice. The fairy tale stays perfectly preserved.

Edward Scissorhands is streaming on Disney.

#980. 10 Game Boy Advance Metroidvanias That Respect Your Time

📅 14 Nov 2026

10 Game Boy Advance Metroidvanias That Respect Your Time

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/game-boy-advance-metroidvanias-that-respect-your-time/

Josh Speer has been writing about games for more than a decade, and has been a fan his entire life, since getting his NES.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game boy advance marked the beginning of the metroidvania genre as a respected and more commonplace one. Not only were there many great games that were released on the handheld, but developers took some real chances to expand it in unusual ways.

Sebagaimana diketahui, partly because of the genre, and partly because of being on a handheld, all the metroidvanias on this list are ones that do a good job of respecting your time. That means they're relatively short burns and that they're pretty streamlined.

Metroidvanias can take a long time to get through, but these ones deliver all the punch of a long game in a package that fits your life.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's a wide variety of games here too, some well known titles, others more eclectic. No matter what, though, they're all great and fun little Metroidvanias which do a good job of respecting us gamers. So join me as we return to a wonderful handheld that I truly adored.

Sebagaimana diketahui, back in its heyday, cartoon network had a lot of amazing shows, but one of the best was samurai jack. And even though I don't typically enjoy adaptations of those programs to videogames, they did a surprisingly good job with Samurai Jack: The Amulet of Time.

Berdasarkan laporan, not only did it feature everyone's favorite samurai, but it also has him hopping through time to procure fragments of elemental gems. Eventually they'll allow Jack to return to his own time period, but in the short term, they unlock new powers, such as a battle hammer and super jump.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while samurai jack: the amulet of time features great visual style and is a fun time, it's also more than a bit derivative of better examples of the genre. Still, for fans of Samurai Jack, this is an excellent adventure.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a big fan of spooky month, i adore the nightmare before christmas. But as iconic as the movie is, many of the video game adaptations have been less than stellar. Probably the best example was on the Game Boy Advance in an adventure called Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: The Pumpkin King.

Berdasarkan laporan, the game serves as a prequel to the movie, and showcases how jack skellington became the pumpkin king. There's all sorts of crazy, including a bug infestation, as well as the the schemes of Oogie Boogie to become top dog.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for how it plays, it's more of a platformer than a full throated metroidvania, but it's just enough of an example to include it here. Jack gets new powers and upgrades as it proceeds, there's challenging boss battles and the like. Combined with a really vibrant visual style, this is one handheld Metroidvania that's worth your time.

Diungkapkan bahwa everyone looks to the prince of persia: the lost crown for when the series finally embraced metroidvanias. But it actually happened much, much earlier on the GBA in Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time. And while the game had multiple console releases, the handheld one did the best job of embracing the genre years before The Lost Crown.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the gba game has you running around the palace of azad in 2d, fighting baddies and saving citizens. You'll get new powers, rewind time itself, and get powerful upgrades for helping out the people of Persia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, most interesting, you'll also switch between the prince and another playable character named farah. Which isn't that common in the genre, but it makes sense thematically and helps this relatively basic Metroidvania stand apart.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when most of us think about konami and metroidvanias, we naturally think about castlevania. But they actually tried their hand with other series, including Shaman King. The massively popular manga turned out to be a pretty fun little Metroidvania in Shaman King: Master of Spirits.

Berdasarkan laporan, what's wild about it is that you can equip a variety of different spirits, both with passive and active abilities. Meaning that it plays out a lot like Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow and Dawn of Sorrow, as well as Order of Ecclesia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you'll get spirits by doing all sorts of things, and can even equip different decks of them that you can swap between on the fly. While it's fun and visually attractive, this is also a pretty basic Metroidvania which you can beat in 10 hours or less.

Diungkapkan bahwa unlike the other games on this list, shantae advance: risky revolution has one unique characteristic – it came out in 2025 for gba as well as other consoles. WayForward had always wanted to make this adventure, and finally found an excuse when Limited Run agreed to partner with them for physical releases.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game takes place between the original game and risky's revenge, meaning that our favorite genie girl can still transform into a variety of animal forms. Those include classics like monkey and elephant, as well as stranger ones like spider and harpy. Each of them provides new ways to explore, as well as unique ways to attack.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the biggest throwback aspect of this adventure is using tremor engines to shuffle around the position of the background, allowing shantae to find new paths forward. Throw in a short run time, fun multiplayer mode, tons of humor and some challenging boss battles, and this is one amazing Metroidvania adventure.

Fans of the PS2 console probably need to check out this list of poorly known Metroidvanias worth playing on the system.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sometimes i think about what could have been, and one off games that should have been the beginning of a legacy. One of those games was Scurge: Hive. It was released on both GBA and Nintendo DS, but I played it on the older system, and was utterly bewitched by it.

Berdasarkan laporan, jenosa is afflicted by the parasitic scurge, and has to not only face the horrible mutations it wreaks on planet inos, but on her as well. You're constantly racing against the clock, and eventually even have to face the infection inside you. Along the way, you'll get upgrades and fun new mechanics like a mechanical grapple.

Berdasarkan laporan, while most metroidvanias play better in 2d, i found the isometric style worked very well in scurge: hive. Mix that with elemental weapons and a paper/rock/scissors system, and it's very addictive. It's also quite short, as you can beat the game in a little more than 10 hours.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'll acknowledge that drill dozer is a hard game to narrow down stylistically. It features lots of platforming, intense boss battles, unique upgrades and a very powerful drill mech. But given that it's also one of the best games on the GBA, I felt worth highlighting it here, even if it's not a traditional Metroidvania.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you'll use the shoulder buttons to control the direction that you drill, and it can do more than just burst forward. Jill can use her Dozer to unscrew bolts, destroying blocks and fighting enemies. You'll even get upgrades that let it traverse watery sections and fly through the air.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's pretty rare for any game to stay with me for more than a decade or so, which is part of why i had to include drill dozer on this list. I haven't forgotten it since I played it more than two decades ago, and I still fervently hope that somehow this amazing adventure gets a modern follow up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, inti creates wasn't on my radar until i played the first mega man zero. A wholly original, super challenging take on the series that bridged the gap between the X and Legends series. And while this is still a platformer, it also features a mission-based system and the ability to level up your gear.

Sebagaimana diketahui, better yet, beating some bosses provides elemental chips that allows zero customize his attacks. Then there's Cyber Elves, which are hard to find but vital upgrades that are also single use. Finding them can drastically change how you play the game, meaning that purists would go out of their way not to overuse them.

Diungkapkan bahwa one thing that also helped distinguish mega man zero from earlier entries was how brutally hard it was, especially the boss battles. The series did start to tone things down in latter entries, but not enough you could call any of the series easy. A really remarkably different Metroidvania.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hot on the heels of castlevania: symphony of the night, we got circle of the moon. A game that was more of a classic example of the series than a pure Metroidvania. It was also incredibly dark and hard to see. Which is why it was a brilliant move on Koji Igarashi's part to make the next game, Harmony of Dissonance, a bright, bold festival of color.

Berdasarkan laporan, even though it's a gba game, castlevania: harmony of dissonance is a beautiful game that still holds up today. It features Juste Belmont, who is capable of powerful magical attacks by fusing sub weapons with magical books. And while that's a lot of fun, it also makes this one of the easiest of the Igavanias.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still, this is a very fun metroidvania that features some surprising boss battles and a fascinating premise. But if you know what you're doing, it's also one you can easily beat in 8 hours or less, at least once you figure out the convoluted maps.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after super metroid's success, nintendo could have played it safe. Instead, they gave us one of the best games in the series on the GBA in Metroid Fusion. But it also was the first game in the series to really embrace a coherent narrative. Sure, it's linear and thus pretty short. It also injected a bit of survival horror into the series, a trend that was later embraced in Metroid Dread.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the x-parasites brought a lot of terror into the adventure, and totally changed how samus fought back. So much so that she had to get a brand new suit, which makes her stronger but also more susceptible to cold. Like other games in the series, beating bosses will provide powerful new upgrades, which you'll need to deal with the deadly doppelganger called SA-X.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this isn't just a great metroidvania you can beat in less than 10 hours. It's an amazing handheld adventure that's just as fun today as before, and it efficiently laid the groundwork for the series to evolve in exciting ways, including the upcoming Metroid Ravenous.

If you're looking for unexplored gems in video games, I recommend these ten Metroidvanias that are unexpected masterpieces.

#982. 12 Classic Wii Games That Nintendo Should Add to Switch Online

📅 14 Nov 2026

12 Classic Wii Games That Nintendo Should Add to Switch Online

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/switch-online-missing-wii-games/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with gamecube games now available to play on nintendo switch online with the expansion pack upgrade, it’s fun to think about other hardware that might benefit from similar treatment. The Wii springs most readily to mind, with a lineup of amazing games many players will remember from the system’s heyday.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s no shortage of gems in the wii library, and they didn’t all come from nintendo itself. Thinking back on some of the games that people missed at the time, it’s easy to argue that Nintendo should add Wii to Switch Online sometime soon, if only so we have another chance to play classic games like the 12 on this list.

Diungkapkan bahwa you’ve heard of excitebike, but have you heard of excite truck? it was the start of a short-lived offshoot series of arcade-style racers from monster games (nascar heat 4), which was a frequent nintendo collaborator around that time. It would be nice to see it return in remastered form, possibly even with a new sequel. Players controlled pickup trucks as they raced around beautiful environments around the world and beyond, using nitrous to launch from small hills and catch air. A sequel, Excitebots: Trick Racing followed in 2009, and leaned more heavily into airborne stunts. The island’s topography changed around them, keeping the action fast and furious for both players. Then the franchise disappeared. But if that can’t happen, an appearance on Switch Online would be just lovely.

Diungkapkan bahwa known as anno: create a new world outside north america, dawn of discovery for wii was an accessible city builder published by ubisoft. The lesser known Wii version, ported by Keen Games, simplified numerous elements (including the interface and visuals) for a console audience. Despite the more manageable approach, the gameplay loop remained compelling enough that, as with previous titles like SimCity, a person didn’t want to quit playing once they started. There was also a DS version, which is similar, but the Wii version handled the necessary scale more effortlessly. On the PC platform outside North America, it was released as Anno 1404, which is still regarded as a classic in the genre. Ubisoft didn’t follow it up with any sequels, which suggests it didn’t sell well enough to justify the effort, but it would still make a welcome addition to the Switch Online library.

Co-developed with Town Factory, the real-time strategy game lets players assume the role of a cartoon king who explores his kingdom in a quest to gain wealth and territory. It would make a compelling addition to Switch Online libraries.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the dog island is an astonishingly cute game from developer yuke’s, which has mostly built a reputation as a developer of fine wrestling and fighting games. The canine-focused title was the third in the series, but the first published outside Japan. It features big-eyed puppies of various breeds. The adventure itself is also surprisingly robust, with mild peril and excitement to keep everyone engaged. You choose your breed of pooch at the start and follow their adventures through cozy environments populated by minor threats, which they scare away with their pipsqueak barks. The art style is very soothing, and the challenges are the sort that might appeal to players of all ages (though younger players are the ones most likely to respond favorably). Anyone looking for a game about pets that isn’t a basic sim would do well to look up this overlooked gem, which deserves a new leash on life.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the fortune street franchise, known as itadaki street in japan, has been around since the famicom days. But that’s no reason the game shouldn’t return for a second round. Fortune Street on Wii was the first chance many North American players got to experience the series in English. It combined Nintendo and Dragon Quest characters, placing them on boards where they competed to amass a fortune. The game resembles the classic Monopoly board game in some respects, since landing on a rival player’s space can really ruin your day. But the lively presentation, featuring so many familiar characters, made it something special. I remember seeing a stack of the game available for years on a local store shelf, suggesting its sales fell short of what Nintendo hoped. A newer audience might be more receptive, especially if the game is one more entry in a software library they’re already paying for.

Sebagaimana diketahui, developed by vanillaware (unicorn overlord), muramasa: the demon blade was exclusive to the wii at launch, although a remastered version arrived on the vita a few years later as muramasa rebirth. Blade Runner Is Officially Getting The AAA Game Treatment

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/blade-runner-is-officially-getting-the-aaa-game-treatment/

Alcon Entertainment confirmed it has had discussions about creating a AAA game based on Blade Runner.

Berdasarkan laporan, alcon entertainment, which owns the blade runner franchise, confirmed in a recent interview that it has discussed making a aaa game based on the beloved sci-fi series. It's an exciting development for Blade Runner, which has never quite found its footing in gaming despite how influential its visual style and narrative themes have been.

Diungkapkan bahwa we learned about the aaa game plans for blade runner in a recent ign interview about the upcoming prime video series blade runner 2099. Andrew Kosove, co-CEO of Alcon Entertainment and executive producer of the show, was asked whether Alcon has spoken with game studios about making a Cyberpunk 2077-like AAA game based on the Blade Runner IP. Kosove apparently said "yes" before adding that they'd want the game to be AAA and prioritize player interaction with the world.

Berdasarkan laporan, kosove didn't reveal much else, and no such project has been officially announced as of nov. As such, we can't help but wonder whether a known AAA game studio is already working on a Blade Runner game or if the project is still in the discussion and negotiation stages. 2026. It would be amazing to finally see a game like this, though, since Blade Runner hasn't had much luck with video games in the 2020s.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the most notable blade runner game was a 1997 3d point-and-click adventure game from wildwood studios. In 2023, Annapurna Interactive announced Blade Runner 2033: Labyrinth, but most of its development team resigned and left the company in 2024. While people liked that game, a 2022 Enhanced Edition remaster from Nightdive Studios had a rocky launch rife with graphical issues uncommon in the studio's usual remasters. The game is believed to be canceled, as it is no longer listed on Steam or Annapurna's website.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it seems that alcon entertainment has moved on from that rough remaster and blade runner 2033 and now has aaa gaming ambitions for the franchise. All we can do is wait and see if those plans come to fruition, as any newly greenlit Blade Runner game would likely still be years out from release.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the short term, fans of the series can look forward to blade runner 2099, which will be released on prime video on nov. 25.
