Xbox CSO Matthew Ball said advertising in console games could help with the "two-sided problem" that AAA gaming faces today. Of course, if these companies insert more ads into gaming, that doesn't mean they'll stop hawking things like DLC, microtransactions, and battle passes; they'll likely both happen in concert. Development costs keep going up and up, and Ball said ads--as long as they're not overly in-your-face--could be a way to help developers make more money and solidify their business fundamentals. As Spiegel sees it, though, if executed correctly, advertising could be a big boon for gaming.

Berdasarkan laporan, "what's particularly interesting is that the opportunity extends beyond placing advertisements inside games. There's an entire ecosystem of digital advertising infrastructure, technology, and services that could benefit as gaming continues to grow. I expect we'll see increasing interest in those opportunities, particularly from investors looking for exposure to gaming without taking on the considerable financial risks associated with developing blockbuster titles," he said.

Diungkapkan bahwa during the covid years, the gaming industry saw massive revenue and player growth as people, forced to stay inside due to stay-at-home orders, turned to games to pass the time, have fun, and connect with friends. At the same time, interest rates were historically low. The cost to borrow money was so attractive that publishers ramped up significantly.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the covid-era boost to gaming did not last, though, and the industry is now challenged, to say the least, with numerous developers cutting staff, cancelling projects, and scaling back in other ways. If GTA 6 is indeed a massive success, it could trigger renewed interest in gaming as an investment vehicle, Spiegel believes, but not necessarily exclusively for funding new games and studios. Instead, Spiegel said he foresees big investment growth for discrete elements of gaming, including advertising, payment services, and AI buildouts.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i absolutely think a release of this magnitude will get the attention of investors, corporate executives, and private equity firms. But I don't necessarily think that translates into another wave of billion-dollar game development," he said. "The economics of producing games at this scale are incredibly challenging, and very few organizations have the resources, expertise, and intellectual property necessary to justify those investments. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "instead, i think investors will increasingly ask how they can participate in the broader gaming ecosystem," spiegel added. "That could mean opportunities in advertising, payment infrastructure, technology services, mobile gaming, or artificial intelligence applications that support game development. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa on the subject of ai, spiegel said he believes it's a "particularly interesting variable" because it could, at least in theory, allow developers to work more efficiently and bring down costs. In fact, many theorize that AI-supported workflows will only make work more intense. There is debate about whether or not this is a genuine reality or wishful thinking on the part of AI companies trying to sell their products and services. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick, for example, recently told Business Insider that, despite Take-Two adopting AI products for some of its workflows, the company has not seen a material decrease in its cost structure. For his part, Spiegel said AI in game development remains only an "emerging opportunity rather than a guaranteed outcome. ".

"The longer-term impact may be less about creating another generation of massive blockbusters and more about directing investment toward the businesses and technologies that support the gaming economy," he said.

Berdasarkan laporan, a lot has already been said and written about publishers moving their release dates to avoid gta 6, and spiegel said he foresees dramatic possibilities for how gta 6 could take the wind out of the sails of other entertainment near its launch. Instead, he thinks it's an "event that could temporarily reshape how millions of consumers spend their time and money. He said GTA 6 is not just a major gaming launch. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "streaming could be particularly vulnerable. Every hour someone spends gaming is potentially an hour they're not watching a television show or movie. And because this launch falls just before the holiday season, it could make it difficult for streaming services to match the exceptionally strong viewership numbers we saw last year," he said.

Diungkapkan bahwa movie theaters could be tested, spiegel said, and one highly anticipated film, the hunger games: sunrise on the reaping, will be one to watch in particular. Director Francis Lawrence said he hopes fans find the time to play GTA 6 and go see his movie, but it remains to be seen what effect, if any, GTA 6's release will have on that film's performance at the box office. Spiegel said movie studios are banking on the belief that the theatrical experience "offers something consumers can't get from their living rooms. It comes to theaters on Friday, November 20, which is one day after GTA 6 releases. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, there is a thursday night football game happening on the same day that gta 6 releases, with the indianapolis colts taking on the houston texans. Spiegel said the live-sports category overall could be "more resilient" because of its nature as an event happening live that fans of those teams, or fans of the NFL in general, feel compelled to watch live as it happens. A movie or TV show, meanwhile, is on-demand entertainment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, gta 6 is a hugely anticipated release, and it's poised to bring lapsed gamers back into the fold, but anyone who doesn't already have a ps5 or xbox series x|s should prepare themselves for sticker shock. That's because, for a variety of reasons, new consoles today are actually hundreds of dollars more expensive than they were when they launched in 2020.

Diungkapkan bahwa take-two ceo strauss zelnick has frankly acknowledged, "the rising cost of hardware is not a good thing. " At the same time, Zelnick isn't shaking in his boots about what this means for GTA 6. He thinks GTA 6 will be so good and so compelling that people will buy in no matter what.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i don’t think it will slow us down any because, you know, we’re delivering, we believe we’re delivering experiences that people want,” zelnick said. “However, a lower price point for hardware would be a good thing because there’d be more hardware in people’s hands. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, in terms of companies, products, people, and services that could benefit from the ripple effects of gta 6's release, spiegel said music associated with the game could surge in listening activity. This has already happened, as streams of Tom Petty's "Love Is A Long Road" surged after the first trailer for GTA 6 used the song back in 2023. Spiegel said social media platforms could benefit from GTA 6's release as well, thanks to fans uploading gameplay clips, livestreams, and other forms of user-generated content inspired by GTA 6. More recently, Cliff Richard's 1976 hit "Devil Woman" showed up in the GTA 6 Extended Look on Netflix, helping the song reach more people, including young people who maybe never even knew about the song. Beyond this, the world of food delivery could see an uptick in activity as people opt to stay in to play GTA 6 (while in-person restaurants and other nightlife venues could take a hit).

Diungkapkan bahwa "the broader point is that the impact could extend into parts of the economy we don't traditionally associate with gaming," spiegel said. "For business leaders, the question is whether they're competing with this cultural moment for consumer attention or finding ways to participate in it. That's what makes this launch so much more interesting than simply tracking how many copies are sold. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, if a game is about cooking, at minimum i'll have to give it a quick testspin. Outside of this whole writing about video games thing, my other lot in life is soul bound to food, so I'm always curious to see how the two can be mixed together. And earlier this week, The Snackbar at the End of the World was revealed, a wonderfully cartoonish action-adventure game set in a magical, slightly post-apocalyptic version of 1960s Italy where you go out and forage for ingredients while fending off monstrous crops before turning them into tasty meals back in your struggling restaurant.

Diungkapkan bahwa first up, i just have to gush over the artstyle a bit. The whole game is hand-drawn with a colourful, comic book look that has an impressive sense of depth to it. Once you've gotten the ingredients you need, you then, loosely in the vein of Cooking Mama, prepare them and make various classic Italian dishes by performing some quick minigames. It gives off a deep love of Italian architecture and landscapes, and that admiration clearly extends to the food too. Simple, but charming! The rest of the time you're off killing some ghoulies that look like mutated fruit and veggies, with the occasional fungus-possessed hog and, uh, haunted statues? I think?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm also quite pleased about two points made on the game's steam page. First is the content description: "This game features cartoon violence, sensitive political themes set in a fictional world, and depictions of an oppressive government committing crimes against its citizens. " There is clearly a romantic quality to the game and I'd be worried if it didn't acknowledge any of the political context of the decades preceding.

Berdasarkan laporan, the other line reads, "every sound effect, musical note, design decision, and line of code is human-made. " Thank the lord! Right now there's no release date attached to The Snackbar at the End of the World, unsurprising given it was only announced this week. Because this game is about human relationships and delicious food – and that’s not a story we would ever trust AI to tell. But while we all wait for a date, you could perhaps join me in throwing it a wishlist on Steam.

#989. 8 Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Miniseries that Hook You in the First Episode

📅 15 Nov 2026

8 Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Miniseries that Hook You in the First Episode

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/sci-fi-miniseries-perfect-hook-first-episode/

Designed to be binge-watched over the weekend.

Berdasarkan laporan, the best science fiction stories have a habit of going on forever. But sometimes, you just want to watch something that can be finished in a single weekend. Franchises like Star Wars, Star Trek, and even Alien enter the world with such incredible momentum that we're still making sequels and spin-offs all these decades later. After all, part of what makes sci-fi so great is the opportunity to imagine alternate entire worlds, galaxies, and universes, and then explore them indefinitely. That's where miniseries come in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sci-fi stories are a dime a dozen, but very few genre stories manage to make an unforgettable impact with the miniseries format. That said, some sci-fi miniseries accomplish a lot with less. Shows like The Expanse or Westworld need more space to flesh out their multi-season storylines. This makes sense. Whether you’re looking for an action-packed show or one that is more philosophical in tone, these eight entries make for a near-perfect viewing experience that can be wrapped up in just a few days.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, stories set in a post-apocalyptic dystopia usually require some time to establish the rules of their worlds, but station eleven rewards us with 10 enthralling episodes that hit hard from the very start. Instead of embracing nihilism, Station Eleven focuses on grief as a shared language between survivors, who try to heal through artistic endeavors. Set 20 years after a flu pandemic that led to the collapse of human civilization, Station Eleven follows a group of survivors who make a living by performing as a theatre troupe. There’s also plenty of violent conflict, but the resolutions are satisfying and earned.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after serving as showrunner for lost and the leftovers, damon lindelof helmed watchmen, penned as a sequel to alan moore and dave gibbons’ popular 1986 comic book. Angela Abar (Regina King), also known as Sister Knight, is a detective investigating the murder of her friend, but she stumbles upon long-hidden conspiracies related to vigilantism, which has been outlawed in this reality. The miniseries draws from the source material, continuing the story of iconic heroes and villains like Doctor Manhattan and Ozymandias, while also introducing new characters to reflect how their world has evolved. In the show, a white supremacist group inspired by the Watchmen character Rorschach clashes with the Tulsa Police Department, who are forced to conceal their identities to avoid being targeted. Watchmen excels in puzzle-box plotting, which is grounded in real-world historical trauma and a nuanced understanding of superhero mythos and how it evolves.

Berdasarkan laporan, time travel shows like dark have elevated the genre like never before, but bodies reinvigorates it with just eight episodes. Based on Si Spencer and Dean Ormston’s graphic novel, Bodies opens with the appearance of a corpse in the Whitechapel area of London. The four detectives involved with the case approach it differently, as their investigation is guided by the prevailing mood of the times. The same body, however, shows up at various points in time: 1890, 1941, 2023, and 2053. This is intriguing to watch, as a detective working during World War II sports a different sensibility than someone living in the Victorian era. Bodies makes good use of its talented ensemble cast, and it's a perfect binge-watch over your next rainy weekend.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you might know russell t davies as the driving force behind the doctor who revival, but he also wrote years and years, a dystopian sci-fi drama that’s quite emotionally devastating. Set between 2019 and 2034, the series follows the Lyon family, who witness the rise of a controversial politician named Vivienne Rook (Emma Thompson). This is a time of great political instability in Britain. Technological progress goes hand in hand with economic upheaval, affecting the everyday lives of the Lyons. Years and Years is perfect for anyone who likes realistic sci-fi that holds up a mirror to a possible future that is more bleak than hopeful. The plausibility of the premise makes it super effective, with Rook emerging as a chilling antagonist that evokes troubling parallels to real-world politicians of the current times.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the original six-episode anime flcl is nothing short of a masterpiece. G, sports a standout visual identity, thanks to a seamless blend of traditional cel animation and 3D CGI. FLCL follows Naota Nandaba, a 12-year-old whose mundane suburban life is shattered by the arrival of Haruko Haruhara, an alien woman who runs him over with a Vespa and then hits him with a bass guitar. Soon, robots and weapons begin emerging from inside Naota’s head after the injury, which Haruko uses as a portal while carrying out an intergalactic mission. This coming-of-age adventure, produced by Gainax and Production I. FLCL works with flawed characters, creating a raw emotional resonance that feels special in this unique standalone tale.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although scavengers reign had the misfortune of being canceled by hbo max after one season, this animated sci-fi show retroactively works well as a brilliant miniseries with a tantalizing cliffhanger ending. The story is about the survivors of a damaged cargo ship stranded on an alien planet, whose vivid vegetation hides unpredictable dangers. Although the survivors are separated into three groups, all of them witness an odd symbiosis between the flora and fauna of the region, along with a complexity that has never been seen before. The planet feels like a character in its own right, forcing every survivor to closely study its bizarre characteristics and life cycles. Scavengers Reign leans into a 1990s aesthetic, inducing hypnotic beauty and environmental dread at the same time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alex garland, best known for sci-fi movies like ex machina and annihilation, created devs, a sci-fi thriller that defies straightforward analysis. Devs is Garland at his surreal, unnerving best, and the show’s eight episodes take their sweet time to arrive at a complicated conclusion about determinism and free will. A cutting-edge tech company named Amaya offers a coveted position on its mysterious quantum computing team to Sergei (Karl Glusman). When tragedy strikes, Sergei's girlfriend Lily (Sonoya Mizuno), who also works as a software engineer for the same company, becomes involved in a mystery that starts feeling more surreal and abstract by the second. Despite its slow-burn, the show keeps you hooked with its intricate structure and compelling arguments about human nature.

Diungkapkan bahwa any sci-fi list is incomplete without an alien invasion story, and v fits perfectly into these expectations. V subverts expectations by turning its invasion premise into a grounded political allegory about fascism and resistance. After the government accepts this offer, a covert infiltration begins, with Visitors rapidly gaining power in political positions. They seek aid for their dying world, offering knowledge about their advanced technology in return. Kenneth Johnson’s (Bionic Woman, The Incredible Hulk) two-part miniseries opens with extraterrestrial beings known as the Visitors extending an olive branch as they land on Earth. Well, almost. Instead of leaning into the tropes of the time, this 1983 show uses documentary-style realism and nuanced drama to tell a story worth remembering.

Any issues with GTA 6’s 212GB install size have largely been mitigated by Rockstar’s decision to let you preload the game a week in advance.

The sheer scale of the open world title is causing potential headaches for other game publishers, however.

A new PS5 console comes with a 1TB SSD, and while you can expand that, I’d imagine the vast majority of users don’t.

That means alongside the operating system, approximately a quarter of your system’s storage will be taken up by GTA 6 alone.

This is a problem for other game publishers, who are probably going to see their titles deleted to make room.

And in a new message added to Madden NFL 27, publisher EA Sports has urged its users not to delete the game:.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a distinctly gta 6-style message, the game says: “don’t delete! the crew is assembling for a high-stakes run. Await the signal from our insider on 11/17. Do not leak this transmission!”.

So it seems the game is teasing some kind of content update, presumably focused on Ultimate Team, which is scheduled to deploy on 17th November – two days before GTA 6.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ea wrote a similar message on social media earlier this week, saying: “don't let 210gb get between you and your league. ”.

I’m sure all this is intended to be taken tongue in cheek, but retaining players once Rockstar’s game comes out is probably a very real problem for devs running live services.

I’m sure those who enjoy playing American football will be back eventually, regardless of whether the client gets temporarily deleted or not.

#991. Doc’s Rainbow Six Siege Remaster Introduces Remote Healing And Revives

📅 15 Nov 2026

Doc’s Rainbow Six Siege Remaster Introduces Remote Healing And Revives

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/rainbow-six-siege-r6-doc-remaster-remote-healing-revives/

Diungkapkan bahwa doc mains, you might want to start celebrating. Rainbow Six Siege is giving one of its most recognizable Defenders a pretty significant upgrade in Year 11 Season 4, and he'll no longer need to put himself in the middle of a firefight to save his teammates.

Diungkapkan bahwa revealed during the osaka major, operation vital signal introduces doc's new e-heal monitor system, which lets him remotely heal and revive teammates from anywhere on the map. Rather than having to run over to an injured teammate and risk getting himself taken out in the process, Doc can select them on his Monitor and activate their pre-attached healing patches from a safe distance.

Berdasarkan laporan, this also means doc can provide support to teammates who are busy roaming around the map and getting themselves into trouble. Players can trigger patches that were previously attached to teammates, which makes it easier to keep aggressive Operators alive without having to abandon their own positions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and if doc finds himself in a bit of trouble, he's not completely out of luck. The remaster also lets him use his own Patches to heal himself and recover when he's Down But Not Out (DBNO). It's a pretty handy addition for an Operator whose entire job revolves around keeping everyone else alive.

Diungkapkan bahwa doc isn't the only thing getting attention in operation vital signal, either. The update also introduces the MBZ-19, a new primary weapon with a 64-round magazine, 33 damage per shot, and a 750 RPM fire rate. Jager, Warden, and Thunderbird will have access to the weapon. Other changes include separate Ranked Solo/Duo and Flex playlists, a targeted Bank map update, and modernized versions of Yacht, Favela, and Tower.

Berdasarkan laporan, personally, i love playing doc and have always found him to be a pretty useful operator. You don't have to worry about missing a Stim Pistol shot or being in the same room as someone who needs healing. I'm excited about this remaster because there's now less room for human error when it comes to healing teammates. Being able to support your team from across the map is a huge improvement, and I think Doc is about to become an even more useful pick.

Operation Vital Signal is the final seasonal update of Year 11, and arrives December 1, 2026.

#993. Tomb Raider Remake Gameplay Changes Are Dividing Fans

📅 15 Nov 2026

Tomb Raider Remake Gameplay Changes Are Dividing Fans

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/tomb-raider-remake-changes-legacy-of-atlantis/

Lara Croft's original adventure is getting heavily modernized.

Berdasarkan laporan, amazon game studios has released the sixth installment in its behind-the-scenes series about the development of tomb raider: legacy of atlantis. The remake of Lara Croft's original 1996 adventure is set to be released next year and will update the game for modern players. While that includes graphical improvements, the new video details gameplay changes and not everybody is happy about what was shown off.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the "combat & progression reimagined" video posted on the official tomb raider youtube channel this summer gives an in-depth look at a handful of new systems coming in legacy of atlantis. Game director Raul Siquera details one major addition to the remake: Focus.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "when you're taking damage, dealing damage, dodging attacks, you're building your focus meter," siquera explained, "focus allows you to slow down time around you and showcase some of the things that lara used to do in 1996. " In practice this lets players unlock more of Lara's iconic acrobatic moves after building Focus.

Berdasarkan laporan, design director jason epps detailed two more changes in legacy of atlantis: a skill tree and herb collecting. Both of these elements are heavily inspired by mechanics in Crystal Dynamics' Survivor Trilogy, which revolved more around Lara needing to scavenge for materials and upgrade her skills. "When I played the Survivor series and I could suddenly affect and increase Lara's power in the game, I felt much more engaged," said Epps. Crafting takes on a Resident Evil-style system, letting players make items that heal Lara but also give her buffs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the response to the focus meter has been fairly muted. In fact, in some of the footage shown off, it looks quite cool when executed properly. A ResetEra thread discussing the video is full of comments like, "No sir, I don't like it," and "I hate it. The skill tree and crafting, on the other hand, have been met with widespread derision. " Another user asks, "Isn't she supposed to be a veteran treasure hunter in this game? Why would she be learning new skills at her age?" As the original Tomb Raider was a relatively straightforward game that had none of the RPG bloat that seems to permeate modern games, many hoped Legacy of Atlantis would harken back to this design ethos.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the additions are divisive, it seems the developers are trying to merge elements of the original tomb raider games with the survivor trilogy. Epps said, "If you decide that you want to play with the dual pistols the entire way and be iconic. Absolutely. In an attempt to reassure fans that Legacy of Atlantis' gameplay won't stray too far from the original, the developers revealed that the entire game can be played with just Lara's dual pistols. That's not too unexpected given the series is trying to establish a more unified timeline with new games. Even the skill tree has an interesting twist, as Lara will gain skill points by collecting in-game artifacts rather than leveling up through experience points. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, tomb raider: legacy of atlantis is coming to nintendo switch 2, playstation 5, windows pc, and xbox series x on feb. 12, 2027.

Legacy of Atlantis has good bones, but its 2027 delay saved it from disaster.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's been something of a rollercoaster watching blizzard tweak the experience rewards players can expect from dungeons in world of warcraft: forever. They've always been a reliable way to get oodles of experience and fat loots, but in Forever, the goal has seemingly been to ensure they're more of a supplement to regular questing and exploration.

Diungkapkan bahwa initially, mob experience values were nerfed pretty hard to compensate for a boost in quest experience, meaning that you'd get diminishing returns for spamming one dungeon over and over. Later, dungeon enemy experience was buffed by a lot, but not back to its pre-nerf value.

In a hotfix released yesterday, dungeon experience was tweaked yet again: "Killing enemies in dungeons now awards zero experience to all party members if the level of the enemy is trivial to the level of one or more of the party members," the note reads.

A mob is considered trivial in World of Warcraft when it's a significantly lower level than you (the exact threshold changes based on your level)—you'll know an enemy is trivial to your character when its level is displayed in a gray font.

This change seems aimed at higher-level players boosting their friends or a group of paying customers through instances, potentially offsetting the experience nerfs by clearing the dungeon and its quests much faster.

Berdasarkan laporan, a potential problem with this is that in classic world of warcraft, the roster of enemies in a given dungeon varies wildly in level, with some early trash mobs being much weaker than the bosses at the end. Blackrock Depths, for instance, has players killing everything from Grim Patrons which range from level 48-52 to Emperor Dagran Thaurissan, a level 59 elite mob. It's possible these values have been or will be tweaked in Forever, but if not, players might be less keen on forming groups with players outside narrow bands of levels close to their own.

#995. Forget Ganon, Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Most Overlooked Boss Finally Gets Its Due

📅 15 Nov 2026

Forget Ganon, Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Most Overlooked Boss Finally Gets Its Due

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-twinrova/

Berdasarkan laporan, the age of ganon is over. It's Twinrova's turn to rule.

Berdasarkan laporan, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time is iconic for plenty of reasons, but a big part of that is thanks to its villain. Ganondorf is one of gaming’s great bad guys, a reputation that has only been enhanced by appearances in later games like Wind Waker and Tears of the Kingdom. While Ocarina of Time’s Switch 2 remake does the Demon King justice, it’s also a reminder that the Zelda series has another excellent, and far more underappreciated, foe: Twinrova.

Diungkapkan bahwa first introduced in ocarina of time, twinrova makes for one of the best bosses in zelda history. The character concept is fun enough on its own, but the fight itself is memorable, too. Link has to use his Mirror Shield to absorb their elemental attacks (fire and ice) and reflect them back at the witches. They’re classic witches: a pair of bickering old ladies flying around on brooms. In the Spirit Temple, Link encounters two evil sorceresses who serve Ganondorf, Kotake and Koume. It all culminates with the duo coming together Transformers-style to become Twinrova, an even more powerful witch.

Berdasarkan laporan, the sisters’ real star-turn moment happens after link vanquishes their twinrova form and they separate once more. Halos appear above both witches’ heads as they begin floating up towards a light. That sets them off into a panic as they realize they are dying, prompting an unexpectedly great sketch comedy routine.

Koume: We’re twins! Don’t try and lie about your age!.

Koume: Who are you calling senile?! Is that how you treat your older sister?.

Kotake: We are twins! How can you be older?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the remake not only preserves that screwball dynamic, but plays it up tenfold. New animation lets Nintendo go all in on their final argument, as the two taunt and shove each other as they rise into the light. The witches are fully voice acted, and they sound exactly as you probably always imagined, speaking in cartoon squawks. It’s a delightful moment of levity right before Link’s adventure gets serious en route to Ganondorf’s castle.

Diungkapkan bahwa all of that has left me begging for nintendo to lean on some zelda villains other than ganon in future games. Twinrova got a moment to shine as the big bad of the Oracle games, but they’ve rarely been seen in the 25 years since. There are a lot of villains like that who haven’t been revisited in decades while Nintendo keeps returning to Ganon: Agahnim, Vaati, Demise, Majora, and more. All of them are underexplored in Zelda’s mythos compared to Ganon.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s a case to be made, of course, that villains like twinrova are so special because they’re not dragged out over and over again. They appear in games where they feel relevant to the story and design, so why force them into games just for the sake of fan service? Maybe Nintendo is better off creating new villains, like Echoes of Wisdom’s Null or A Link Between Worlds’ Yuga.

Berdasarkan laporan, i can get behind that, though there is a good opportunity to revisit twinrova if nintendo decides to do so. A new game set in that era, with some incarnation of Link facing off against them, could expand the Zelda mythos in a way that feels natural. You can spot the younger version of Koume and Kotake in Tears of the Kingdom, and they play a role in Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment. After all, the witches are 400 years old (give or take) by the time we meet them in Ocarina of Time. I’m down to see what hijinks the siblings were getting up to at the young age of 104.

Nintendo’s excellent Switch 2 remake recaptures the soul of a masterpiece.

Sometimes, games feel the need to really shake things up, especially if they’re on the older side of release dates. Today, it seems, League of Legends is joining this number.

Sometimes, games feel the need to really shake things up, especially if they’re on the older side of release dates.

Berdasarkan laporan, a sizable amount of the community response to the announcement has actually been rather negative, tossing shade towards the game for looking too “mobile game-y” after its vibrant new coat of paint. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the counter-strike community is another proponent of this practice, clearly wanting valve’s attention through skins and patches, without actually wanting any real part of the cs tempo changed. Now, for longtime fans, this can be understandable; after all, nobody wants their favorite game suddenly changed into something totally different. However, every live service title, no matter the age, needs new blood.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the aging visuals and code of league have clearly been the largest stopgap to its constant evolution, and the promises set forth by riot for league of legends: new dawn are seriously hopeful, opening the door for new players and those who have grown tired of the shakiest part of the moba giant. Years of work and slow improvement are clear through every inch of the visuals, I just need to see how it plays!.

Berdasarkan laporan, in may 2014, it was announced that edgar wright, best known for movies like shaun of the dead and scott pilgrim vs. The news was shocking because Wright was not just a director-for-hire like some Marvel filmmakers have been. When the MCU began to develop, Wright’s Ant-Man was one of the earliest confirmed projects. Wright first began crafting his Ant-Man film with co-writer Joe Cornish in the early 2000s, before the Marvel Cinematic Universe was even a thing. the World, would no longer be directing Marvel’s Ant-Man movie. Wright was even a part of the MCU’s first panel back in 2006.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as wright has explained in interviews, he was excited to be on the ground floor of something, setting the tone for what the mcu would become. After leaving Ant-Man, Wright even told Variety, “I wanted to make a Marvel movie but I don’t think they really wanted to make an Edgar Wright movie. He wanted to do a superhero movie where it was still emblematic of the director, in keeping with their body of work. The comparison he’d made was Tim Burton’s Batman, which is still very much a Tim Burton movie. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa part of the problem was timing. But Wright asked that Ant-Man be pushed back so that he could direct The World’s End first. Ant-Man was originally a Phase One MCU movie, with only loose connective tissue to the other films. This was because his producing partner, Eric Fellner, had been diagnosed with cancer and he wanted to finish their “Cornetto Trilogy” while Fellner still could.

Berdasarkan laporan, marvel agreed and ant-man moved to phase two, after the blockbuster success of avengers and when marvel’s “house style” had already been established. As Wright and Cornish were updating their drafts of the film and casting the major parts, Marvel kept pushing for more connections with the MCU. This eventually resulted in Wright's departure, and director Peyton Reed took his place. Eventually, Marvel had one of its in-house screenwriters do a draft without Wright’s involvement. Paul Rudd, who was already cast as Scott Lang, then did a rewrite with Adam McKay, which became the film we now know.

Berdasarkan laporan, to be clear, a good amount of wright and cornish’s script survived and served as the film’s overall backbone. The idea of Hank Pym and Scott Lang as mentor and pupil, again, that was all theirs, and also, the idea of a movie that that all drives toward a third act where the big battle between the good guy and the bad guy takes place in a little girl's bedroom, that was always there from the beginning, and I stand by the fact that I think that's genius. According to Reed, “The idea to make Ant-Man a heist movie structure was all Edgar and Joe. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, still, there were a lot of changes, and while we’ve never seen the original script (and wright has said he has to be careful about revealing too much because of the nda he signed) there’s enough out there to give us a pretty good idea of the differences. Here are the nine biggest changes from Edgar Wright's Ant-Man to the one we got.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the version of ant-man that we got, scott lang’s crew for pulling off heists was just three guys, but according to the film’s editor colby parker jr. , “I think there were, like, 15 people within the gang. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, michael peña’s character luis did exist in wright’s version, but in a much smaller capacity, most likely because scott lang’s crew would have been so much bigger. But as the movie took a new direction under Reed, his part grew and once they got into reshoots, his character grew even more. Even that famous summary montage Luis did was a late addition.

Berdasarkan laporan, this one probably isn't a big surprise, as falcon's fight with ant-man definitely feels shoehorned into the movie. As Parker Jr. I think he was going to be a standalone. He didn't want any other Marvel characters in the film. told The Direct, "I don't think there would have been any other Marvel characters set up. Wright’s version had far less crossover with the existing MCU. ” Parker Jr. even specifically pointed to the scene, saying, “I don't think the Falcon would have been in Ant-Man.

According to the book MCU: The Reign of Marvel Studios, Edgar Wright’s Ant-Man would have begun with a flashback to Hank Pym (Michael Douglas) as the original Ant-Man, then it would have jumped to the present day with Scott Lang stealing the suit.

With Wright opening on Pym as Ant-Man, the movie would not have featured the scene with Hank Pym fighting with Peggy Carter and Howard Stark about trying to replicate his Pym Particles.

Diungkapkan bahwa as peyton reed told vulture, “in the original drafts i think there was one reference in dialogue to janet. She didn’t appear in the movie. ” While Janet Van Dyne — who would eventually come to be played by Michelle Pfeiffer in Ant-Man and the Wasp — only appears briefly in Ant-Man, her absence informs much of Hank Pym’s arc with his daughter Hope (Evangeline Lilly) and builds into the Quantum Realm story for the sequel. Speaking of which….

Berdasarkan laporan, “we also brought the quantum realm into the movie, which was never in the early drafts,” reed told vulture. “That mostly came about because Adam and I love that psychedelic part of Marvel Comics. What if we got to the third act and we took it even further?’ We found a way to work that into the story with the self-sacrifice that Scott makes to save his daughter, but it also leaves Hank Pym with this realization that Scott got out of the quantum realm, something he didn’t think was possible. We thought, ‘There’s gonna be a lot of shrinking in this movie. ”.

Considering how important the quantum realm is to the MCU, especially for Avengers: Endgame, it’s clear that Wright’s departure didn’t just change Ant-Man, it changed the entire MCU.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the final version of ant-man, scott lang is an ex-con in the very loosest sense, having committed some anti-corporate crime where he did some robin hood kind of thing, stealing corporate money and giving it to people who had been scammed by the company. But in Wright’s version, Lang started out as an “actual criminal,” Wright explained on his Instagram, with a greater redemption arc throughout the film. This undoubtedly would have changed the character, and probably would have made him a bit more interesting.

Diungkapkan bahwa evangeline lilly, who came onto the film as hope van dyne because of edgar wright, was a big supporter of his and almost left the film in solidarity. It would have stuck out like a sore thumb, no matter how good it was. It just would have taken you away from this cohesive universe they’re trying to create. Eventually, she was convinced to stay on and, after having seen the finished film directed by Reed, she told The Hollywood Reporter that Wright's version “wouldn’t have fit in the Marvel Universe. ”.

#998. 10 Great Games That Defined The Xbox One

📅 14 Nov 2026

10 Great Games That Defined The Xbox One

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/great-games-that-defined-xbox-one/

Eric Warner is a Journalist and Multimedia Producer based in New England with over 7 years of experience producing stories for multiple publications.

Diungkapkan bahwa the xbox is turning 25 years old this november. While most of this momentous occasion’s marketing is centered around the original Xbox console, it’s important to look back at every era of the Xbox brand and reflect on how far the Microsoft gaming branch has come over the years.

Arguably Xbox’s darkest age was that during the reign of the Xbox One, as Microsoft immediately lost the momentum of the Xbox 360 by having the third Xbox generation initially focus primarily on TV shows, streaming services, and restrictive internet connectivity.

Despite these issues and troublesome game development during this era, there were still many great exclusive games that launched on the Xbox One and showcased Xbox’s evolution throughout the 2010s.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the late 2010s, battle royale games were all the rage. While Fortnite has since taken the crown as the most popular BR game, that wasn’t always the case, and Microsoft strived to capitalize on the genre’s popularity by releasing PUBG: Battlegrounds exclusively for the Xbox One in 2017.

Based on ARMA, DayZ, and the 2000 Battle Royale Japanese film, PUBG: Battlegrounds on Xbox One was released as a part of the Xbox Game Preview program before being officially released in 2018 with PC cross-play functionality.

Compared to more modern BR and extraction shooters, PUBG: Battlegrounds may seem rather basic but nearly 10 years ago PUBG stood as one of the most popular multiplayer games thanks to its gritty, realistic, first and third-person shooter gameplay.

While the Xbox One might not have had a great PR debut thanks to its TV focus, it still managed to have a fairly impressive lineup of launch titles such as Ryse: Son of Rome, Zoo Tycoon, and Killer Instinct, a revival of Rare’s underrated 1990s fighting game series.

Unlike the former titles, 2013’s Killer Instinct didn’t launch with a physical release and instead was a digital Xbox One exclusive in a free-to-play state, with only one playable character available for free on a rotated basis and every other character available for purchase individually.

This sort of free-to-play and unfinished nature would set the tone for the Xbox One era overall, as Microsoft would go on to invest in other free-to-play opportunities and launch games in incomplete states such as its Xbox Game Pass subscription service and Halo: The Master Chief Collection.

From Project Gotham Racing to Halo: Combat Evolved, these 10 great games defined the original Xbox and set the groundwork for Xbox's future.

The Xbox One era overall is marred by its lack of heavy hitting exclusive titles, especially compared to the exclusives that launched on the PlayStation 4, but Microsoft did strive to experiment a bit with brand new IPs and this can best be represented with 2016’s ReCore.

Inspired by The Legend of Zelda and Metroid in terms of gameplay, ReCore was a third-person action-adventure and platforming game following Far Eden colonist Joule Adams and her trusty animalistic corebot Mack as they awake from a centuries long cryo-sleep only to find the colony in mysterious ruin.

While ReCore received mixed reviews overall and never got a proper follow-up, it’s still one of the most creative and interesting exclusives released for the Xbox One and is worth a revisit via its updated definitive edition by anyone who considers themselves to be a hardcore Xbox fan.

Diungkapkan bahwa the xbox one era was a rough time to be a halo fan to say the least. Not only did Halo: MCC launch as a broken mess but Halo 5: Guardians debuted with a highly divisive campaign, without several traditional modes, no split-screen functionality, and pay-to-win microtransactions.

Those two games were massive disappointments for many fans, but in 2016 they were given a glimmer of hope when 343 Industries and Creative Assembly launched the long-awaited sequel to the RTS Halo Wars, Halo Wars 2, for PCs and Xbox One consoles.

Here fans were not only to learn about the fate of the lost UNSC Spirit of Fire in its classic Bungie-era art style, but witness the introduction of one of Halo’s most beloved enemy factions, the Brute-led Banished, as they and the Spirit fought over control of the Forerunner installation, the Ark.

Much like the Halo franchise, Microsoft strove to continue the Gears of War franchise after its original trilogy concluded on the Xbox 360, with the publisher forming The Coalition to oversee the franchise into a new era with Gears of War 4.

Gears of War 4 was relatively well-received by critics and fans alike, but Microsoft chose to have its sequel, Gears 5, be more or less the mascot of the Xbox One X to showcase the power of the upgraded console.

While Gears 5’s campaign wasn’t as well received as its predecessor, it was certainly a visually impressive game for the time and featured some of the most visceral gameplay in the entire series as well as one of the best DLC campaigns in the franchise with Gears 5: Hivebusters.

To prepare for Halo: Campaign Evolved's debut, Halo fans should strive to check out these eight games due to their lore and gameplay connections.

Insomniac Games is largely known today for its PlayStation exclusive Marvel games such as Marvel’s Spider-Man and Marvel’s Wolverine, but in the early 2010s the Californian developer briefly worked with Microsoft to launch a brand-new IP called Sunset Overdrive.

Heavily inspired by the funky Jet Set Radio series, Sunset Overdrive is an open-world adventure game following a customizable janitor turned reluctant hero as they strive to flee Sunset City from people turned into hulking mutants after they consumed the new energy drink, OverCharge.

With its comical world design and enthralling parkour centric gameplay, Sunset Overdrive was easily one of the best exclusive titles available on the Xbox One, even if its fun game design didn’t translate to high sales numbers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beginning in the 360 era, microsoft increasingly invested in smaller game development studios to the point of eventual acquisition and publication of their small, typically 2d-focused titles. This method of game releases continued into the Xbox One era with titles like Ori and the Blind Forest.

Moon Studios’ debut title, Ori and the Blind Forest is a rather emotional and frankly wondrous metroidvania following Ori, a small cat-like guardian spirit, as they set out to restore their home, Nibel forest, after a mysterious event caused all plant life to wither away, leading many animals to starvation.

Ori and the Blind Forest might not be action-packed as many of Xbox’s exclusive titles, but it's still one of the most visually impressive games Microsoft has ever published and is easily one of the best metroidvania games made in the 21st century.

Diungkapkan bahwa as mentioned before, the xbox one surprisingly featured a good variety of unique, exclusive launch titles. While all of them are great in their own right, I would argue that the best Xbox One launch title was Capcom Vancouver’s Dead Rising 3.

Set roughly 10 years after Dead Rising 2, Dead Rising 3 follows series new protagonist Nick Ramos as he strives to escape a new zombie outbreak in California with his friends, only to discover that he’s at the center of a conspiracy that goes all the way back to events seen in the first Dead Rising.

While DR3 did notably ease up on the series’ traditional stress-inducing time mechanics, it innovated upon the series in several other ways, such as introducing a seamless open-world, a plethora of new combo weapons, and combo vehicles, culminating in an overall awesome DR experience.

The Xbox had a rough start, but it managed to stick the landing in the industry and our hearts with these great games.

Diungkapkan bahwa ever since rare was purchased by microsoft in 2002, the british developer has struggled to release universally successful games. While I would consider Viva Pinata to be their best Xbox game, they finally released their most overwhelmingly successful Xbox game in 2018, with Sea of Thieves.

Rare’s 15th game developed for Xbox, Sea of Thieves is a first-person pirate adventure multiplayer game, with players being able to customize their own cartoonish pirates and ships and set sail into monster-infested waters in search of hidden treasure or loot to steal from other players.

As a live service game, Sea of Thieves took time to really shine but after Rare released several expansive updates over the years such as the Sunken Kingdom, A Pirate's Life, and The Legend of Monkey Island, the game has truly become the definitive pirate multiplayer game.

Without a doubt the most unique, creative, and standout exclusive game to launch on the Xbox One, and the best game that defines the overall Xbox One era, is Studio MDHR’s Cuphead.

Inspired by rubberhose-style cartoons of the 1920s and 30s similar to Felix the Cat and Mickey Mouse, Cuphead is a 2D run and gun game following the young brothers Cuphead and Mugman, as they make a deal with the Devil to save their souls by taking down all of his runaway debtors from his casino.

Cuphead is as visually amazing as its gameplay is challenging, in both single-player and two-player co-op, with the game additionally featuring an energetic soundtrack, making Cuphead one of the best overall products ever released on the Xbox One.

These Xbox 360 games are fun from the start to finish and remain that way upon repeat single-player or multiplayer playthroughs.

#999. Stephen King’s Underrated 1980 Horror Thriller Gets New Prime Video Adaptation

📅 15 Nov 2026

Stephen King’s Underrated 1980 Horror Thriller Gets New Prime Video Adaptation

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/stephen-king-prime-video-crouch-end-tv-show/

King's cosmic horror story is getting a brand-new adaptation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stephen king fans are eating well, with mike flanagan's adaptation of carrie turning out to be a surprise hit, a second season of it: welcome to derry on the way, and a series based on the dark tower books in the works. But that's not all King fans can look forward to.

Sebagaimana diketahui, prime video is reportedly developing a limited series based on king's horror-sci-fi short story crouch end. Considered an homage to H. P. Lovecraft, the story first appeared in the New Tales of the Cthulhu Mythos anthology, and was later published in King’s Nightmares & Dreamscapes short story collection. It bears the distinction of not being set in King's native Maine, like many of his works, but rather in London.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the series' official synopsis reads: “london never sleeps deeply, and its dreams are uneasy. When global movie star Doris Freeman bursts into a London police station claiming that strange phenomena are behind the disappearance of her husband, police inspector Ted Vetter must investigate whether she’s telling the truth, whether she could be a murderer, or whether there’s something even more chilling at play…”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the six-part adaptation is created by paul tomalin (bodies) and directed by tom shankland (berlin noir). Variety confirms its producers include Mammoth Screen (The Serpent), and Fifth Season (Severance), while its executive producers are Paul Tomalin, Ben Irving, Rebecca Keane, Damien Timmer, and Tom Shankland.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tomalin and shankland's project is far from the first time that crouch end has received an adaptation. The short story was also adapted as an episode of TNT's Nightmares & Dreamscapes: From the Stories of Stephen King in 2006, starring Eion Bailey as Lonnie Freeman and Claire Forlani as Doris Freeman. While Crouch End is certainly short enough to fit into a single episode, Shankland and Tomalin's adaptation will have room to explore more of the themes of grief, trauma, and cosmic horror.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i’ve been a stephen king super-fan forever," shankland said in a statement. "The chance to work with this great team and bring his utterly brilliant London mystery to life is beyond exciting – Crouch End will be cinematic, original and thought-provoking in equal measure. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, tomalin added: "after reading ‘crouch end’ some years back, stephen king’s vivid prose has haunted my nightmares ever since. Having the honour to adapt it with the incredible team at Mammoth, Fifth Season and Amazon alongside director Tom Shankland is a dream come true. I couldn’t be more excited to bring this thrilling tale to the screen. ”.

Sit back and go on a wild ride with Maximum Overdrive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to being a supernatural mystery and crime-thriller, crouch end also draws on the cthulhu mythos of h. P. Lovecraft — meaning there will be plenty of grotesque imagery and horror alongside its mystery and crime elements.

Diungkapkan bahwa nicole clemens, the vice president of international originals at prime video and amazon mgm studios, said in a statement: "stephen king is one of the defining storytellers of our time, and we’re thrilled to bring his lovecraftian tale to life in london with crouch end. Paul Tomalin brings a singular, character-driven vision to the series and, paired with Tom Shankland at the helm, plus the first-class production teams at Mammoth Screen and Fifth Season, this show will grip audiences worldwide with its visceral crime thriller and supernatural mystery. ".

Crouch End does not have a confirmed release date.

#1000. 8 Metroidvanias Where Every Choice Matters

📅 14 Nov 2026

8 Metroidvanias Where Every Choice Matters

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/metroidvanias-where-every-choice-matters/

Diungkapkan bahwa shayna josi is a features writer from south africa. She is a ghostwriter, copywriter, and editor in the publishing industry.

Berdasarkan laporan, choice one of the mechanics that does a lot to set video games apart from other forms of media, and can take many different forms. It’s what draws me to RPGs, but even genres that aren’t known for their story choices like Metroidvanias have choice play some kind of a role, even if it’s something like how you build your character and approach combat.

Metroidvanias can take a long time to get through, but these ones deliver all the punch of a long game in a package that fits your life.

Berdasarkan laporan, metroidvanias focus primarily on exploration, abilities, and exploration, and there are plenty of games in the genre that take things a step further by giving you meaningful decisions that influence your adventure. Even within this framework, choice matters as builds, abilities, weapons, and exploration all play a role. These are Metroidvanias where those choices play a bigger role than is typical of the genre.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unsighted includes a game mechanic that makes choice one of its most important features. Characters, including yours, are all on a time limit before they disappear, or become “unsighted”. Your time can be extended thanks to meteor dust, a limited resource that forces you to decide who gets to live and who has to die.

Diungkapkan bahwa this turns resource management into a moral dilemma, particularly because your decisions have consequences beyond individual character interactions. It's a clever way of making your decisions feel important without relying exclusively on dialogue options or branching cutscenes. Saving certain NPCs can preserve access to shops, quests, and useful items, while allowing others to become unsighted can permanently change what you have access to. Every time you discover a new character, you have another difficult decision to make on the horizon.

Sebagaimana diketahui, death’s gambit: afterlife has a lot of rpg elements with a strong metroidvania influence, which puts it in an awkward in-between category. It features multiple endings, with some of the most important decisions tied to your encounters with Death and Thalamus. But, because of this, choice is more important here than is typical of Metroidvanias. Depending on your progression and the decisions you make during the adventure, you'll have opportunities to pursue different narrative outcomes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i particularly like games that connect rpg mechanics to storytelling in this way. Rather than treating character development as something that exists independently of the main narrative, Death's Gambit: Afterlife makes your progression part of the decision-making process.

Berdasarkan laporan, nine sols is already great if you're looking for a challenging metroidvania that comes with a good story. It also goes the extra mile by making the relationships that you develop throughout the game incredibly relevant, and unlocks a different ending.

If Dark Souls left you drowning in an indescribable emptiness, these are the 10 best 2D Souls-Likes to resurface and drown again.

Berdasarkan laporan, you’ll encounter several characters who join you at the four seasons pavilion, most notably shuanshuan and shennong. Completing these quests, alongside other optional discoveries, is necessary to unlock the game's Shooting Star Ending, also known as the True Ending. Both these characters introduce questlines that require you to invest time in helping them. Having a reason to invest in a game’s characters, beyond it being its own reward, is an example of game design done well, and it means that the ending you get is influenced by the choice you make to invest in them.

Berdasarkan laporan, blasphemous 2 is a particularly good example of a metroidvania that rewards you for looking beyond its main storyline. While exploring Cvstodia, you'll encounter numerous optional challenges, hidden collectibles, and characters with their own stories to uncover.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some of these discoveries are particularly important if you want to unlock the game's true ending. What's interesting is that you can technically reach the final encounter without completing any of the side objectives. It makes the choice to explore and complete side quests more important, and neglecting them means getting the less satisfactory ending. However, doing so means missing out on an entirely different conclusion.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of salt and sanctuary’s more interesting mechanics involves the different creeds you can pledge allegiance to throughout the game. Creeds offer different benefits, resources, and services, meaning your allegiance can influence how you approach progression. Choosing to follow one Creed over another can affect which items and services are available to you, while interacting with rival sanctuaries can have consequences of their own.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can also choose how to develop your character, with an extensive skill tree and a wide variety of weapons, armour, and spells allowing you to experiment with different builds. While its choices are more closely tied to character progression and faction allegiance than branching narrative decisions, Salt and Sanctuary still gives you plenty of opportunities to change your adventure based on your choices.

Diungkapkan bahwa vigil: the longest night is another dark fantasy metroidvania that takes inspiration from soulslike games and salt and sanctuary. You play as Leila, a warrior tasked with investigating the strange events affecting her homeland. As you explore, you'll encounter characters who have their own problems, motivations, and quests to complete.

From classics like Teslagrad to modern gems like Blasphemous, these are ten Metroidvania franchises that should come back in 2027.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one vigil’s more interesting aspects is how its optional content encourages you to investigate the circumstances surrounding the people you encounter. The game also features multiple endings, giving you additional reasons to investigate its mysteries and pursue optional content. Rather than simply following the main storyline, you can spend time helping NPCs and uncovering additional information about the world. There’s a lot of character and environmental story here, and your experience is largely shaped by your decisions.

Berdasarkan laporan, ender lilies: quietus of the knights is a particularly atmospheric metroidvania that follows lily, a young priestess attempting to uncover the truth behind a devastating plague known as the blight. As you explore the ruined kingdom, you'll encounter the spirits of fallen warriors who can help Lily in combat. Each spirit has its own abilities, allowing you to experiment with different combinations and develop a combat style that suits your preferences, bringing choice into play.

Berdasarkan laporan, alongside its gameplay, choice also plays a big part in its endings, with three possible outcomes. The best outcome involves thoroughly exploring and finding all seven Stone Tablet Fragments, which allows you to craft the Liminant Aegis Curio, an artifact that protects Lily. It neatly ties together narrative with exploration, and gives more incentive for exploration.

Diungkapkan bahwa infernax is one of the best examples of a metroidvania where your decisions have consequences. This is because of a morality system, which always makes a game that is influenced by your choices. The morality system is determined by how you choose to help the people of your kingdom. Infernax gives you multiple options with how to deal with situations, and with both noble and selfish options available.

Diungkapkan bahwa in addition to affecting your alignment, your choices also determine which ending you’ll receive. Infernax is a fantastic example of a game that gives you the freedom to shape your character's journey.

#1001. 10 Must-Play Co-Op Games for People With Real-Life Schedules

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Must-Play Co-Op Games for People With Real-Life Schedules

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/co-op-games-real-life-schedules/

One level, one mission, or one long weekend.

Berdasarkan laporan, picture this: it’s thursday at 7:42 p. And often, you simply don’t have a lot of time or headspace to give. m. There’s a problem, though: Many of today’s most popular co-op games ask a lot of their players. You finally have two friends in the same voice call. Someone’s cat is walking across their keyboard, and a third friend is still stuck in a meeting, but you’re here, and you’re ready to game. You need a co-op game that fits the time and energy you and your squad actually have.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, good news: plenty of those exist. These 10 co-op games for people with real-life schedules run from lunch-break pick-me-ups to month-long game-night commitments. The only boss fight left is making sure nobody reschedules at the last minute.

Sebagaimana diketahui, four cooks, one cramped workspace, and a plate nobody remembered to wash: if you’re looking for catharsis outside of your own kitchen, put this game on the menu. Up to four players can cook together locally or online. Overcooked! All You Can Eat bundles both of the original games along with extra content — delivering 191 campaign and Kevin levels, plus 17 Versus levels, so you can clear one kitchen or a dozen and stop whenever real life calls. Expect your team’s communication skills to fall apart around the first conveyor belt, and plan on whoever drops the plates buying the next round of snacks.

Berdasarkan laporan, looking for a co-op game with no campaign to fall behind on? deep rock galactic has you covered. You play a dwarf miner dropped into procedurally generated caves alongside up to three friends. Six hazard levels let you match the difficulty to however tired everyone is. You mine what you came for, then race back to the escape pod while the cave fights back. Missions come in three lengths, so a weeknight can mean a short run and a free weekend can mean a longer session. And, if nobody’s free to join, you can hone your skills by doing a solo run with a drone named Bosco. The four classes available in this game — Gunner, Scout, Driller, and Engineer — give everyone a job. Leave no dwarf behind, at least until the escape pod is full.

Diungkapkan bahwa what if you and your co-op partner want to play together, but still have your own screens and little tasks to focus on? we were here forever builds a game around that question. In it, two players escape a castle while mostly separated, each holding different clues and sharing them over push-to-talk radios, so you win by describing what you see and listening to your partner. This setup works very well for friends in different cities or for people who would rather not stress out over a busy screen. If your partner bails, in-game matchmaking can pair you with a stranger, though you’ll lose the opportunity for inside jokes and familiar banter.

Berdasarkan laporan, orbitals sends maki and omura far into space to save their home in a co-op adventure styled after early ’90s anime. About half the game is platforming and puzzles on foot, and the rest happens on their ship, where one player pilots while the other mans the turrets.

Sebagaimana diketahui, each player wields one tool at a time, and the puzzles make you talk things out…which, for better or for funnier, does make this game double as a test of how well you and your partner communicate under pressure. It’s co-op only, so you never have to decide whether to play solo, and it can be short enough to finish in a single long sitting.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Diungkapkan bahwa the shield is down. Someone’s manning the wrong cannon. Every section gives you a boss battle. Each randomly generated level has you rescuing imprisoned animals or surviving waves of increasingly dangerous enemies. Wait, what? Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime puts you and up to three friends in charge of a neon battleship in a galaxy menaced by the forces of Anti-Love. A kidnapped space bunny needs rescuing. The ship has eight rooms with different jobs — so get ready for an evening of yelling about who’s on which station with your crew. This one doesn’t have network support, so save it for local matches with partners, roommates, and siblings home for the holidays.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a way out hands you one half of a prison break, and gives the other half to your partner. Even better: the Friend’s Pass system lets you invite a friend to play even if they don’t own it. (Both players do need to be on the same type of platform, and console players will need an active PlayStation Plus or Game Pass Core subscription for online functionality, so make a note to check that before game night. Sebagaimana diketahui, calvin and hobbes wasn't bill watterson's first pitch for a comic strip. C&H's protagonists began as side characters in Watterson's comic The Doghouse before his original syndicate suggested that they ought to be the focus. "Marvin" became "Calvin," the rest of The Doghouse's cast was dropped, and while United Feature Syndicate still didn't take the resulting comic, Universal Press Syndicate did.

Berdasarkan laporan, before then, watterson had drawn cartoons about a spacefaring character as early as college. Watterson went on to make that character the focus of one of his rejected comics: a mustachioed, cigar-smoking parody of adventurers like Flash Gordon. Shortly after Calvin and Hobbes began, Watterson reworked "Mort" into Calvin's fantasy alter ego Spaceman Spiff.

Sebagaimana diketahui, over the course of calvin and hobbes' run, spiff was one of calvin's most frequent escapist characters. Whenever Calvin was caught in a boring or unpleasant situation, he frequently retreated into his Spiff persona to pass time or even make a hasty retreat. In practice, that gave Watterson a handy excuse to take Calvin and Hobbes' art well outside its usual mundane setting, with tons of gross aliens, impossible landscapes, and great phrases like "eat hot electric death" that don't usually come up in everyday conversation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, much like the rest of calvin and hobbes, spaceman spiff really hit his stride in the comic's last three years, when watterson began doing his trademark "unbreakable" sunday strips. Some of the most colorful and evocative C&H comics are Spaceman Spiff adventures from the mid-'90s, but Spiff made a few solid appearances before that point. Here are some of our picks for the best Spaceman Spiff comics in Calvin and Hobbes.

Diungkapkan bahwa when calvin gets sick during his summer vacation, his first reaction is to get annoyed. Sick days are for the school year. I think we all can relate.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately for all involved, calvin's mom takes him to the doctor. That includes a checkup, an injection, and a retreat into Calvin's Spiff mode, as he imagines himself as a prisoner of aliens rather than a little kid trapped in an examination room.

Diungkapkan bahwa calvin's teacher mrs. Sometimes I want to see a version of C&H from her perspective. Wormwood catches a lot of strays in Spaceman Spiff cartoons. Most of her class are apparently boring normal kids who do the reading and don't get in unusual amounts of trouble. Wormwood and Mr. Then there's Calvin, who's as much of a chaos agent as a six-year-old can be. Mrs. Wilson from Dennis the Menace would have a lot to talk about.

Diungkapkan bahwa in this early installation, calvin gets called on in class and seamlessly incorporates mrs. (Look at those bug-men. Those are aliens that deserve the word "Hideous" being part of their proper noun. Wormwood's history question into his daydream. It's not being called on in class; it's being interrogated by the Hideous Zorgs of Planet X-13. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the most extreme (in the '90s sense) spaceman spiff adventure was a week-long story where calvin got deeply enough into character that he staged a breakout from elementary school. Called to the board to answer a math problem, Calvin instead decides to shoot his way out (with a rubber band), then run for the door.

Sebagaimana diketahui, through what one assumes is the relative indifference of school staff, calvin manages to make it all the way home before his mom catches him. Unfortunately, Spiff can't get Calvin out of the ensuing consequences.

Diungkapkan bahwa right from the start, bill watterson has said that one of his primary influences on calvin & hobbes is george herriman's golden age newspaper comic krazy kat, which ran from 1913 to 1944. It’s not dead media yet, though, as historians and preservationists have made a point of keeping collections of Krazy Kat in print. That was already some inside baseball in the 1980s when Calvin and Hobbes was new, as Krazy Kat’s modern following is almost exclusively made up of historians, fanatics, and other cartoonists. Curious readers can check out Fantagraphics' George Herriman Library hardcover collections, which are still in print at time of writing.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you check out krazy kat, its influence on calvin and hobbes is obvious immediately, particularly in its colored sunday comics. Herriman's characters inhabited a cartoonish version of the Arizona desert, and many of Watterson's Spaceman Spiff strips feature him visiting alien planets with similar arid backgrounds. This largely-wordless strip from 1993 is a perfect example, with so much of it devoted to Calvin's imagined spaceship journey from an alien valley to home.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the best spaceman spiff strips comes in the last year of calvin and hobbes. Without dialogue, we see the entire comic from Calvin's perspective, as he's entertaining himself during yet another boring class by imagining himself behind the stick of Spiff's flying saucer.

Berdasarkan laporan, suddenly, mrs. Wormwood interrupts his daydream and breaks his train of thought. As soon as she isn't paying attention anymore, Calvin switches to a new scenario: this time, he's a dinosaur stalking prey.

#1006. The Sunday Papers

The Sunday Papers

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/the-sunday-papers-836

The Sunday Papers is our weekly roundup of great writing about (mostly) videogames from across the web.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while following a peculiar trail of silver and saffron leaves around the largest roots of the treehouse, you come across a hexagonal wooden door lying half-hidden among ivy and moss. What mystery is here? You turn the brass knob – strange, it is warm! – and the engraving of the newspaper flutters. Scraping away the dirt, you discover a faint, absurd engraving of a newspaper. The pages turn faster and faster, emitting a howling gale that bowls you head over foot. When you pick yourself up, you are inside a vast attic full of books and bricabrac, lit from one side by windows that offer no view of the outside world – just light and mist.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tarnation! you have been lured into the eternal prison of sunday afternoon. Fortunately, there are several ways to escape. Each of the arcane objects before you is secretly a portal, transporting you to another site of arcane activity, in a bizarre web of diversions that cannot possibly reflect the hand of a human curator. Which will you choose?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as you step forward, your toe nudges an ornamental scroll. It growls and wriggles like a panicking caterpillar, scooting away under a table. Before you lose sight of it, you discern the title and subject of the text – it's an essay by Kyle Tam about the yokai of Promised Mascot Agency.

Diungkapkan bahwa deep in a drawer, you discover a sour-smelling binder full of extracts from an ancient and all but indecipherable dispute over the discovery of "generative ai" in something called "big walk". Here is Mike Cook arguing that "what's happening is not unusual, it's not extreme, it's not unfair and it's not a 'public flogging'. Here is Bruno Diaz noting in passing that "one of the harms of the 'AI' political project is the propaganda machine dedicated to making you feel stupid and helpless. " Here is a professorial interjection from Brendan Keogh calling on the warring parties to recognise when "critiques of generative AI are actually just deflected critiques of the capitalist relations of technology and labour". The stakes are long-buried, but many of the individual pieces of writing are lively. " Here is a ticker tape message from Hannah Nicklin observing that "if your radical position doesn’t have room for transformation it will not be safe until it contains just you".

Diungkapkan bahwa a footnote in the same dusty sheaf of papers points you towards another work from mike cook in a different drawer. This one consists of neon slides, slotted into an antique View-Master, and explores a comparison between procedural generation and street photography.

Berdasarkan laporan, peering at the weirdly white and opaque windowpanes, you realise there are intricate equations traced in the condensation. It appears to be a post-mortem for a "post-cosy" game called Danchi Days, in which developer Melos Han-Tani discusses wishlist conversion rates and the problem of not fitting neatly into any recognisable genre.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a snowglobe stands on a mantelpiece, the flakes still orbiting a miniature washtub as though the object had been recently shaken, even though the chamber has clearly been abandoned for decades. Instead, you are almost deafened by a screeching guitar chord. You put it to your ear, anticipating the faint jingle of Xmas bells. Here is Erin Keane to explain.

Diungkapkan bahwa next to the snowglobe on the mantelpiece, there's a souvenir shop conch shell, polished to a high sheen. You put that to your ear, hoping to catch the soothing shuffle of surf on shingle, and a disembodied voice tells you to piss off. Tim Sniffen has some thoughts about gentrification, and why only he should be allowed to do it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, again, one of these mystic artefacts hides the key to your release from the suffocating stillness of sunday afternoon. Which will you choose? Or have you, perhaps, brought a sorcerous teleportation device of your own? Please share. Here is Joanna Newsom's Cosmia to help you think.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at long last, the transfer of power is complete. Dune: Awakening, Funcom's ambitious survival MMO based on the classic sci-fi novel, has completed is pivot away from massive multiplayer, and can now be played fully offline.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the offline function arrived in an otherwise unremarkable patch that mainly fixes specific bugs and technical issues. "It's not possible to play the game in single-player mode without requiring an Internet connection at any point," Funcom revealed in a Steam post. This includes "creating and deleting single-player characters. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa dune: awakening has been gradually drifting away from being a purely multiplayer experience for some time. At that point, single-player still required an Internet connection. A fully fledged single-player mode arrived in September, including a dramatic rework of several major endgame systems—like its dynamic political "Landsraad" system' to make them work in solo play. In April, Funcom made its PvP element, like the Deep Desert and shipwreck exploration, fully optional. Now though, that's no longer the case.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to be clear, dune: awakening can still be played with all its multiplayer and pvp trappings, now including a "go online" button for exactly that purpose. competitive multiplayer experiences toward smaller, cooperative communities. Nonetheless, it's been a fascinating shift in direction, one that, alongside games like Marathon, embodies a broader apparent trend away from large-scale. Whether with friends or alone, players increasingly want to be able to live in their own worlds, unbothered by the wider, more tumultuous encounters of the open Internet.

Diungkapkan bahwa whether this is a positive shift is up for debate—encounters with strangers on the internet can provide highs as well as lows—but it's certainly an interesting one. Either way, offline mode isn't the end of Dune: Awakening's journey. A new expansion is coming in December, one that lets players explore Arrakis' frozen poles in a radically different scenario from the base game. Funcom appears to be in it for the long term with Awakening too, having recently pivoted to focusing purely on support for it and its other multiplayer survival game Conan: Exiles.
