#1010. 7 Best Things About the Original Xbox That Aren't Halo, Ranked

📅 15 Nov 2026

7 Best Things About the Original Xbox That Aren't Halo, Ranked

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/xbox-retrospective-best-things-besides-halo/

Diungkapkan bahwa when microsoft entered the console market with its xbox brand, people outside the company didn’t necessarily have high hopes. Throughout the 1990s, the industry was dominated by Japanese hardware companies like Nintendo, Sega, and Sony. But Microsoft meant business, and its first console effort provided some excellent reasons to give the brand a chance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the best reasons to own an xbox was undoubtedly halo: combat evolved, with a compelling first-person campaign and a multiplayer mode that kept people busy for dozens or even hundreds of hours. Bungie’s sci-fi epic shifted a lot of hardware units, but it wasn’t the only reason for players to be excited. Here are seven of the best things about the original Xbox that aren’t Halo.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the xbox came out during a difficult time for sega. The company had just ended an unfortunate string of hardware failures that concluded with the death of the Dreamcast, its final console. That platform had offered all sorts of great games, but they didn’t connect with wide audiences because everyone was too focused on the PlayStation 2, which offered a built-in DVD player that made it a particularly attractive prospect.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, microsoft offered sega a way to present its own vision for a console future without devoting all of its resources to challenging hardware. A string of terrific Sega titles hit the Xbox during its early years, and Microsoft promoted them aggressively, from Jet Set Radio Future to Sega GT 2002 and even more niche affairs like Gun Valkyrie. That support persisted throughout the console’s life, and also produced Panzer Dragoon Orta, one of the very finest games on the system.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, commercial tie-ins weren’t huge news by the time burger king released a series of three video games near the end of the xbox life-cycle. They had been around for some time, particularly during the Atari 2600 era. In 1983, Chase the Chuck Wagon even built a game around a dog chasing a wagon, which consumers obtained by sending in UPC labels clipped from bags of Purina dog food.

Sebagaimana diketahui, burger king brought that convention back with sneak king, pocketbike racer, and big bumpin’. At the time, Burger King advertised heavily in print and on TV with its creepy “king” character, who featured in each of the games. To get a copy, players paid a small fee while placing an order for a value meal. The games worked on both the original Xbox and the newer 360, a cross-generation wonder that people have largely forgotten.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, players naturally associate microsoft with halo, which it published on behalf of bungie. Fable, from Lionhead Studios, kicked off another successful franchise that’s scheduled to return early in 2027 with a reboot from Playground Games. But the giant publisher also took chances on less conventional fare during the era.

Diungkapkan bahwa one such game was kung fu chaos, which offered a parody of ‘70s b-movie chaos. In a slapstick fighting brawler along the lines of Power Stone, players survived perilous environments and talked trash to their opponents until one fighter emerged the victor. The edgy humor doesn’t hold up well today, but plenty of players had fun with it at the time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, other unusual releases from the time included phantom dust, a deck builder with 3d arena battles, and voodoo vince. The latter was a platformer featuring a voodoo doll roaming New Orleans. To harm enemies, he had to inflict damage on himself through dangerous maneuvers, like setting himself on fire. Players never knew quite what to expect from Microsoft Game Studios at the time, and it was wonderful.

Sebagaimana diketahui, first released on nov. 15, 2001, the original Xbox missed the ‘90s by only a little bit. As it helped define the 2000s gaming scene, it did so with help from one powerful component: the hard drive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, players suddenly had a lot of space to store their game saves. They could install them directly to the device, no longer relying on separate memory cards. If they preferred, they could also rip audio CDs to the drive and then play their favorite titles accompanied by their favorite music. You haven’t lived until you’ve played Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball while Creed, Nickelback, and Avril Lavigne croon in the background.

Berdasarkan laporan, unlike today, when a required install for a game like grand theft auto 6 can eat up roughly a third of your available space on a playstation 5, the original xbox supported large libraries without flinching. That made it an especially good time to be an Xbox fan.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, formerly known as tehkan, the game publisher that became tecmo (and later koei tecmo) published its first original console game on the famicom in 1986. Traditionally a Japanese publisher, the company nevertheless made a name for itself in North America, thanks in large part to the classic Ninja Gaiden series.

Diungkapkan bahwa unexpectedly, tecmo threw considerable support behind the xbox hardware, and with excellent results. Ninja Gaiden (later released in an expanded form as Ninja Gaiden Black) became one of the hardware’s biggest successes. Tecmo also brought over the excellent Dead or Alive fighting game series, which felt like the perfect match for Microsoft’s powerful system. The beautiful environments and the detailed fighters within them provided ample eye candy to remind players that console gaming had come a long way since the 8-bit figures they remembered stomping on turtles only a decade prior.

Graphics were still a huge differentiator, and Tecmo was arguably the era’s developer that did the most to prove the Xbox was a graphical powerhouse.

Berdasarkan laporan, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Diungkapkan bahwa console gaming had a certain feel to it by the time the xbox arrived, and microsoft quickly pushed some boundaries. Today, many games release on PC alongside their console counterparts, but that wasn’t the case back in 2001, when Xbox began building bridges across some of the biggest gaps.

Diungkapkan bahwa on xbox, we got to see some games that surprised us, like the elder scrolls 3: morrowind, star wars: knights of the old republic, and even sid meier’s pirates. Microsoft also published versions of the original Fable across the two platforms, and the role-playing epic felt just right on both. And MechAssault made a big splash when Xbox Live launched, proving the power of the hardware to provide compelling online play experiences.

Berdasarkan laporan, the dreamcast deserves credit for making some early efforts in the same arena, but the xbox stuck the landing. In the process, it set Microsoft up to enjoy the even more successful generation that followed with the Xbox 360.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by the time the xbox came around, the strong relationship between rare and nintendo had soured enough that the time was ripe for someone else to swoop in and acquire the most storied software developer in twycross, england. Microsoft saw the opportunity and went for it.

Berdasarkan laporan, although it has failed to capitalize on the rare acquisition the way people once thought it might, microsoft did acquire some early gems in the years before sea of thieves. The latter served as one of the final Microsoft releases on its first console. Grabbed by the Ghoulies and Conker: Live & Reloaded both launched on the original Xbox. A remake of the surprisingly vulgar Nintendo 64 classic, it provided not only a visual overhaul of the single-player campaign, but multiplayer modes that kept players busy fragging each other for hours at a time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, most of rare’s post-nintendo triumphs came during the xbox 360 era, but its earliest efforts on the original xbox are solid games that hold up reasonably well today. They didn’t exactly set the world on fire, but they’re fun to revisit even now. You can still acquire them on the Xbox Store today, and they’re well worth a look.

Diungkapkan bahwa disc-to-digital is either a genuine players-first initiative or a swipe at sony. Either way, I'll take it.

Diungkapkan bahwa we want to hear from you. Share your perspective in the comments below, and please keep the conversation respectful.

A new studio overseen by "key members" of the Chronicles team will finish the historical strategy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in late october, chronicles: medieval developer raw power games announced that it was in trouble. Funding for its ambitious, historical sandbox strategy had suddenly been pulled, and as a result the studio was at "real risk of closing". But it turns out the situation was even more dire than the announcement suggested, as Raw Power Games declared bankruptcy on the same day.

Despite this, development of Chronicles: Medieval will continue with at least some of its original creators involved, after Satisfactory developers Coffee Stain swooped in to purchase the assets and IP.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a press release, coffee stain said that it submitted the winning bid in raw power's sale process following the company's bankruptcy, paying 36. 75 million Danish Krone (around $5. 42 million) for Chronicles: Medieval's intellectual property.

Berdasarkan laporan, rather than acquire the assets directly, however, coffee stain will transfer them directly to a "newly established company" that is owned 75% by coffee stain, and 25% by "a small group of key members of the game's original development team. " Alongside paying full purchase price for Chronicles: Medieval's assets, Coffee Stain will also fund the continued development of the game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a statement, coffee stain ceo anton westbergh said that "chronicles: medieval made a strong impression at its reveal at summer game fest last year. " He also explained that "Things have been moving fast around this deal, and our short-term focus will be on working out how best to complete the game, together with the new company's management team. We're happy to step in and help bring it to players after the recent developments in Copenhagen. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, chronicles: medieval is in the top 30 most wishlisted games on steam, higher than the likes of guild wars 3, atomic heart 2, and the upcoming mass effect-like exodus, so it's clear why this was an attractive proposition for coffee stain. Presumably, Coffee Stain will seek to transfer as many people from Raw Power as they can, given they've been working on the game for years and therefore understand it intimately. What isn't clear from all this is how this affects Raw Power's existing staff. But there's nothing in Coffee Stain's statement that confirms this.

Diungkapkan bahwa according to its steam page, chronicles: medieval is still slated for an early access release in 2027, but it isn't clear at this juncture whether the acquisition will affect this. In its press release, Coffee Stain states that "further information about the plans for the game, including the release timeline, will be communicated through the game’s own channels in due course. ".

#1017. Stardew Valley Meets Night in the Woods in One of 2026's Scariest New Games

📅 15 Nov 2026

Stardew Valley Meets Night in the Woods in One of 2026's Scariest New Games

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/village-in-the-shade-new-farm-sim-horror-game/

Sebagaimana diketahui, i thought i knew what to expect from village in the shade after attending nis america's pre-launch preview event in september. The villagers would be quirky but likeable, and things would probably get at least a little twisted, though nothing too terrible. Nippon Ichi Software's non-Disgaea games get pretty dark, as do the Labyrinth games and Yomawari. But they're dark on a small-scale, personal level, and rarely do they have something poignant to say. Village in the Shade tossed all my expectations out the window within the first few hours and, since then, has quickly rocketed up my list of the year's best games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, village in the shade starts with a child frolicking in the fields, running through dappled woods, skipping over rivers, and doing normal kid stuff. Something did happen, though. Not that the idea brought anyone joy. The local carpenter and a hunter find the child, who happens to bear a striking resemblance to a kid who vanished years ago. Then they fall down a hole and die, or so you'd think from the amount of blood on-screen, except they climb out and start walking again like nothing happened. They seem worried, actually, but Rin, the de facto mayor of Kagatsu Village, decides the child may be of use.

Diungkapkan bahwa rin initially seems like a tom nook caricature. But NIS had something much more interesting in mind, which became evident the next in-game day when Rin threw a baby goat down the village well as an offering. There's a bit of subtle commentary from her about min-maxing supposedly relaxing games to get the most out of them, and I thought this poke at established cozy staples would be the extent of Rin's personality. One life out of the village in exchange for another life in. She's fixated on profit and productivity, stuffs you in a ratty little hovel, charges you for it, and decides your value based on how much you do for the community. Balance must be maintained.

Berdasarkan laporan, it likely comes as no surprise to hear this following a sentence that includes the words "threw a baby goat down the well," but kagatsu village is a weird place. Their families lived at the foot of this mountain for generations. A good quarter of the people who live there agree with that assessment. Even so, they don’t seem to have much of a choice but to stay and deal with it. Leaving would be tantamount to betrayal of everyone past and present, and who knows what might happen then?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rin and kagatsu village under her rule are the epitome of toxic communalism. As long as the collective is intact and moving forward, every sacrifice is permissible. You're also not supposed to pry into anyone's affairs or share their secrets, no matter how upset they are or whether they're gathering poison as part of a murder plot. She's sincere in her dogged determination to put the village first — frighteningly so at times — but either overlooks or just plain doesn't understand the harm of ignoring the individual. Part of Kagatsu's code is that every favor must be met with appropriate compensation, which is great for people with mercenary dispositions. It’s less great if you just want to help a friend out with no strings attached. And mandatory.

Diungkapkan bahwa the most common sacrifice is a monthly fee, like a tax, though to rin's intense frustration, people tend to get around it. Those with nothing to give, or who flat-out refuse to give anything, are taken to the local clinic where the doctor draws a rather alarming amount of blood. Blood figures quite prominently in Village in the Shade. There's the monthly offering, of course, along with a spate of serial killings 10 years in the past — around the time you disappeared from the village, in what's surely a totally normal coincidence. Others give food or necessary items. Some perform a service. On some nights, one of the bridges leading to the center of town is covered in blood.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm a coward and haven't ventured beyond the bridge on those nights, so i don't know why the blood is there yet. The rest of the hauntings are not. Untold horrors slither down the mountain and haunt the streets and alleys, and dealing with them is much more nerve-wracking than I originally thought. Village in the Shade uses a drumming sound like a heartbeat and a tremor effect on the screen when danger approaches, and they increase in intensity the closer you get to the source of it. The preview session showed the very first haunted incident, a linear segment where the ghost of an old man chases you through the village. It was pretty tame. That, plus a general lack of defensive capabilities and places to hide, is enough to get the adrenaline going during evening wanderings. Nighttime is dangerous in Kagatsu Village. Stealth and bloody death were not on my bingo card when I started this game, and the intensity of these moments — plus just how at odds they are with the sedate daytime routine — make them standouts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the "weird rural place with a terrible past" and its critiques on collectivism aren't entirely uncommon in japanese media. Ryukishi07's Higurashi: When They Cry springs to mind as one of the stronger examples of it, and, more recently, there's The Summer Hikaru Died and even Nintendo's Emio — The Smiling Man. The concept is typically reserved for anime or visual novels, though, and I've yet to come across a good example of the storytelling style in more interactive media. Who'd have thought a farm-sim could make the perfect fit for it? Certainly not me.

Berdasarkan laporan, but it does, and even the calm routine surprised me. Village in the Shade holds little back at the start and throws a lot of crop variety, processing machines, and progress at you. Most farming games in the last decade have done very little to shake up the daily chores, and even Stardew Valley followed a pattern familiar from old Harvest Moon games. I'd upgraded my tools once by the first summer, reached level 50 of the mine, and harvested enough spring crops to get them all to silver rank in quality.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's not too easy, though, and nis didn't skimp on the farming just to facilitate storytelling. Crop-producing trees had a section all to themselves. There were flower fields for producing honey, flowers for selling, and a smaller plot for gift flowers. In that first summer, I divided my fields (plural, as I bought a second one with my springtime earnings) into planned segments. The furrowed vegetables — Village in the Shade lets you alternate between tillage and furrows to encourage faster growth for some species — had a section all to themselves, just because uniformity looked nice.

Berdasarkan laporan, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Diungkapkan bahwa while i hadn't created rice paddies yet, that didn't stop me from spending thousands of yen on seedlings while the store had them in stock, and i created a special bed of edamame beans that i'd let ripen into autumn for a soybean harvest. Meanwhile, at the other end of the homestead plot sat my beehives, smelters, smithing station, mayonnaise maker, and pickling barrels. I had full access to cows, ducks, chicken, horses, and sheep despite being early in the game, too.

Berdasarkan laporan, and all of this is for the good of the village. Well, assuming there's enough people left to live there when the future arrives. With more crops, more money, and more goods, you can fulfill more requests and improve Kagatsu, giving it a better chance at surviving into the future. Regardless of how things play out, I'm frankly astonished at just how well Village in the Shade tells its story and wraps it around familiar farm-sim routines. As we head into the twilight of 2026, this one definitely deserves a spot on the lists of the year's best games.

Grave Seasons captures the terror of small-town living.

Sebagaimana diketahui, moira brown gets a bad rap. That means she puts you in harm's way quite a lot, which many players hate her for. Fallout 3's most chipper NPC, the Minnesotan menace is an inventor who sends you out on fact-finding missions to investigate the many dangers of the Wasteland. Others just hate her voice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think her positive outlook makes a refreshing change of pace from, you know, everything else going on in fallout 3. Plus she gives you an armored Vault suit just for starting her questline, and the Wasteland Survival Guide she writes with your help goes on to be a useful item in both New Vegas and Fallout 4.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what i'm saying is, there are plenty of videogame questgivers much more annoying than moira brown. All of the ones below, for starters. And if you disagree, you're a big meanie.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rockstar loves to make us sit through cutscenes where our protagonist agrees to help out some of the most annoying people alive. Zero isn't alone—in GTA: San Andreas, he's got wannabe MC/janitor OG Loc for competition—but he is the winner for absolute worst.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zero's the owner of a remote-control car shop at war with a rival called berkley. He's a shrill parody nerd who shrieks dialogue like, "Curse you, Berkley, curse you!" Zero's most annoying mission is Supply Lines, where you pilot a model biplane to shoot Berkley's delivery drivers. The flying controls in San Andreas are terrible enough on their own (the fact it makes you complete pilot school as an unskippable part of the plot is a hate crime), but in Supply Lines you also have to cope with a limited fuel gauge that drops like a stone if you dare to use the accelerator.

Zero's excited yelling during this mission is so bad even David Cross, who voiced Zero, called it "the most annoying voice you could ever imagine" and has never finished the mission himself.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "ignore the main questline, stick to the sidequests. " This is good advice when you're playing Oblivion, if you mean "stick to the Thieves Guild, Dark Brotherhood, Daedric Shrines, Shivering Isles, and Fighters Guild," because if you take it to include the Mages Guild questline, it becomes bloody terrible advice.

Berdasarkan laporan, the most frustrating faction in oblivion, the mages demand you travel to every guildhouse in cyrodiil to earn a recommendation from each before you can join. Many of the Mages use these recommendations as a way to extort tedious favors from acolytes like yourself, such as clearing a dungeon of boring old zombies, or they involve you in silly pranks like stealing spellbooks. It's tough to pick who is the most obnoxious, but my vote goes to Falcar.

Diungkapkan bahwa falcar sends you to retrieve a missing ring. You find his body still submerged in the well. The ring's down a well, but turns out to be enchanted so it has an encumbrance of 150, which the previous acolyte couldn't lift. Someone drowned because of how much of a dick Falcar is.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can drag the ring out of the well yourself, if you clear some space in your inventory and maybe drink some potions, but that turns out to be pointless. By the time you emerge from the well, Falcar's done a runner because he was secretly a necromancer this whole time. Shame his quest isn't about uncovering that, which might have been interesting, but is instead a literal fetch quest.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before the battinson movie reskinned the riddler as gotham's version of the zodiac killer, the character was at a low point. The Arkham series saw him transform from preppy to shabby as Batman outsmarted him again and again, and by the time Arkham Knight rolled around he'd been reduced to an oily mechanic crafting racetracks to test the Batmobile, in between making Catwoman walk across his deathtraps.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's bad enough, but you still have to collect his trophies scattered across the city and solve "amusingly taxing" riddles by taking photos as well, and if you don't 100% all the tedious challenges he throws at you you're not allowed to see the game's "real" ending. Thanks, Arkham Knight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you're probably familiar with flyting, the medieval poetic boasting often compared to rap battles, thanks to its use in assassin's creed valhalla. It was referenced a year earlier in Rune 2, but a lot less people played Rune 2.

Sebagaimana diketahui, human head's last game (and there's a story there), the viking action-adventure features some truly terrible npcs. Chief among them is Rider the Miner, who speaks entirely in rhyme with the kind of overemphasized white-ass delivery that makes you expect "My name is Rider and I'm here to say…" at any second. Instead, what you get are lines like, "When I take off my shirt you'll see all the girls flirt / Though my work is to whittle, it's my stomach that's chiseled. " He's unemployed because the mine is closed, which I guess is why he's whittling? I don't know, man.

Sebagaimana diketahui, anyway, survive all his dogshit rapping and finally you find out he's got a quest for you. Does it involve the skalds, or the bardic tradition he's part of? No, he wants you to mine some ore. Don't bother coming up with a rhyme for that, Rider.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's a lot of filler in final fantasy 7 rebirth, but what makes it worse is how much of that filler is routed through chadley. This tedious little twerp who looks like he stepped out of the Village of the Damned appears on your wristscreen to narrate tower-climbing, lifesprings, photorelics, summons, combat challenges, and more. It feels like you can't take five steps without him squeaking "Cloud!" and making you drop everything for an update that could have been an email.

Diungkapkan bahwa then mai appears, a gender-flipped version of chadley who doubles the amount of dialogue you have to sit through. Instead of just having Chadley backseat driving every other sidequest, now there's a pair of squabbling siblings in the backseat who won't shut up. The third game should pull a Jar-Jar and dump Chadley straight down the memory hole, for all our sakes.

Berdasarkan laporan, the problem with preston is that he's surrounded by some of bethesda's best companions. Nick Valentine, Codsworth, Curie, John Hancock, cage-fighting Cait—compared to them, Preston's a personality-free zone. He's a Minuteman because he always wanted to be a Minuteman and his main function is to tell you when to clear out another settlement on behalf of the Minutemen.

Diungkapkan bahwa companions have an affinity score that can be raised and lowered based on your actions. He doesn't like cannibalism? Shocking. Preston's affinity goes down when you do typical bad stuff, like picking pockets, stealing, taking drugs, and indulging in cannibalism, and goes up when you help settlements (of course) and modify weapons. I can feel myself getting bored even writing that out. Give me Strong the Super Mutant any day.

Diungkapkan bahwa the vampire prince of los angeles, sebastian lacroix runs the city from an office so gaudy it's probably got a gold-plated toilet. He talks over you, bosses you around, and if you refuse to run errands for him, uses his vampire powers to dominate you into doing them anyway. (In a nice touch, you still get dialogue options but they all say the same thing. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, when he's not bossing you around, he's whining about how difficult it is being sebastian lacroix. "Each minor problem like a grain of sand," he moans, "each night I inherit the desert. " He doesn't even have the good grace to enjoy being rich and powerful and immortal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unlike most of the other questgivers in this list, he's not annoying because he gives you meaningless missions or wastes your time or roadblocks the best ending, but because he's written that way. You're supposed to hate LaCroix for exactly the reasons you do.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jody's first computer was a commodore 64, so he remembers having to use a code wheel to play pool of radiance. com, whose cheques with the bunny logo made for fun conversations at the bank. Sony has revealed its PS Plus membership at all three tiers will be going on sale from tomorrow, 16th November, for two weeks.

However, if you've been paying attention to how Sony handles this promotion in the last few years, then you will already know what's coming: the discounted prices only apply to new sign-ups; current members won't have access to them.

Diungkapkan bahwa "players in participating countries who join playstation plus during playstation’s black friday promotion can save big on select memberships," sony clarifies in an updated playstation blog post. As it states, you have to "join" PS Plus during the Black Friday offer period to qualify, which lasts from 16th November to 30th November.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the only promotion open to current ps plus members is a subscription upgrade to ps plus premium. Anyone at the PS Plus Essential or PS Plus Extra tiers can upgrade to PS Plus Premium at a discounted rate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a tactic sony has utilised for years now — it has not let you extend a ps plus membership at the same tier for a very long time. Instead, the promotion once again only applies to PS5, PS4 owners joining PS Plus.

Berdasarkan laporan, in fact, this year, sony hasn't even revealed what the discount will be yet. Normally, the accompanying graphic tells you the sort of offers coming (usually 33% off), but the image above has nothing on it. We'll have to wait until tomorrow to find out what the PS Plus deal for Black Friday 2026 is.

#1021. Minecraft Is Officially Adding Throwing Discs, But Fans Want A Name Change

📅 15 Nov 2026

Minecraft Is Officially Adding Throwing Discs, But Fans Want A Name Change

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/minecraft-reveals-throwing-discs-fans-dont-like-the-name/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on november 14, at twitchcon, mojang unveiled a brand-new weapon for minecraft: the throwing disc. But fans aren't sold on the name.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "there are plenty of projectiles, like snow balls or the new ice balls, that are designed to be thrown," mojang explained. But what the name doesn’t suggest, or even imply, is that it returns after you throw it. And soon, there will be a brand new thing - the throwing disc! As the name suggests, this weapon is ranged. "And then there are other things, like an inventory full of granite that you can throw into your friend's chest and hope they don't open that particular one. Nifty! It doesn’t travel that far, but if you get it to ricochet off hard surfaces it can bounce and go a bit farther. ".

In 2025, Mojang added the spear - the first new tiered tool in 15 years.

Diungkapkan bahwa basically, it's an iron, bronze, gold, diamond, and netherite frisbee, but the name is a little uninventive. Throwing disc is exactly what it says on the tin, but it feels a little disjointed from spears, maces, and swords, when there are far better options out there. Already, there are calls from the community to "change it," with one popular suggestion being 'Chakram'— a circular throwing weapon that originated in India, featuring in ancient epics as a divine weapon. There's a lot more gravitas to a Chakram than a throwing disc, which sounds less like a weapon to dispatch zombies with and more like gym equipment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, others suggested genuinely calling it a frisbree, though as u/kind_lychee7221 said in their post calling for the change, that "doesn't sound very minecraft. " Also, it's trademarked. It sounds better, sure, but they aren't rings. "Chakram would be nice. Another popular idea being tossed around is 'discus'. So, again, it doesn't work. Flydisc is meh, it's not better than throwing disc. "Frisbee would be goofy as hell," u/-mosura commented. As a staunch Chakram defender (a position I took up literally just now), the Indian "steel wheels" look a lot closer to what Mojang envisioned, and frankly, they just sound cool. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some have argued that "a lot of people, especially kids, won't know what a 'chakram' is," and so throwing disc makes more sense because it's easily understood as a disc you throw. To counter that point, Minecraft is often used as an educational tool, and teaching people what a Chakram is, and possibly inspiring them to look into the weapon - and thus a slice of Indian history - would fit the game perfectly. I doubt I'm alone in learning what maces, halberds, trebuchets, and all sorts of Western medieval weaponry were solely because of video games and movies. Minecraft, as one of the most popular games in the world, could do the same for the Chakram.

If kids can figure out what netherite is, they'll manage just fine.

Berdasarkan laporan, calling them throwing discs also runs into a bit of a weird problem. Discs exist in Minecraft already as music discs, things you slot into a Jukebox, and they look nothing like these new weapons. Chakram would differentiate the two more cleanly.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mojang, if you're reading, at least consider it. Chakram is a way cooler name, and you might inspire kids to learn about Hindu epics and Sikh warriors, like the Akali Sikhs of Punjab. Throwing discs are just a bit. boring.

It's been a long time coming, but Minecraft is finally getting a brand-new dimension.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we want to hear from you. Share your perspective in the comments below, and please keep the conversation respectful.

#1022. 10 JRPGs Launching in 2027 You Should Keep on Your Radar

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 JRPGs Launching in 2027 You Should Keep on Your Radar

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/jrpgs-launching-in-2027-you-should-keep-on-your-radar/

Berdasarkan laporan, murillo zerbinatto is a jrpg enthusiast, writer, and editor. He has played over 300 RPGs during his gaming career, with 90% of them being JRPGs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the pandemic sure threw a wrench into many developers' plans, which was understandable. However, as soon as the situation began to normalize, many games that were delayed or suffered internal setbacks started getting revealed with official release dates. It feels like ever since 2023 we have been living through a run of great releases, with banger after banger.

Diungkapkan bahwa furthermore, jrpg fans have been well served since then. I, for one, would love some peace and downtime to just play casually, and I thought 2027 would bring that relief, but I was mistaken. A new title keeps coming out, whether from indie developers, veterans who left their former companies to start their own studios, or fresh remasters and remakes popping up. The year hasn't even begun, and my backlog is already clogging up again. Let us take a look at a few upcoming JRPGs in 2027 that you should definitely keep on your radar.

Which 2026 JRPGs are the best according to their Metascore?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, terranigma brings back a classic from the snes, a jrpg that formed part of the legendary quintet trilogy. It functions more as a direct port than a full remaster, but it remains extremely welcome nonetheless. Terranigma never originally launched in North America, only in Japan and Europe, meaning many players from back in the day never had the chance to experience this action RPG.

Diungkapkan bahwa in terranigma, we play as ark on a mission to restore earth. And by Earth, I mean our actual planet, as all the continents are based on real-world geography that we gradually bring back to life. To do this, Ark uses a real-time combat system driven by level-ups and spells you buy along the way. The most enjoyable aspect of Terranigma is witnessing the world-building sidequests unfold as you visit villages and restore them. It is a fantastic treat for anyone looking to revisit or experience a past JRPG gem through an official release.

Diungkapkan bahwa against all odds and to my utmost surprise, saga is becoming one of the longest-running and most sprawling series in the square enix catalog. I know it is unorthodox and not everyone enjoys its unconventional design, but I love seeing Square keeping the franchise alive, especially through its remakes. Following Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven, Square Enix is delivering a full remake of the third entry titled Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the remake will include similar enhancements to revenge of the seven, such as a revamped turn-based system that heavily emphasizes targeting enemy elemental weaknesses, while retaining core saga staples like glimmer mechanics and open-ended progression where players shape the narrative path. I don't know if it will be as brutally difficult as the original Romancing SaGa 3, which was notorious for softlocking players with its complex progression systems. Still, it will certainly be a feast for fans of the series.

Sebagaimana diketahui, continuing with upcoming remakes, atlus is bringing another project to the table: persona 4 revival. As the name implies, this is a ground-up remake of the fourth Persona entry, fully modernized with current-gen graphics, overhauled combat mechanics, a re-orchestrated soundtrack, new social activities, extra story events, and expanded dungeon crawling elements inside the TV World.

Diungkapkan bahwa the best part is being able to revisit what many consider the best persona game (a statement that could honestly apply to almost any entry in the franchise). Returning to the town of Inaba, we play as the canonically named student Yu Narukami. While keeping up with his daily routine of school life, part-time jobs, and social simulation, he will also need to unravel the mysteries of the TV World alongside fan-favorite Teddie.

Berdasarkan laporan, atelier is one of the longest-running jrpg series, with a fanbase more dedicated than a football club. While the overall narrative remains anthological across the franchise, Atelier is organized into distinct subseries. Following the Secret subseries featuring Atelier Ryza, we have the Memories subseries, which kicked off with Atelier Yumia and now continues with Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories.

Berdasarkan laporan, atelier karia continues the adventure in aladiss, this time venturing into the underground world of noctrem. This entry puts players in control of Karia, an amnesiac alchemist. Combat builds upon the real-time foundation established in Yumia, with Karia introducing a strategic layer that lets players pause combat to execute command skills or parry incoming enemy attacks. I won't say playing Atelier Yumia beforehand is strictly mandatory, but if you want full context, it might be the ideal route.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's no exaggeration to say that eternal anima is one of my most anticipated jrpgs of 2027. The game was unveiled during a Nintendo Direct, and while I initially fell in love with its charming pixel art, it first looked like just another solid indie release. That changed once I looked into the talent behind the project, including industry veterans like Kazushige Nojima, a legendary Final Fantasy writer, and director Katsuhisa Higuchi, who worked as a battle programmer on several Final Fantasy titles and directed Monster Hunter Stories 2.

Berdasarkan laporan, early previews for eternal anima are singing high praise, spotlighting its refreshing turn-based combat, its time-travel mechanics (a narrative trope i never get tired of), and how seamlessly both elements interlock. Combat features a mechanic called Future Sight that previews enemy moves, showing who they plan to target and the exact damage output, which elevates tactical planning and should be a joy to experiment with. The story follows Wade alongside an eclectic party gathered from different timelines. I will be sitting in the front row waiting for Eternal Anima.

If you loved Final Fantasy Resonance, then it's time for more JRPG love, Jobs, and pixel art.

Diungkapkan bahwa final fantasy vii revelation needs no introduction and stands as one of the world's most anticipated jrpgs of 2027. We can wait for The Game Awards to hand out the Most Anticipated Game trophy, and if Final Fantasy VII Revelation doesn't take it home, feel free to call me out in the comments. Serving as the conclusion to the Final Fantasy VII remake trilogy, it appears to have refined everything that made its predecessors spectacular, pushing combat, exploration, and player freedom to new heights.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, narratively, it will conclude the main arc, though whether it introduces major plot twists remains to be seen. As for traversal, with the Highwind at our disposal, Square Enix stated that world exploration is completely open, leaving route decisions entirely up to the player. Combat introduces two new playable party members, Vincent and Cid, along with the new FITs system, which acts like a Job framework to give each character a broader tactical arsenal. Certain regions will have higher level thresholds, nudging players to tackle them later, but the overall scope looks immensely promising. We do know the Weapons are present and look more imposing than ever. Final Fantasy VII Revelation, the year is yours.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we now shift to games targeted for 2027 that lack specific day-and-date release slots, which leaves them open to potential schedule shifts. That said, if one developer rarely delays its titles, it is Nintendo. Because of that track record, when Nintendo announced Xenoblade Genesis for 2027, I knew with confidence I would be playing it next year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, xenoblade genesis marks the latest chapter in the xenoblade saga. The reveal trailer omitted gameplay, focusing instead on narrative cutscenes that showcased story beats and main characters. Whether it functions as a direct narrative sequel to the Chronicles arc remains unconfirmed, but it continues under the direction of Monolith Soft and series creator Tetsuya Takahashi. The artistic direction initially drew mixed reactions from some fans for leaning closer to Fire Emblem than traditional Xenoblade, but I personally loved every bit of it, including the medieval aesthetic.

Sebagaimana diketahui, knowing monolith soft, xenoblade genesis will feature a colossal world, an overhauled battle system, unorthodox progression mechanics, and endless features that will sink hundreds of hours into this new universe. Did I mention Yoko Shimomura is composing the soundtrack? That alone means it's a fantastic time to update my Spotify playlists.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this new jrpg, players take control of asch and finé as they set out to prevent a world-ending catastrophe known as the lightfall. Rev. is an action RPG, but it features a tactical time-stop mechanic similar to Final Fantasy VII Remake, letting you pause combat to issue skill commands through a visually stylish menu. Noir. NOiR. Deep gameplay details remain sparse for now, but as mentioned, I'm choosing to trust the project and will be ready on day one once Rev. locks in its official release date.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here is another franchise that requires zero introduction. Pokémon Winds & Waves is being touted as the first truly high-fidelity graphical Pokémon title, which would certainly be a milestone achievement for Game Freak. Given its oceanic setting packed with islands and open seas, it has every tool required to expand the open-world framework of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet to unprecedented heights, complete with fresh traversal mechanics.

Diungkapkan bahwa no specifics have been revealed regarding the battle mechanics. For anyone jumping into Pokémon Winds & Waves, three traditional elemental starter companions await: the puppy Pombon, the gecko Gecqua, and the bean chick Browt. However, it will likely preserve the turn-based structure of its mainline predecessor while leaving real-time action gameplay to the Legends spinoff series. I will almost certainly end up picking Gecqua.

Diungkapkan bahwa i want to start by noting that, according to the developers and director tetsuya nomura himself, kingdom hearts iv will definitely launch in 2027 and won't face delays. Square Enix confirmed that internal development is progressing smoothly, setting up the long-awaited return of Sora's adventure in Quadratum, complete with new characters (along with returning faces for those who played the mobile entries) and a fresh selection of Disney worlds.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in terms of core design and gameplay structure, we can expect a polished take on the series' classic loop: sora travels from world to world, adapts to local rules, meets regional protagonists, and aids them in their struggles. It is a charming formula, and I would not have it any other way. Officially, only the world of Coco has been formally revealed, though a leak stemming from Steam achievements unveiled several others. I won't share those details here to keep you safe from spoilers, but if you want to look them up, do so at your own risk.

From Eternal Sonata to Triangle Strategy, revisit seven underrated JRPGs that launched near major blockbusters and struggled for attention.

#1023. Feed the Scorchpot serves up a dice-rolling roguelike where you cook for a dragon

📅 15 Nov 2026

Feed the Scorchpot serves up a dice-rolling roguelike where you cook for a dragon

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/feed-the-scorchpot/android-early-access/

Sebagaimana diketahui, feed the scorchpot is based on a rather simple deal - a dragon protects your island for twenty years, and in return, you cook it dinner for twenty years. The hand-drawn dice roguelike from husband-and-wife studio Moravian is out now in early access on Google Play, with an iOS version coming soon.

Diungkapkan bahwa each year, you roll dice to work the island, harvest ingredients, combine them into recipes and then cook them down in the scorchpot itself. If the meal isn’t up to scratch, then it’s been made fairly clear that you end up in the pot instead.

Diungkapkan bahwa all your strategizing happens on the island itself. You build farmsteads, shrines and harbours across a hex grid so they feed into one another, with more than 50 buildings and 80 recipes to unlock and upgrade, and the recipes boost your Flavor and Essence to multiply your Fodder score.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are over 20 types of dice to tune your tray with as well, including odd, even and coloured dice, plus one with a six on every face. Winning in fewer seasons gets you a bigger payoff, but every extra year brings harsher odds and a hungrier dragon, which occasionally throws a tantrum and sets fire to your board.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, comparisons have been made to balatro and slay the spire, which is a lot to live up to. Balatro showed there are plenty of people on phones happy to spend hours chasing silly scores, and Feed the Scorchpot is going about it sensibly by letting you start for free and unlock the rest with a single purchase.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can grab feed the scorchpot in early access from google play now. And if you were thinking just like I am, then yes, you can pet the dragon.

#1024. 15 Years Later, Jamie Lannister’s Best Game of Thrones Quote Is an All-Time Fantasy Hit

📅 15 Nov 2026

15 Years Later, Jamie Lannister’s Best Game of Thrones Quote Is an All-Time Fantasy Hit

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/jamie-lannisters-best-game-of-thrones-quote-is-an-all-time-fantasy-hit/

Jamie remains a fan-favorite for a reason.

Diungkapkan bahwa many factors have helped make george r. The eight-season adaptation brought Martin’s vast, stunning world and complex central characters to life. R. Weiss. B. Martin’s A Song of Ice and Fire one of the most beloved fantasy series of all time, and one big reason is HBO’s adaptation of the dark fantasy epic by showrunners David Benioff and D. Jaime Lannister, played by Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, was one such character. And like many others in Game of Thrones, he had poetic one-liners that captured his nature and helped define his place in the story over the years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unlike ned stark, whose blunt and severe demeanor left little room for elaborate remarks, jaime lannister seemed to have an arsenal of memorable quotes and cutting one-liners. His words reflected both his standing as Tywin Lannister’s beloved son and as Lord Commander of the Kingsguard, as well as the complicated reputation he carried throughout Westeros. To many, Jaime was a man without honor, and his sharp remarks often seemed to echo the way others judged him.

Diungkapkan bahwa with so many banger quotes from jaime, it’s tough to pick the best one. Still, we think we’ve narrowed it down to a line that captures a key part of Jaime’s character and a central fantasy theme.

Berdasarkan laporan, of all the meaningful lines jaime delivers over game of thrones’ eight seasons, one perfectly highlights a key theme that often serves as a source of strength in stories, regardless of genre: love. Martin, however, twists that theme in a way that helps ensure Jaime goes down as one of fantasy’s most memorable characters.

In the show's first episode, “Winter is Coming,” Jaime delivers his best line to his sister, Cersei, shortly after Bran Stark, the youngest son of Ned Stark of House Stark, catches them locked in an incestuous romantic embrace in one of Winterfell's towers.

Turning to Cersei, Jaime gives a self-assured smirk and says:.

Moments later, Jaime pushes Bran out the open window — triggering a chain of events that leads to eight seasons of warfare, seedy politicking, and epic fantasy unlike anything ever seen before.

Diungkapkan bahwa love is a powerful emotion that drives stories across every genre and format. It is love that causes Jack to sacrifice himself for Rose in Titanic, and it is love that protects Harry from dying from Voldemort’s killing curse in Harry Potter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, game of thrones may be a dark fantasy tale in which nobody is truly safe, but that does not mean its characters are one-dimensional. Both D&D and Martin have made it clear that even the most loathsome among them can feel love and form deep attachments.

Sebagaimana diketahui, those feelings do not necessarily make them kinder or less dangerous. On the contrary, in some cases they will commit monstrous acts for the people they love. That is clearest with Jaime, who is capable of killing a boy if it means his secret relationship with Cersei isn’t exposed to the rest of Westeros.

Berdasarkan laporan, jaime committing heinous acts for the love of his sister proves just how obsessive and toxic that love can be. It’s only when Jaime realizes his sister cares more about power than about being with him that he eventually wises up.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately, jaime’s toxic bond with cersei has been a foundational part of him since childhood. Even when Jaime eventually leaves Cersei’s influence and forms a romantic relationship with Brienne of Tarth, sleeping with her after the Battle of Winterfell, it’s not enough. When Jaime hears of Cersei’s precarious situation in King’s Landing in the final season, he abandons Brienne and the Starks to rush back to the capital to try to save Cersei from her own folly.

Diungkapkan bahwa ultimately, this final act of love for his sister leads to jaime’s downfall. Even as the Red Keep begins to crumble, Jaime refuses to leave Cersei’s side. They came into the world together, and so it only makes sense that they leave it together too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as aemond targaryen explained to jon snow in a game of thrones: “we are only human, and the gods have fashioned us for love. That is our great glory, and our great tragedy. ”.

#1028. Ocarina Of Time Zelda Notes Officially Reveal Number One Cause Of Death

📅 15 Nov 2026

Ocarina Of Time Zelda Notes Officially Reveal Number One Cause Of Death

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-zelda-notes-stats-number-one-cause-of-death/

Berdasarkan laporan, in 1998, if you wanted to know how everyone else was faring in ocarina of time, you'd have to ask your friends in the playground between rumors of a hidden sky temple. Or maybe you'd scour some old-school message boards like N64. com and AOL, long before the days of Reddit and centralized social media.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's a little different for today's kids. Now, there's a dedicated Zelda Notes section on the Nintendo Switch app that keeps track of all the stats, so you only need to swipe on your smartphone to find out who is dying to what. It's got a little less of that tactile hubbub of the playground rumor mill, but there are some interesting details to come out of it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as reported by gonintendo, the zelda notes not only provide personalized playtime data, but global data. If you die to an enemy, you get lumped into a statistic that everyone can gawk at. Funnily enough, not much has changed since the day of ASCII-art GamesFaq guides, when authors would urge that you "run through the green muck" because it "hurts less than if you go near a ReDead. " Even now, in the remake, they're the leading cause of death in Hyrule.

Diungkapkan bahwa it'd be interesting if there were statistics from the '90s that we could compare this to. I'd imagine that ReDeads and Gibdos would still be the #1 cause of death — though it'd be fascinating to know if people died as little as they have in the remake. Was the original game really harder, or were we just kids who didn't know any better?.

We finally got a chance to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and it's still one of the best games ever made.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we don't have an app that handily compiles stats like this from 1998, but there are some old internet forums that do shed light on what ocarina of time players thought at the time. On the Ushi No Tane forum, one player wrote that they "hate" ReDeads specifically because "they hump your face. " Others in the comments said it was "the scream" that did it, or simply that they "freak me out. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in 2006, someone posted to the neoseeker forums asking, "what's your most annoying enemy?" the comments called out the tektites, wallmasters, and yes, the redeads. And in 2003, IGN described Dark Link as "the most annoying mini-boss in the history of Zelda," so if you're dying to him in the remake, just know that a stressed-out guide writer was suffering through the same fight you were over 20 years ago.

#1029. 7 Decades Later, the Most Satisfying Movie of All Time Is Free on YouTube

📅 15 Nov 2026

7 Decades Later, the Most Satisfying Movie of All Time Is Free on YouTube

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/12-angry-men-free-youtube/

It’s widely considered to be one of the greatest films ever made.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sometimes, all i’m looking for in a movie is a really great performance. I don’t need grand adventure or killer special effects or stakes so impossibly big that I can’t relate to them. I just want to be moved by an actor (and a script) with as few frills and distractions as possible. Currently, for free (with ads) on YouTube, there is a movie that contains no less than 12 of those kinds of great performances, and it's one of the most satisfying films ever made.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 12 angry men begins at the very end of a trial, just as the jury is about to go deliberate. The judge reminds the jury of their duty, and that the sentence for this person, if convicted, will be death. This is a murder case where a son is being accused of stabbing his father to death. Silently, the young man who barely looks to be out of high school looks at the jury and a couple of members look back. Then the jury goes off into the jury room.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the men pile in and take a few minutes to get settled, but once they do, the foreman suggests they take a vote to see where everyone stands. Of the 12-man jury, 11 of the men believe the man is guilty, while the 12th man is unsure. From there, the discussion unfolds about whether to convict or not.

That’s literally it, and that’s all you need.

Diungkapkan bahwa to bring home my point about no frills, 95 percent of this black-and-white movie from 1957 takes place in the jury room (just the very beginning and the very end don’t). The movie is just 12 guys in a room talking and making their points, arguing, and revealing their prejudices. The characters don’t even have names, they’re just called “Juror 1,” “Juror 2,” etc. And while Henry Fonda, who plays the dissenting Juror 8, is the star of the movie with the most compelling performance, every single one of those characters is given something interesting to do and is a fully fleshed-out character in their own right.

Juror 1 is played by Martin Balsam, the foreman and the steady hand who leads the discussion, but even he finds himself shaken by the arguments that break out in the room.

Berdasarkan laporan, juror 2 is john fiedler, a character actor who may be best remembered as the voice of piglet. He’s an easygoing, seemingly weak man, but he learns to stand up for himself in the room, especially after he’s insulted or it’s revealed that bigotry is part of the reason why some of the men who agree with him want to convict.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lee j. Cobb is Juror 3, a loudmouth jerk determined to convict. He’s easy to root against because of how obnoxious he is, but he becomes more and more sympathetic once you figure out the source of his anger had more to do with his own estranged son than it does with the accused.

Diungkapkan bahwa juror 4 is played by e. G. Marshall. He’s a cold, analytical man who presents the best, most logical case for conviction.

Berdasarkan laporan, the odd couple’s jack klugman has one of the most sympathetic character arcs as juror 5. Like the young man whose life is in their hands, Klugman is a “slum kid” and he objects to the innuendos about the accused based on his social standing.

Juror 6, played by Edward Binns, is an understated blue-collar guy who is easy for the viewer to identify with.

Berdasarkan laporan, jack warden is the kind of character actor who makes you go, “oh, i know that guy,” even if you’re not sure from what. He was in The Great Muppet Caper as Kermit and Fozzie’s boss at the newspaper and in Dirty Work as Artie Lange’s dad. As Juror 7, he often steals the show by cracking jokes and making it very clear that he’s got tickets to a Yankee game after this and he really doesn’t want to miss it.

Diungkapkan bahwa then there’s the star of the film, henry fonda as juror 8. He’s a principled, thoughtful man who originally dissents not because he’s sure of the innocence of the accused, but because he’s just not sure. He states his points and, one by one, more people come to his side by bringing up their own points and even convincing themselves. His performance is moving and the arguments he makes are compelling, but the movie isn’t just him convincing everybody. He thinks, because this is a death penalty case, that they should take the time to discuss everything — a man’s life is at least worth that. It’s the unique kind of performance that is both commanding and, in many ways, quite subtle.

Juror 9 is Joseph Sweeney, an old man who is easy to overlook, but he makes some of the most profound observations about the trial.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, juror 10, played by ed begley, is a bigoted business owner who is determined to convict simply because of the defendant's unspecified ethnicity. (A key point to the case is that it took place in a New York City slum and the accused murderer is darker-skinned than everyone on the jury, which is incredibly relevant to how things proceed in the jury room. ).

Juror 11 is George Voskovec, a European watchmaker who also finds himself a target of some bigotry in the room.

Finally, Juror 12 is Robert Webber, an ad man who doesn't really care about the proceedings, but eventually rises to the occasion.

Berdasarkan laporan, written by reginald rose, 12 angry men was directed by master filmmaker sidney lumet, famous for films like dog day afternoon, serpico, network, and many others. Relatively early in the movie, it becomes clear that the trajectory of the film is that each man changes their minds, one at a time. 12 Angry Men was his directorial debut and he shows tremendous wisdom in just letting the actors do their thing. But the interesting part is the why of each man.

Diungkapkan bahwa most compelling of all is to figure out when you, the viewer, switch sides. Going into the jury room, the majority is convinced of the man’s guilt because the case they just witnessed was convincing. The evidence appears to point in favor of conviction, and it's laid out, at first, to make sure the viewer is also on the side of conviction. But one by one, the men change their minds and the experience of watching the film is that you, at some point, change your mind, too.

#1032. 25 Funniest 'Peanuts' Comics from the 1960s That Prove Charles M. Schulz Is Unbeatable

And maybe Charles Schulz’s funniest-ever story.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the year 1964 was an election year in america. After assuming office in late November 1963 following the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, Democratic President Lyndon Johnson was running for reelection on a platform of civil rights and combating poverty. His opponent was Republican Senator Barry Goldwater, who ran on a conservative platform of smaller government. Johnson ended up winning in a landslide with 61 percent of the popular vote and 44 out of 50 states voting for him.

As is the case with every presidential election year, the race was the number one news story, and it invaded many other aspects of American life, up to and including the immensely popular comic strip Peanuts, albeit in a very Peanuts-appropriate way.

Berdasarkan laporan, beginning on oct. Linus even reaches 92 percent support in the polls at one point, but on Oct. 5, 1964, Charles Schulz launched a month-long story about Linus running for school president. His sister Lucy convinces him to run and acts as his campaign manager, while Charlie Brown becomes his running mate. Linus runs a pretty savvy campaign, conducting rousing speeches about the same nonsense real politicians do, talking about “moral decline” and other amorphous platitudes. 21, the campaign takes a shocking turn that changes everything.

Berdasarkan laporan, the story is probably schulz’s funniest-ever long-running story. There are a lot of amusing political points that Schulz makes about our system, some of which still feel pretty prescient. The whole build-up to the big shift is a brilliant slow burn, while still being quite funny along the way. While most Peanuts comics work just fine out of context, this 25-day arc is best enjoyed in its entirety, to get the full effect (or at least some of the same effect) newspaper readers experienced back in 1964.

Perhaps Linus’ face in panel number three should have prepared people for where this story would go.

It’s pretty sad that teachers' salaries are still such an issue more than 60 years later.

Linus is officially nominated here by Schroeder, who can’t seem to skip an opportunity to bore people about Beethoven.

Berdasarkan laporan, linus’ acceptance speech puts up a serious red flag when he says he may do away with elections. This is one of those things that feels especially relevant in today’s political climate. I would not have taken Linus for a fascist.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after his nomination and acceptance speech, linus brings in his vice presidential candidate, charlie brown. I mean, just look at the Christmas special (which aired a year after this). I think I agree with Lucy here when she says “Good Grief!” to the choice. Linus is an excellent, inspiring public speaker, while Charlie Brown can’t even direct that goofy little play or pick out a decent tree. He’s not meant for leadership.

Diungkapkan bahwa i, for one, think linus should have nominated snoopy for vice president. Sure, it’s a gimmick, but there have been several times in US history where America would have been better off with a dog as VP (just look up a guy named Aaron Burr).

“The press is against me!” also feels like it could have run today with equal relevance.

Diungkapkan bahwa you may have noticed that this series skipped oct. 11. That’s because the Sunday strips had to be standalone, as many people only got Sunday papers. Also, because they were in color and had wider distribution, Sunday strips had to be completed much farther ahead than the daily strips.

This is just bad journalism on Violet’s part.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, linus’ propensity for religious fervor is so incredibly funny. What’s even funnier is how effective it is.

All of these ideas are super-solid and should happen in real life.

#1034. I Can't Wait to Ignore the Main Story of GTA 6

📅 15 Nov 2026

I Can't Wait to Ignore the Main Story of GTA 6

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/gta-6-main-story-side-activities/

Have fun robbing stores, I'm going snorkeling.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's hard to believe, but after years of waiting, we're less than a week away from the launch of grand theft auto 6. I couldn't care less about shooting people and stealing cars. Many of them will be diving headfirst into Jason and Lucia's story, taking on high-stakes robberies to see how the couple's ascent through Vice City's underworld plays out. Tons of people are planning to take time off from work or school in order to sink their teeth into Rockstar's newest adventure. But for me, the "grand theft auto" of GTA 6 is actually the least intriguing element of 2026's most anticipated game. I'm far more excited to explore the vast, glorious sandbox Rockstar has created.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the major draws of sega's yakuza series is that it provides a fantastic virtual tourism experience. I've never been to Miami, but I'd like to go someday. Now I can check out all those cool Art Deco buildings and take a fan boat through a swamp without spending IRL money on bottle service. I'm hoping for a similar kind of experience with GTA 6. When I visited Tokyo for the first time, I walked out of Shinjuku Station and knew exactly where I was, having spent so much time as Kiryu running around the streets of Kamurocho. Pound for pound, video games are the cheapest form of vacation out there, and this one's shaping up to be a doozy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm also looking forward to meeting all the wonderful weirdos rockstar has crafted to inhabit this dazzling sandbox. If you kick off a fistfight in Valentine's saloon and get thrown in jail for the night, passerby will scold you and warn you not to "cause trouble" the next few times you visit. One of my favorite elements of Red Dead Redemption 2 was simply talking to people and watching their reactions. My favorite memories of that game have little to do with hunting O'Driscolls — it's all the dumb shenanigans I bumbled into while ignoring the main campaign, like doing an oopsie and shooting a man when I just wanted to steal his sick raccoon-skin cap, then getting run out of town by multiple lawmen and racking up a hefty bounty as a result of my thieving ways.

Diungkapkan bahwa gta 6 promises to up this kind of immersion by several orders of magnitude. "Once we managed to accomplish that level of interactive fidelity in a more sparsely populated version of America 100 years ago, we were already imagining what it would be like if we could do that at the scale and density of a modern environment," Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson told the Times. Back in August, thanks to a New York Times feature about the game, we learned that Rockstar created an entire studio just for NPCs. If GTA 6 feels more like Red Dead 2 than GTA 5, I'd be delighted.

Berdasarkan laporan, based on what we've seen in the netflix extended look and various previews of the game, gta 6 will have literally dozens of minigames and optional activities to distract me from the central plot. These include fishing, jet skiing, mini-golf, scuba diving, lifting weights, hunting, racing, fan boating, billiards, basketball, and parachuting. There's even an in-universe animated TV show, Macca and Friends, that I'm sure is going to be ridiculously in-depth, just like Red Dead 2's movie theater in San Denis. I mean, I guess I'll shoot some people in GTA 6 if I really have to, but honestly? I'm just here for the vibes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when world of warcraft: forever's beta first launched, i lamented its long stretches of silence and penchant for ambience over theatrics. I still sort of stand by that, but after spending more time in Azeroth (and discovering the loop music setting) I've a new-found appreciation for both WoW's soundtrack and ambient music as a whole.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's also got me thinking about what makes a soundtrack ambient versus something more melodic. You can't escape composer Masayoshi Soken's penchant for leifmotifs. I'm chronically Final Fantasy 14-brained, where just about everything has a grand thematic soundtrack to it—the jauntiness of the Gold Saucer, the soothing Middle-earthness of Gridania's outer Shroud zones, the grand organs of Ishgard's bitterly cold landscape. He will turn anything into an orchestral spectacle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm a big jrpg fan in general, a genre i think is the absolute master of thematic soundtracks. Minecraft's OST is a masterclass in ambience, and is in regular rotation across my videogame-themed Spotify playlists. But I also think fondly of games I've played over the years that are a little more pared down, their soundtracks there for a little atmosphere rather than actively driving the narrative. I also have a huge soft spot for the soundtrack behind Mirror's Edge—one which settles in this almost otherworldly ambiance, only ramping up when Faith is in a perilous situation.

But what about you? Do you prefer the more subtle nuances that an atmospheric soundtrack has to offer? Or do you like your videogame music loud, in your face, and full of dramatics? Be sure to leave a comment and let me know which one's your favourite and why.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cleanser man is a cleaning robot with an obsession for pristine beauty. His aggressive scrubbing causes great damage to global landmarks and historic works of art. #1040. Prime Video's Near-Perfect Game of Thrones Replacement Officially Arrives in 2 Months

📅 15 Nov 2026

Prime Video's Near-Perfect Game of Thrones Replacement Officially Arrives in 2 Months

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/blood-axe-prime-video-episode-1-review/

Time to start sharpening your bloodaxe.

Time to start sharpening your bloodaxe.

Berdasarkan laporan, a weak king rules over a cobbled-together kingdom that's already coming apart at the seams. Various heroes and villains compete and scheme to claim the throne. A new challenger rises up from across the sea, full of vengeance and bloodlust. If that sounds like the premise of Game of Thrones, well, that's because it is, but it's also the set-up for Prime Video's thrilling new action drama from one of the 21st-century's most successful (and underappreciated) showrunners.

Diungkapkan bahwa back in october, during new york comic con 2026, i attended an early screening of bloodaxe, a new series from vikings creator michael hirst and his son horatio. Based on the show's first episode, which premieres Jan. 20, 2027 on Prime Video, the streamer might just have a new Game of Thrones-level hit on its hands. Or at the very least, an entertaining show for VIkings fans.

Diungkapkan bahwa bloodaxe tells the real-life story of eric haraldsson (aka eric bloodaxe), who lived during the 10th century. Eric expects to be named successor, but then Harald reveals that his younger son Haakon (Levi Miller), who spent his childhood in England learning the art of diplomacy, will be king instead. His father, King Harald (Jesper Christensen), is beginning to lose his grip on the Norwegian kingdom he spent his life uniting. When we first meet Eric (Xavier Molyneux), he's already a powerful warrior and a popular figure in Viking society. Meanwhile, Eric's statuesque wife Gunnhild (Bridgerton's Jessica Madsen) has her own schemes in mind to elevate her husband to the throne, while her exiled brother Egil (Kārlis Arnolds Avots) plots his own ascension to power from nearby Iceland.

Berdasarkan laporan, that might sound like a lot of plot to pack into one hour of television, and… it is. But Michael and Horatio Hirst deftly plunge us into this world headfirst like a Viking warrior sprinting into the frigid Norwegian Sea. Like Game of Thrones, Bloodaxe pulls out all the stops in its opening act to win over its audience. That means plenty of political intrigue, shocking deaths, stunning scenery, meticulous production design, beautiful actors, and gratuitous sex scenes.

Diungkapkan bahwa the landscapes are particularly stunning. The cast ain't bad to look at either. While much of what's meant to be Norway was filmed in Ireland, with rugged Scandinavian mountains added in digitally, Egil's scenes were shot on location in Iceland — you just can't fake those scorchingly beautiful geothermal pools and glaciers. Life-sized boats and massive sprawling sets complete the experience. Molyneux resembles a lost Hemsworth brother (his breakout role was as a contestant on Australian Big Brother), while Miller bears a striking resemblance to Kit Harington's Jon Snow. It all makes Bloodaxe very easy on the eyes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that helps when the plot quickly gets down into the muck. While Bloodaxe technically hinges on palace intrigue, this is a gritty and grimy world with its own morals and ethics that feel alien by 21st-century standards. (An interesting wrinkle: Of the two, the Vikings were arguably more progressive for their time, with an egalitarian society that treated men and women equally. There's even a few prophecies and witchy rituals thrown in for good measure, all playing out against the backdrop of a larger theological battle between Viking paganism with its pantheon of Norse gods and the rising tide of Catholic monotheism. The core story of multiple factions vying for power and bracing for all-out civil war also feels particularly Game of Thrones-esque. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa perhaps most interesting of all, bloodaxe is based on a true story. This also means that, like with Game of Thrones, if you're curious about what ultimately happens to Eric and the rest of the gang, you can always read ahead and find out. The writers are pulling directly from history (as recorded by Icelandic clerics and scholars several hundred years later). But why ruin the fun?.

Berdasarkan laporan, all eight episodes of bloodaxe will make landfall on jan. 20, 2027, with season 2 already in production. So while you could head to Wikipedia right now to find out whether Eric Bloodaxe becomes king or not, you may have a lot more fun watching his journey play out onscreen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and assuming the showrunners get to tell a complete story, bloodaxe has one big advantage over game of thrones. This story has been set in stone for over one thousand years, which means it will be very hard for Michael and Horatio Hirst to bungle the ending.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bloodaxe premieres jan. 20, 2027 on Prime Video.

Diungkapkan bahwa treyarch's former senior lead writer, craig houston, has been laid off after approximately 20 years of service with the developer. In a post made to both his Twitter/X account and LinkedIn, the developer thanked fans for their support during his two decades with the company and confirmed he was impacted by recent reorganistation within the studio.

Berdasarkan laporan, "after approximately 20 years, i was sadly one of those affected by recent layoffs," he noted in his posts. Thanks to all the fans for your enthusiasm, support, and kind words over the years. "I am proud to have worked with so many talented people - many of whom will remain friends for life. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on twitter/x, he quote tweeted a video celebrating 30 years of treyarch and featuring footage from many of the games he worked on to share his message. It appears the layoffs referenced are part of the broad reorganistation affecting 3200 jobs that Xbox announced earlier this year. Treyarch, as part of Activision Blizzard, is owned by Xbox.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, houston is a bonafide veteran of the esteemed fps series. This was followed by World at War, Black Ops 1 through 4, where he is credited as a writer and designer. His first Call of Duty title at Treyarch was Call of Duty 3, where he worked as a video editor. For Modern Warfare, Black Ops - Cold War, Vanguard, Modern Warfare 3, then Black Ops 6 and 7, he is listed as a member of the design team and in 'creative development'. He is not credited on this year's Modern Warfare 4.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you've picked up a call of duty game in the past decade-plus, you'll have interacted with houston's work: he was a central creative force behind the writing for treyarch's campaign modes since 2006 (with call of duty 3) and the main writer for the zombies mode since 2008 (with call of duty: world at war). Alongside Jimmy Zielinski, Jason Blundell, and Kevin Drew, Houston was an integral part of the evolution of the Zombies pillar of Call of Duty, and shaped it into the series-defining thing it is today. There has been a fair amount of community support for Houston since he announced the news yesterday; he was a popular dev, and a lot of the Zombies-specific fan communities online hold a lot of respect for him.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "craig is a great guy," notes one user on reddit. "You can tell how much he loves the story/characters he writes just by how excited he is when he talks about them in promo material. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "you're a legend craig, it was an honor to work with you," says ex-treyarch vet, tony flame, in a reply to houston's x post. Wishing you the best [. "You created a truly special experience that will live on in the kinds of millions fans. ]. ".

From all of us here at Eurogamer, and myself personally - who really admires the character-work and emergent storytelling present in the Xbox 360-era Call of Duty games, specifically - we wish you the best and good luck with the future, Craig.
