Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, we've seen blade runner games before. There was 1997's simply-titled Blade Runner - developed by Westwood Studios and published by Virgin Interactive - which was a point-and-click adventure that really seemed to pick up the vibes the original Ridley Scott was putting down. An Enhanced Edition of the game was released in 2022, which is actually more of a remake than a simple enhancement.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then, in 2023, annapurna interactive unveiled its very first internally-developed game, in the form of blade runner 2033: labyrinth. It was going to be set in LA after the Blackout hits, but beyond that - and the fact it's coming to PC and consoles at some point - few details ever managed to break through the PR barrier before the game went dark: it's been removed from Annapurna's website and delisted from Steam. The game, which promised to riff on the dystopian universe established in Ridley Scott's cult classic movie, would have been sandwiched squarely between that film and its sequel, Blade Runner 2049. Curious.

If you want to see something more from the cyberpunk world sooner, Blade Runner 2099 releases on Prime Video on 25th November.

Riot has announced a League of Legends overhaul that promises to touch every aspect of the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we want league to stand the test of time and be a game that's here for many years to come," said league studio head andrei "meddler" van roon in a teaser trailer. "And there are a lot of things that need to be true to make that happen. ".

The headlining changes coming with the update, called New Dawn, are a "modernized" client, a graphical revamp for the 5v5 map Summoner's Rift (the last time this happened was in 2014), and "new ways to play" each champion.

Berdasarkan laporan, while details are scarce in the teaser, some brief footage is shown where you can see what he's talking about: a blitzcrank player selects what looks like a character-specific mastery tree labeled "god hand," and it cuts to him beating up an enemy in melee. Other champions are shown using abilities in ways they currently can't—Vayne, for instance, dashes through a wall.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, an updated art style is also shown off, including new character models for all sorts of champions as well as bosses like baron nashor and the elder dragon. It looks much more in line with the art style of Wild Rift, League of Legends' mobile port-slash-spinoff with high-detail character models.

Player reactions are, as you might expect with an update that promises to be so comprehensive, all over the map.

"Am I the only one who thinks this looks like a mobile game," said Reddit user lukesherboiii in a thread sharing the trailer.

It's official! These animations are now rolling out to all players on Xbox One, Series X and Series S:.

Original Story: So, you remember that recent Xbox console update we mentioned yesterday? The one that happened on Wednesday and included original Xbox achievements? It seems like there's at least one more hidden feature to be discovered.

A couple of eagle-eyed Xbox fans have spotted that the patch notes had been adjusted for this update last night, and they mentioned that three classic startup animations were being added to "celebrate 25 years of Xbox history".

The three animations are for the original Xbox, Xbox 360 (2005) and Xbox 360 (2010).

Since then, the patch notes have been adjusted once more to just reference "miscellaneous" improvements, so it seems like they jumped the gun slightly and were supposed to wait until November 15th (the date of Xbox's 25th anniversary) to reveal these three startup animations.

None of them are live yet by the way, but it might be worth checking the "Startup" section of your Xbox console's Settings menu periodically over the next couple of days to see if they show up.

I don't know about you, but I'm going to be rocking the original Xbox startup animation as soon as possible!.

Here's a look at what you can expect from the three animations when they become available:.

It's with Insiders right now, but will soon become totally public.

Team Meat has announced a new remake of its classic 2010 platformer: Super Meat Boy Again+, this time with a fresh coat of bloodsoaked paint and entirely new levels.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the brutally tough platformer became a cult hit more than a decade ago and spawned one sequel, one 3d spin-off and a whole speedrunning community dedicated to beating its masocore levels without dying. Super Meat Boy Again+ is more or less the same game, but with much more bolted on top.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "this version is just like the original super meat boy game but with new art, music, cutscenes, levels, secrets and unlockables. new everything," the game's Steam page says. You'll go into it blind like you did the first time you played Super Meat Boy. That's the "+" in Again+, and no, we won't spoil it. "Since 2010, millions of people [have] played Super Meat Boy, all the secrets are known, all the levels are mastered, all the characters unlocked, so we have to give fans familiar with the game something to pull their hair out over. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, original composer danny baranowsky - better known as danny b - is also back with an expanded soundtrack. The reveal trailer up above shows off how drastically different the game's updated art looks, too.

Berdasarkan laporan, "for our old fans, we want to present the game as you remember it through the wonderful lens of nostalgia. For our new fans, we want to give you a great looking, easy to pick up but difficult to master platformer that you may have missed because it came out like 4 years after YouTube was invented," the studio explains.

There's no release date yet for Super Meat Boy Again+ and the only confirmed platform thus far is Steam.

If you’re relying on luck, you’ll need to open every Rare and Sprite chest possible to stand a chance. Mythic rarity has very low drop rates to begin with. Additionally, there’s no guaranteed for the Mythic Drop to be a Zee Sprite.

Diungkapkan bahwa what you can do instead is to collect as many other sprites as possible. When you do so, it will help you to obtain a Zee Sprite. Once you have your collection almost filled up (ideally, you should have all but the Zee Sprite), use the Lucky Locator. Then, it’s all about surviving and extracting the Sprite to add it permanently to your collection.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, finally, you can kill as many players as possible and hope to get lucky. This is precisely how I managed to get it on my end. Once again, it’s all a matter of luck.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you equip the zee sprite, you’ll be able to use zero point dash charges. This ability allows you to dash forward when you press the jump button while you’re in the air. As you level up the Sprite, you’ll increase the number of charges you get.

The boost you get to your movement makes this a great choice if you like to engage in player fights.

#1058. 17 Years Ago, the Longest Running Sci-Fi Show Flipped Its Core Concept On Its Head

📅 15 Nov 2026

17 Years Ago, the Longest Running Sci-Fi Show Flipped Its Core Concept On Its Head

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/doctor-who-the-waters-of-mars-17th-anniversary-retrospective/

Diungkapkan bahwa david tennant has long been recognized as one of the greatest actors alive. He’s played scoundrels, cops, serial killers, and even a demon — an actual one, not a member of the Conservative Party, though he’s played one of those too.

Berdasarkan laporan, if there’s one thing you can’t say about tennant, it’s that he lacks range. He can play a lover, a fighter, or the scummiest person you know. But his most iconic role as the time-traveling alien known as the Doctor in the sci-fi family show Doctor Who brings all three together.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that might be a shocking statement to process. Always try to be nice, but never fail to be kind. During the Twelfth Doctor’s (Peter Capaldi) regeneration in 2017, one of his very last statements was that the future Doctor should “never be cruel, never be cowardly, and never ever eat pears! Remember, hate is always foolish, but love is always wise. One of the Doctor’s core moral philosophies, articulated as early as Classic Who in 1963, is that the Time Lord is ultimately a peaceful person. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and yet, tennant’s tenth doctor was the opposite of all those things during the 2009 autumnal doctor who special, "the waters of mars. ".

There have always been moments when the Doctor has shown that, for every person he has saved over the centuries, there have been just as many whom he has condemned.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, the most memorable episode in which whovians see the doctor at his lowest point morally comes when the time lord lands on mars in 2059 and encounters humanity’s first colony there: bowie base one. Unfortunately, once the Doctor realizes who they are, another realization follows: it’s a fixed point in history in which everyone on Bowie Base One will die in an unknown cataclysm. Led by Captain Adelaide Brooke (Lindsay Duncan), the colonists seem to be doing quite well for themselves, and there is hope that more of humanity will be able to join them in the future. Worse, it’s set to happen on the day the Doctor arrives.

Diungkapkan bahwa the reason is revealed with the arrival of the flood — an incredibly intelligent, waterborne alien virus. A single drop of the virus infects humans, turning them into zombie-like creatures with one sole aim: to keep spreading. One by one, the personnel of Bowie Base One perish, though one member cleverly destroys all the ships so the Flood cannot spread to Earth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, throughout it all, the doctor is racked with indecision. Messing with fixed points in history is usually seen as a big no-no, but he had done so before with his previous companion Donna Noble (Catherine Tate) when they saved a single family during “The Fires of Pompeii. ” However, if he saves Adelaide, her granddaughter Susie won’t be inspired to become the first human captain to pilot a lightspeed ship to Proxima Centauri, a major historical event.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s a conundrum that arises while the doctor is traveling alone, still reeling from the loss of his companion, donna. In several previous episodes, the alien race known as the Ood has also warned him that his time is running out — regeneration is on the way.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this knowledge leaves the doctor furious. Now that he’s on his own, the fact that time and circumstance take so much away has driven him to the brink. No matter how many he saves, it seems all he does lately is lose. He’s tired of losing; he wants to win.

After revealing to Adelaide her impending doom and her granddaughter’s achievement, the Doctor, in a moment of profound, unbridled hubris, delivers a speech that must be read in full to appreciate just how villainous it sounds:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “there are laws of time. Once upon a time there were people in charge of those laws, but they died. They all died. Do you know who that leaves? Me! It's taken me all these years to realize that the laws of time are mine and they will obey me!”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s a quote that feels exactly like it would come from the doctor’s worst enemy, fellow time lord, the master. Unlike the Doctor, the Master has always wanted to dominate others, making the Doctor’s subsequent rescue of Adelaide in the TARDIS feel even worse.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately for the doctor, his victory in giving time itself a big ‘f u’ is short-lived. Back on Earth, Adelaide is shaken by the Doctor’s self-perception as a god over time and berates the Time Lord for thinking he gets to live and choose who lives and who dies. She walks away and kills herself, righting history once more.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the doctor's overwhelming pride has always been part of him. As much as he loves exploring the universe and often falls in love with humanity, he undoubtedly thinks himself better than most. There have been too many episodes to count in which a character has called the Doctor out for thinking others are stupid.

Diungkapkan bahwa the time lord’s arrogance often leaves it to his companions to reel him back from the brink of destruction by reminding him of his humanity. In “The Waters of Mars,” it is easy to see why: If they don’t, the Doctor can easily become the very monster he so often fights.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we want to hear from you. Share your perspective in the comments below, and please keep the conversation respectful.

#1059. 'The Ultimate Gaming Machine' - Xbox Reveals Tons Of New Project Helix Information

📅 15 Nov 2026

'The Ultimate Gaming Machine' - Xbox Reveals Tons Of New Project Helix Information

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/the-ultimate-gaming-machine-xbox-reveals-tons-of-new-project-helix-information

Also clarifying that it's definitely a console and not a PC.

As part of Xbox's 25th anniversary celebrations today, we've been treated to a new digital version of a magazine that was given out at Seattle FanFest earlier this week, available to read in full over on the official Xbox Wire website.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the bit that's getting most attention concerns xbox project helix - the new next-gen console that's currently in the works over at xbox hq. The brand's VP of Next Generation, Jason Ronald, shares tons of new information across four pages in the magazine, helping to give us a better idea of what to expect from the upcoming console.

There's one section in particular that's getting all the interest on social media right now, where he clarifies that Project Helix is definitely a console that can play PC games, and definitely not a PC that happens to play console games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we're very clear on the design goal: helix is designed to be a console that is also capable of playing games from your pc. But if you're a hardcore gamer or a power user who wants to have that deeper level of customizability across settings and performance options, you can absolutely go do it. The goal is making it easy, intuitive, and instant to access my games. It is not a PC that can also play console games. ".

Beyond this, Ronald talks in depth about loads of other aspects of what they're aiming for with Project Helix, and as mentioned, there's so much detail that it spreads across four pages of the magazine.

In the interest of highlighting as much as possible though, we thought we'd transcribe all of most notable quotes from the magazine down below, whereas you can read the added context inside of the magazine article itself.

Here are more of the key bits from the magazine article:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "when we think about project helix, it's really designed to be the ultimate gaming machine - one that removes all barriers of play that have historically existed. My entire library is accessible to me. I'm able to bring four generations of my Xbox library and progression with me and have it available instantly. And we remove the arbitrary constraints between console and PC games. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "we don't think the next generation is defined by 8k or 240 hertz, or some of the traditional metrics - it's really about gameplay innovation. It is about leveraging new technical advancements such as neural rendering, to deliver a new level of visual fidelity in more efficient and innovative ways. It's about deeper immersion. It's about new kinds of games and new game experiences that we haven't been able to do before. What excites me about the future is the idea of entirely new types of games that have never been possible before, delivered through all the innovation in the silicon and the hardware and the platform that we're delivering. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "when i think about what makes a console magical, it's that it just makes my games instantly accessible and ready to play in an instant. The hardware and the experience is entirely designed around playing games. I don't have to worry about updating my operating system, updating drivers, configuring different settings - things like that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "the very first next-generation conversations we had were with all of our first-party studios. That was absolutely foundational to the design of what we've done with Project Helix - talking about where they saw the future of game design going, where they saw the future of their franchises going, and what was constraining their creative ambition. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "with xbox one, i think we got so focused on expanding our aperture that we lost sight of what truly is magical, which is players, developers, and the games that they love. We have to build the best platform for game developers to deliver their creative vision. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "the other thing, and i think this is something that is unique about xbox, is we have to be connected to the community. A lot of the features that people have come to love and expect from Xbox have actually been driven directly by community feedback. I think that's really core to the soul of who Xbox is, because if you're in touch with your player base, you never go wrong if you focus on what their needs are. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it's definitely a challenging time, but as a system and a platform designer, it's also one of the most exciting times, because we have to invent entirely new technology to continue to advance the state-of-the-art while also continuing to make things accessible and affordable. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "this is a big reason why we're really focused on advancements like neural rendering, because it's an entirely new way to generate a frame without requiring more computational horsepower, additional memory, and things like that. I think you're going to see more innovation over the next three to five years than you've seen in the last 10 years. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "the rog xbox ally was really an opportunity for us to learn alongside our player base with a lot of these concepts and the ideas that we had: being able to play libraries from across multiple different storefronts, understanding how pc games and console games can show up together in a unified library. Players shared where we met the mark and areas we needed to improve or approach differently. So absolutely, we view the Ally as a precursor to what we're doing with Helix - but it's informed by a lot of the design concepts we have for Helix. The feedback that we've gotten from players has fundamentally informed and altered our plans of how it actually shows up in a future console. ".

Sorry for the wall of quotes, but we thought you might find all of this pretty interesting! It's not even the full extent of what Ronald had to say, as he also touched on the importance of game preservation to the Xbox platform in general, as well as how Project Helix will seemingly have a bespoke UI, but one that still feels familiar to Xbox fans.

Of course, we're still waiting on concrete details about what Helix will look like, how much it'll cost, how significant the PC integration will be, and loads of other things that will give us a much better picture of how it'll shape up.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it seems like we won't be getting that this year though, and if rumours are to be believed, xbox might even be releasing a first-party handheld in 2027 before the project helix console in 2028. Who knows. plans can always change.

For now, let us know what you think about this latest info on Xbox Project Helix down below, and we definitely recommend reading the full Xbox 25th anniversary magazine for yourself - we wish we could buy one to be honest!.

#1063. Xbox Celebrates 25th Anniversary With New Magazine And Boot Animations

📅 15 Nov 2026

Xbox Celebrates 25th Anniversary With New Magazine And Boot Animations

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/xbox-25-anniversary-boot-animations-magazine-release/

Diungkapkan bahwa xbox has had no shortage of ups and downs with its public perceptions in recent years, with mass layoffs followed by promising announcements leaving players confused about the future of the company. Despite the difficulties, however, Xbox's latest celebration for its 25th anniversary has already been a smashing success with fans so far, bringing back some of the brand's most iconic eras to life in the modern day.

Coming hot off the heels of numerous project announcements like a new Doom game in the works, Xbox is kicking off its 25th anniversary with a nostalgic new software update and some teases for even more classic games to return.

Starting now and rolling out for all regions over the next few hours, Xbox announced on X that they will be officially bringing back the original Xbox boot-up animations for Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One users, alongside a couple of additional Xbox 360 boot animations for fans to enjoy.

Xbox is finally getting its own answer to PlayStation's platinum trophies.

After installing the update, all you have to do is head over to your system settings, access the system startup menu, and you'll be able to choose from any of the 8 starting animations that Xbox has released over the years, going all the way back to the original console that started it all.

While fans have already been celebrating the change and using it as a chance to chastize PlayStation for making their 30th anniversary event temporary rather than a permanent change like Xbox, it's far from the only new announcement either.

Aside from the nostalgic boot animations, one of the more informative anniversary updates comes in the form of the newly released Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine, which has been offered for free to read online through Xbox Wire.

Originally debuted at Xbox FanFest in Seattle, the free virtual magazine goes over several key moments and releases over Xbox's history, while offering details for upcoming games like Stranger Than Heaven, Persona 4 Revival, and Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Snogs Of The Past, and more.

To top off the sheer amount of game details, the magazine also offers some information about Xbox's next console, Project Helix, specifically related to how it will connect and be able to play PC games through the system.

Berdasarkan laporan, to get into the game industry – at least at the level he’d always dreamed of – joe brammer had to tell a lie. In 2014, just as he was about to graduate from university, he applied for what was then the brand-new ID@Xbox scheme, which enabled novice developers to pitch to Microsoft in the hope of receiving an Xbox One development kit and a subscription to Unreal Engine. “So I lied on the form, saying I’d worked for loads of people, like Lionhead. “I’d wanted to make games since I was 11, modding Battlefield,” Brammer says. It’s funny when you look at that list of the first ID@Xbox studios now: CryTek, Sumo Digital, me. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, working with a team of friends from his course, brammer would co-create a firstperson myst-style puzzler called pneuma: breath of life. “If we launched it today, we’d get slaughtered,” he continues. “It’s awful. But it was the first Unreal Engine 4 game on Xbox One, so Epic put us in all their booths”. Helped along by that whirlwind exposure, the game made about £400,000 in its first six months, more than enough to get production going on a new project. It also incentivised the formal founding of Bulkhead as a studio.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, from a variety of fleetingly occupied offices around derby (“we’ve moved about ten times by now,” brammer says), the expanded and newly rebranded team would go to work on its next game, a follow-up first-person puzzler called, with an almost hubristic pragmatism, the turing test. “We basically made the whole game in white box, with about 100 puzzles,” Brammer recalls. “Then we went to a local college and we added a little popup at the end of each puzzle asking people to rate the difficulty and how much they enjoyed it. And then we put them in that order, on a spaceship. Just like getting accepted into the ID@Xbox scheme, when it came to Bulkhead’s masthead debut, the ends were more important than the means, and what mattered above all was the will to get things done. Honestly, it was easy. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa but if bulkhead had been unfailingly confident up until now – and had grown to be much more successful, much more quickly, than its founders had ever anticipated – the studio’s next game would bring its surging momentum to a near-terminal stop. But nobody wants to play that for more than three hours. During development of The Turing Test, team members had taken to spending their lunchtimes playing competitive rounds of Call Of Duty 2 and Splinter Cell: Blacklist. Inspired by this older generation of multiplayer shooters – and deciding that they were, in Brammer’s words, “bored” with the puzzle genre – the team at Bulkhead started work on Battalion 1944, a World War II FPS that would pluck on players’ nostalgia for old-school COD. “We delivered,” Brammer continues. “But because it was a ‘classic shooter’, it just didn’t have any long-term retention,” explains UI and UX designer Howard Philpott. “We made an old-school shooter that reminds you of that era of games. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, beyond the lack of long-term appeal, battalion faced other, more immediate problems. Owing to a well-targeted pre-launch campaign, the studio had managed to push Battalion to the very top of the Twitch viewership charts – “We had some of the biggest streamers playing our game,” Brammer remembers. After a highly successful Kickstarter, Bulkhead had once again partnered with Square Enix, its publisher for The Turing Test. Ultimately, however, being one of the most watched games in the world would only serve to make the collapse of Battalion more spectacular, and leave an even bigger bruise on Bulkhead’s soul.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we were using this thing for the backend called google app engine,” brammer says. “It wasn’t really designed for what we were using it for, but in the alpha and beta test, it had been fine. On release day, though, once we hit 12,345 players, it all went down. If they’d put ‘123456’, it would have been fine. Turned out, a Google programmer had just put in an arbitrary limit on users – someone at Google had gone, ‘Ah, just put in a limit, whatever – 12345’, so when we hit that number, it crashed. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “so we’re there phoning google,” philpott continues, “trying to find out what’s going on, and all the time we’re also watching timthetatman streaming the game. ‘Oh my god, TimTheTatman is streaming the game, and he can’t get into the server’. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa while pneuma and the turing test had helped to put it on the map, and given shape to a dogged and strident work ethic – almost a bravura – that would remain at the core of its collective personality, battalion would be the game to really define bulkhead as a studio. It knocked our confidence. “We were saying, ‘We’re ready to release it’. It was a huge scar for us. But then you don’t get Wardogs without us making the mistakes on Battalion. But the adults in the room probably should have said, ‘Yeah, we need to delay it another six months’. It’s why you haven’t heard of us until Wardogs. “We were 24 at the time,” Brammer remembers. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite learning some tough lessons from its first attempt at a shooter, bulkhead’s route back into the genre – and to creating its most successful game to date – would be far from straightforward. It was a close and affectionate relationship. Some time later, in December 2022, Splash Damage would buy Bulkhead outright. After releasing Battalion, the studio was approached by Splash Damage with an offer to work on the infamously troubled, and eventually cancelled, Transformers Reactivate. “They always protected us from businesses and publishers,” Brammer says.

Berdasarkan laporan, but a complication was on the way. “I remember saying to people, ‘If you have another job offer, please take it’. However, when Splash Damage’s parent company, Tencent, sold Splash Damage in 2025, it also negotiated a deal whereby it would keep Bulkhead. Under Splash Damage, Bulkhead had already begun work on the prototype version of Wardogs. You can get it done’. This transference of ownership – inheriting these new overseers – had never been part of Bulkhead’s plan. And so Brammer was suddenly rushing around, reaching out to potential partners and investors, trying to find a way to buy back the studio that he’d co-created. I was like, ‘I’m telling you, we’re going to die!’ I was trying to kick people out but they just wouldn’t go. And they were saying, ‘I believe in you, Joe. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, those few months were arduous, but ultimately, in december 2025, the buyback was completed successfully. “For a British studio to make an FPS game of this scale, it’s a big deal,” Brammer says now. For Brammer, however, the game also illustrates the efficacy of Bulkhead’s studio culture. Less than eight weeks later, Bulkhead announced Wardogs. He makes no secret of the fact that Bulkhead expects its staff to crunch. ” Now in early access, to a certain extent Wardogs’ success speaks for itself: since arriving on Steam in September, it’s sold over three million copies and maintained an average concurrent player count of more than 200,000. I’m quite proud of that. “I went through the British game-development education system, from college to university to making our own studio. More than that, he says that certain attitudes, perhaps more common in today’s videogame industry than in the past, are unlikely to fit in with the company’s practices and beliefs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we liked how talent-driven the industry used to be,” brammer says. “And then it started to be about, ‘Everyone should be able to get a job in games’. We don’t really think like that. The floodgates opened, but now they’re closing again, and there might be some benefit to saying to people: ‘You have to be fucking good to be here, and you have to prove your worth’.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “our team doesn’t love working late, but they do work late and we do crunch. “My mum was a teacher and a headteacher at a school,” he says. ” The more Brammer talks about Bulkhead’s ways of working, the more emphatic he becomes about the virtues of those expectations. And so when game devs are like, ‘I don’t want to work overtime for my 100K salary’? Fuck. But sometimes, when you’re on the eve of releasing a game that keeps you all employed, work’s more important. Respectfully, it’s Californian bullshit. Off. “I’ve never seen someone do so much crunch for barely any money. What we’re saying is that sometimes, yes, life is more important. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa with regard to wardogs itself, brammer believes that the game has been aided by a certain creative absolutism. “A lot of modern business books will say, ‘You want to make sure everyone’s got a voice’, but I think that’s complete bullshit when you’re in a creative endeavour. You want to make sure everyone is heard, but that’s not the same as everyone has a voice. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite this somewhat centralised approach to making games, philpott says bulkhead’s developers will often work across multiple areas of wardogs. We need to detox. ” In return, Brammer says that Bulkhead offers its staff a variety of bonuses and the opportunity to own shares in the company. With the early-access launch of Wardogs behind it, everybody at the studio will also be going on leave for the entire month of December. “We’re going to make sure players know they can fuck off in December,” Brammer says, laughing. “Everyone wears multiple hats, because they can see the path to success with the product. “Everyone has done something that’s not in their job description,” he says. “Go play GTAVI. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for bulkhead’s next steps, there are plans to open a new office in manchester and also to make – in brammer’s words – “more games using our fps technology”. But both he and some of the studio’s other senior figures are also thinking about the future in more philosophical terms. At the very top of its website, Bulkhead provides what is both its company motto and its ostensible mission statement: ‘The next big shooter studio’. Having finally released Wardogs, and seemingly cemented its place among the heights of the FPS genre, there is, for Brammer, a sense that this era of Bulkhead is complete – that the studio can now become something beyond what he’s been building for the past decade.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we’re keen for people who are juniors and mid-level to step into leadership, so the old guard aren’t always running it,” brammer concludes. But I also don’t think that’s what we were really ever chasing. The best thing we can do is put Bulkhead in a position where it doesn’t require us. “I mean, I guess just by default we’re a big shooter studio now. ”.

#1068. Talking Point: As Xbox Celebrates Its 25th Anniversary, What Are Your Hopes For The Next 25 Years?

📅 15 Nov 2026

Talking Point: As Xbox Celebrates Its 25th Anniversary, What Are Your Hopes For The Next 25 Years?

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.purexbox.com/features/talking-point-as-xbox-celebrates-its-25th-anniversary-what-are-your-hopes-for-the-next-25-years

Maybe we'll be looking back on this in 2051!.

Berdasarkan laporan, the celebrations for xbox's official 25th anniversary roll on! we've finally arrived at november 15th, which marks the exact date when the original xbox launched all the way back in 2001. How time flies!.

Of course, this is a great chance to reflect on everything that's happened over the past 25 years, which we've been doing in various articles throughout the month (and indeed the year), but it's also an opportunity to think about the next 25 years and where Xbox as a brand might be headed in the future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think the cynical view, and perhaps the logical view, is that xbox won't exist by the time we get to 2051. Let's not forget that PlayStation was still in its infancy 25 years ago, SEGA had just got out of the console business after being a major player for so long, and Nintendo hadn't even released the GameCube in North America until November 18th of 2001.

Feature 25 Years Later, How Many Of These Original Xbox Launch Titles Have You Played?.

From the original North American launch on November 15, 2001.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in other words, 25 years is a very long time, and we've seen many ups and downs from xbox throughout its history. The glory days of Halo, Xbox Live and the Xbox 360 were followed up by a horribly botched Xbox One launch, and the Xbox Series era has been summed up as everything from extremely promising to extremely disappointing, now hovering somewhere in the 'cautiously optimistic' territory for some Xbox fans since Asha Sharma took the helm earlier in 2026.

Berdasarkan laporan, while console sales might be down, and the xbox ceo keeps talking about a need to "return to growth", there's every reason to believe xbox might still be a powerhouse in 25 years' time. Microsoft's backing is obviously a big aspect of that — assuming the brand never gets sold off — but so is the mountain of incredible first-party IP (Minecraft, Call of Duty, World of Warcraft, etc. ) that should continue to rake in money over the next decade at least, coupled with the ability to innovate in the hardware space and eventually win back some market share with handhelds and consoles.

Berdasarkan laporan, realistically, the answer to all of this is that we don't have an answer - it's impossible to predict a future that's still 25 years out, especially when xbox's mission statement appears to have changed on an almost yearly basis during the 2020s. There's no doubt that Xbox will face many challenges in the 25 years that are ahead and it'll be forced to adapt and innovate along the way, but I wouldn't be surprised if we're still talking about it in 2051!.

For what it's worth, here's what Xbox boss Asha Sharma said on this topic a few days ago:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "while modern games demonstrate the heights of human craft in ways unimaginable just decades ago, the cost, resources, and risk required to create them have grown just as dramatically. For decades, this has been the unavoidable tradeoff of ambition. And our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today’s games as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is from its first entry in 1982. A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars. As a result, too many ideas never become games, and too many games fall short of what their creators imagined. ] A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. We must change this. [. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "i believe the future of gaming will look more like its beginning, when a small team with a big idea could change how the world plays. Our responsibility is to deliver great games, unmistakable hardware, and give more people the chance to make something the world has never seen. ".

Talking Point As Xbox Celebrates 25 Years, What's Your First Ever Xbox Memory?.

News Asha Sharma Issues Statement On Xbox's 25th Anniversary And The Future Of Gaming.

"Our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today’s games".

#1069. How to get the Mini Miku Sprite in Fortnite

📅 15 Nov 2026

How to get the Mini Miku Sprite in Fortnite

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/how-to-get-the-mini-miku-sprite-in-fortnite/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the mini miku sprite is now available in fortnite treasure hunters, and you can now add it to your collection. Like all previously released Sprites, the Mini Miku Sprite has special variants and unique in-game abilities.

Without further ado, let’s find out how to get the Sprite and how it works.

Diungkapkan bahwa unlike most sprites in the game, there is a guaranteed drop spot for mini miku. First, head to Friendship Villa, which is located in the north of the island. There, you will have to interact with Hatsune Miku, who allows you to select a new Sprite.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this is the easiest way to collect the sprite. Aside from the method mentioned above, you can also find Mini Miku from the wild. Try opening as many chests as possible to have higher chances. You can also try your luck at the Vault since the Rare Chests have better chances at providing you with the Sprite.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you want to find the fortune, cursed, or gold variants, the method remains the same. Their odds are significantly less that the base variant.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can spawn a shield bubble around you and your allies. However, you and your buddies will have to perform an emote together to do so. This makes the Sprite truly unique since I can’t remember any other variant that has such requirements.

The Fortune, Cursed, and Gold variants all offer the same base effect, but you get additional in-game abilities from them to trigger.

#1070. Persona 6 Gets A New Domain Update, Prompting Game Awards Rumors

📅 15 Nov 2026

Persona 6 Gets A New Domain Update, Prompting Game Awards Rumors

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/persona-6-might-be-appearing-at-the-game-awards-after-all/

Berdasarkan laporan, ever since persona 6 was first revealed back in june, fans have been eagerly awaiting any details about the highly anticipated sequel. While Persona hasn't exactly been short on spinoffs and remakes in the 9 years since the release of Persona 5, it's still a far cry from the full-blown original entry that fans have been dreaming of for years now.

Following a disappointing series of teases and trailer reposts, however, a recent discovery by one dedicated fan has been making waves in the community for possibly hinting at a brand-new trailer reveal sometime in the next month.

First discovered by Reddit user ronakwya, who has been tracking Atlus' public domain certifications, the studio recently updated their domain for none other than Persona 6 just a few days ago.

While this doesn't really mean much on its own, the post details how not only do the domain certifications used by Atlus let them "build a massive website makeover behind closed doors before making it live," but that the exact same thing happened to the newly inspired Persona 4 Revival one month before its first major gameplay trailer dropped.

Persona 6 looks like it might be bringing back the spooky vibes, but not everyone is trusting Atlus just yet.

Combined with the fact that the 2026 Game Awards are just about a month away at this point, the newest update is offering even more support that Persona 6 will not only appear at this year's showcase, but that it could even be the first look at a new mainline Persona game in nearly a decade.

Although The Game Awards is filled with some tough competition for world premieres and extended looks at upcoming games, it's hard to imagine many titles that could beat out Persona 6 in terms of sheer player popularity, with the event having the perfect audience size for such a massive and highly anticipated gameplay reveal.

Given that Persona 6's first teaser also came not long after its protagonist and cast were supposedly leaked, a new gameplay trailer wouldn't be too unexpected as a way to distract fans from the inadvertently confirmed Persona 1 remake that dropped at the start of November alongside the new anniversary merchandise.

Diungkapkan bahwa welcome to disk cleanup, our regular weekend feature delving into the pcs of pc gaming luminaries. Come back every weekend to read a new interview, digging into the important questions, like "How tidy is your desktop?" and "What game will you never uninstall?".

Sebagaimana diketahui, stuart ashen—better known by his youtube persona ashens—grew up on a diet of 8-bit games on consoles like the atari 2600 and the spectrum. Hated Syndicate Wars. "Ended up giving it to a friend who loved it … I think I went on to Duke Nukem 3D or something. Never got on with it at all," he says. The earliest PC game he recalls playing was Syndicate Wars on his first home-built rig—a Pentium 200 MMX machine housed in a server tower case: "I loved Syndicate. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa alongside his video work, ashens is currently making a folk horror film told in reverse. But he hit pause on production to guide me through the haunted arcade of his PC. "Unfortunately, it's far enough away from release that there's no point plugging it," he says. We talked DOS fighting games, the problem with rangers in RPGs, and the worst retro game Ashens has ever played.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm currently playing gloomhaven, the digital version of the board game, for the second time. I put about 150 hours into it, then sort of left it, and I've come back to it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's kind of fantastic. I love board games, but Gloomhaven is one I didn't think I would ever play, because I know it takes two hours to set up or something. When the computer is taking control of all the bits and bobs, you can play it on your own in the background while you're doing other things and waiting for stuff. That’s going to get a lot of time from me.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's all team-based. It's all your standard band of different [fantasy] archetypes together, and then after they reach a certain level, that's not true. When they do a certain personal quest thing, which can be a pain in the arse for various reasons, they retire, and then you can replace them with other ones you've unlocked. So the team basically changes, and the whole dynamic changes over time, which is something that's really kept me interested.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the previous game would have been baldur's gate 3, and it is still installed. I should uninstall it for two reasons. One, it takes up a lot of space, and two, I might start playing it and it will eat all my spare time again. Because, yeah, I got kind of obsessed.

From the creators of Edge: A free weekly videogame industry newsletter, featuring in-depth news, expert analysis and exclusive interviews.

Berdasarkan laporan, to give you an idea, i'm now on 350 hours on gloomhaven, but 927 on baldur's gate. Probably a good 50 to 100 hours of that is just sitting in the background [but] it's so far ahead of any other game I've played in terms of hours, it's unbelievable.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i've never played a larian game [before], and i didn't like the early baldur's gate games. I got the first one free with a graphics card. I remember opening the graphics card box and about 14 discs fell out. I was so excited to play it and I could not get on with the combat. It was that weird, sort of issue commands and pause and do things. It just didn't do anything for me, and I thought, "Oh, that's disappointing. " After a couple of hours, I never came back to it.

Berdasarkan laporan, and then i saw something about baldur's gate 3—because i wasn't interested in it at all for obvious reasons, and it just had that spark to it of, "hang on, there's something special going on here, with the writing of that. " And then I saw they changed the combat to turn based, and I was like, "Right, sign me up. ".

I bought it, installed it, started playing it, and that was the only thing I played probably for two and a half, three years.

Diungkapkan bahwa this isn't one i played a lot—we have this because we were streaming it. But it's Street Fighter for DOS from 1988.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's entirely different to the arcade version, i think it's got more in common with the weird commodore 64 version. But basically, we were going through, on stream, every single DOS fighting game, and it's pretty bad. But weirdly, not as bad as a lot of them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, dos fighting games are, like, for every good one, there's five really bad ones and one that you can't believe they'd charge money for. It barely works. But God, the DOS ones! It was like they saw Mortal Kombat but absolutely did not understand Mortal Kombat. I love fighting games, so it's always interesting to see these obscure ones we haven't heard of. So you've just got teenagers dancing around in front of a camcorder, badly digitised, and some Christ-awful game engine that just does not work fundamentally.

Sebagaimana diketahui, then again, the arcade game is awful for the first street fighter. Or trying to, because the controls are not quite there for Street Fighter 1. Even in the arcade, it's all about learning the special moves and repeating them over and over. There's just not really much of a game to it. I think that's got to be one of the biggest improvements in history, from Street Fighter 1 to Street Fighter 2.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think i [initially] did a ranger. It probably wasn't the optimal build, but it did actually work. It felt better in Baldur's Gate 3. I do like the ranged bow combat, and I'm always interested in why they never get it right. In EverQuest, it was the [class] that could dish a lot of damage and yet couldn't take any. I'm always interested in Rangers in RPGs, because they're never implemented very well. It was just noticeably inferior …. Is it just nobody likes Rangers, but they feel they have to put them in anyway?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i didn't go dark urge until the second playthrough, not really understanding what it was at the time, obviously. OK, yes, it's even better now. And then I was informed after, "Oh, you should try that. " And I'm like, "Oh, this is what the game was written for. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, it's absolutely incredible. Writing, performance, everything is a step above anything that had come before, I think. And the combat is so much fun, which obviously is super important because that's a huge percentage of it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that is command & conquer 3: kane's wrath. It's almost a comfort thing. I only do it once maybe every couple of months, but I'll always leave it installed for that reason. Because sometimes, if I've got 10 minutes spare, I'll just quickly start up a skirmish map on it, just a simple 1v1, and see how quickly I can win, and that's it. Plus, by today's standards, it doesn't take up much room.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i think i like the skirmish better in 3, due to the variety of all the bits and bobs in it. It's probably not the tightest of the games in the series. But for me, that's the one I always enjoyed the most.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's a little window, and you type in the name of any file on your pc, and it's already indexed them, and it instantly appears with where they all are, and you can easily narrow things down. The amount of files I've given stupid names to, or put in the wrong folder that I've just found immediately because of this. Life changing. It's fundamentally changed the way I work.

Berdasarkan laporan, oh dear. So I have icons turned off on the desktop. I'm going to turn them back on, if I can remember how.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fuck! i'm turning that off. That's pretty bad. Oh no, that's not good. Oh God! How do I turn them off? Oh God, it's horrible.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's just two 4k monitors entirely covered in icons and stuff. Because I don't use the desktop at all, so I just let it auto install things there and forget about it. I've got a little program called RocketDock, which keeps the useful things on the side of one of the monitors, and that's it. I've not looked at the actual desktop in years, and it is monstrous.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one i only briefly played back in the day, and then something made me play it again on stream, and it was so much better than i remembered, [is] moonstone for the amiga. But it's a really interesting game. It's also beautifully designed, with really nice artwork and sound. No other game quite has the vibe of it. It's like a hack 'n' slash-y, brawler type thing, but with a lot of RPG elements. Not to say it's the best game ever or anything, but it's still very bloody good.

Berdasarkan laporan, what is the worst overall? oh man, there's so many bad ones. This isn't the worst. It's totally unplayable. So they're all weird things moving around and the frame rate is monstrous. It's an Amiga game, and literally the characters are vectors. It's like three frames a second. But of course, due to the way they didn't really have the processing power back then, these vectors look like the Keep Britain Tidy logo. There's one called, which we keep talking about [on stream], Graeme Souness Vector Soccer. I'm just going to mention it because it's great. Nobody seems to know if there's a good game under the hood or not.

Berdasarkan laporan, i think for absolute worst, it's got to be sqij! and it's for the spectrum. There are versions for other computers that are perfectly competent. But the Spectrum one was written by a man, or a boy at the time, bless him, called Jason Creighton, who really didn't want to fucking write it or work at that company again. They just loaded it, went 'Oh, that loads. So he just spat out something absolutely awful that basically is borderline unplayable, sent it to them, and they just didn't bother looking at it. ' Put it on tape, out it goes.

#1073. 10 Games That Have Creative Punishments for Cheating

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Games That Have Creative Punishments for Cheating

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/games-that-have-creative-punishments-for-cheating/

Sebagaimana diketahui, shane is a contributor for dualshockers writing guides and other materials. He has a degree in Game Design and Criticism.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’ll come as no surprise to any gamer that pretty much every game has a way to cheat, whether it's approved by the developers or otherwise. Over the years there have been some pretty creative and hilarious ways that developers have dealt with cheaters in all kinds of games from FPS games to the cozy ones.

Berdasarkan laporan, while a lot of the punishments for cheating in more recent years are typical things like warnings or outright bans, there are some that take a more creative approach. Whether it’s a fun way to kill the player or an incredibly punishing turn of events for dark deeds, it’s always funny to see that happen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this list consists of many games from all sorts of genres and ages, but they all have some interesting and hilarious punishments for what they perceive as cheating. It may not always be altering game files and could just be something players are able to abuse in game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, way back in 1996 crusader: no regret came out following in the footsteps of its predecessor crusader: no remorse. The isometric gameplay combined with some great weapons and destructive environments made a very engaging combination.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the only problem was if you played the previous game and attempted to use any cheats from the last game crusader: no regret would have something to say about it. Players would be greeted with a message and teleported into a room with eight copies of the final boss.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, heretic was created using the doom engine, but things were a bit mixed up and instead of the traditional doom world this one was steeped in fantasy elements. Everything revolved around the fantasy element as players could use magical weapons like the Elven Wand, and Phoenix Rod.

Berdasarkan laporan, unfortunately for players who were well educated in the ways of doom, the developers had a surprise for anyone hoping to use doom cheats. Inserting the cheat for God Mode would instantly kill players, and the all weapons cheat would instead reduce you to using just a wooden staff.

Diungkapkan bahwa with the recent remaster of ocarina of time there’s a lot of great details in the legend of zelda series coming to light. Some are just fun little tidbits or small things, but in Link’s Awakening the dev team decided to make things a little harder for anyone doing nefarious things with Link.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, link can steal some items from a shopkeeper by distracting him and then grabbing the items to take outside. Not only does doing this ruin Link’s reputation earning him the mark of thief by any other NPCs, that shopkeeper will also kill Link to settle the debt.

Activision is drawing a line in the sand against third party lobby shopping apps, threatening bans outright.

Sebagaimana diketahui, traditional mmos typically don’t play too well with cheaters, resulting in all kinds of punishments, but one mmo really stands out, eve online. This old school MMORPG is all about space battles and exploration in its entirely player driven world.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during a gm week event there were public executions of cheaters who had been caught and the team opened up the destruction of these ships to any players who wanted to join. This turned it into an incredible spectacle that many will not soon forget.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the sims series is probably one of the most prolific gaming franchises on the planet, being enjoyed by a huge demographic of people. Even in these cute games people try to cheat and The Sims devs were not going to let that slide even on the DS.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you attempted to use the internal system clock to skip time forward the game would notice and spawn an alien invasion that would cause a lot of problems. They become a persistent problem in the game and could require players to restart the game.

To combat rampant cheating, BULKHEAD implements ping locks to keep certain regions out of main servers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cd projekt red are known for their storytelling and incredible game design, but they don’t just stop being amazing there. While the devs respect when players are able to find something they hadn’t accounted for they didn’t stop them from doing it, they just got a bit creative.

Diungkapkan bahwa when the witcher 3 originally came out there was an exploit that would let you kill cows in the starter area indefinitely giving you crazy amounts of money. To fix that they simply spawned a giant late game monster, a Chort, that would likely kill players as a punishment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there’s nothing quite like finding out a classic game has punishments for attempted cheating, and pokemon ruby and sapphire is no exception. Despite being a game for mostly young people they weren’t going to stand by and let someone cheat in their game.

Diungkapkan bahwa pokemon, of course, has a way to mess with players who were able to manipulate game code although it's a bit different from others on the list. Instead of anything dangerous the game would spawn a Bad Egg in a box that cannot be moved creating an issue with inventory for the rest of the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, cheat codes in games have been around for longer than most gamers, so a lot of early games allowed players to put them in. Now just like some other games, they want to encourage you to still play the regular way and have to get a bit more creative about punishments.

Sebagaimana diketahui, banjo-kazooie took this to an extreme and offered players the ability to put in forbidden codes doing all kinds of silly things. If you put in too many Gruntilda will threaten to erase your save file, making this a very dangerous gamble if you aren’t careful.

A config exploit is helping losers disconnect from Marvel Rivals matches without penalties.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, edmund can’t ever do something in half measures and mewgenics is more than proof of that in almost every aspect. The game took a lot of things to extremes and dealing with cheaters is no exception.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you tried to save-scum, quitting out of something quickly to reload a previous save, the game would know and you’d meet steven. The first time you do this in a run he gives you a warning, but if you continue to do it you’ll no longer have control of the game and Steven will make all the choices.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, not many games have the sense of humor that the stanley parable has and this, of course, has to extend beyond the metaness of the game. This hilarious narrative game wants you to focus on the order of events and not have you screw that all up.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if a player attempts to use console cheats the game takes notice and sends them to the serious room where the narrator has some choice words for them. Continuing to do it only makes the punishment longer and more ridiculous, much like everything in the game.

From giant heads to low gravity, these are the PS2 Games That Had the Most Ridiculous Cheat Codes — and Why Players Still Miss Them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, slay the spire 2 has a new character—notably, a new character in testing—and as the patch notes themselves point out, that testing will very much be needed: "we expect to make a great number of content and balance changes before the fool is ready for the main branch. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, i decided to hop into the beta branch myself and take her for a whirl, and—yeah, those changes'll have to come. The Fool's central mechanic is her bow and arrow—she can fire an arrow/shoot card to deal damage equal to the card's base damage plus her aim. So if a shoot card deals 15 damage and she has six aim stocked, she'll deal 21.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is a little busted, because by default, the fool has 6 aim already put in her bank. Her non-strike starter card, Foolish Shot, already deals a hefty 15 damage for just one energy. With aim, the first time she uses it, it deals a whopping 21 damage, which is a heck of a damage output for the Fool's first round of combat.

Berdasarkan laporan, the saving grace here is that when a card that fires an arrow is used, that arrow becomes lodged in a target, who gains the impale status. You can't play any more arrow-based cards until you either Dislodge (another game term, hence the proper nounage) an arrow with a card that dislodges, or until you have more than one arrow.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in my runs, i wasn't able to figure out the latter. But I really didn't need to, because I was one-shotting bosses the whole way up the spire. One card in particular, Repeat Shot, seems borderline broken. While it is a rare, it shoots a target for 20 damage (when upgraded) X times, plus your current aim.

Diungkapkan bahwa with precious little setup, i was casually knocking (or should i say nocking) out around 78 damage on turn one just by having the card pop into my hand. Add even a little aim generation to your deck, and Repeat Shot solves single-target fights for you. By making them dead.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are some other interesting mechanics, too, such as a trio of melodies you can activate and trigger other cards off of. Wah Blast, for instance, hits twice if you've got a Cho or Ki melody active. There's also Stretch, which gives you extra block on the usage of your next block card, Sadness, a status card that can be turned into Joy which gives you energy and card draw, and tarot cards via a power called Mythic Form.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Sebagaimana diketahui, obviously, she's broken. I absolutely shouldn't be one-card tapping bosses on Act 1 just because I happened to first-turn draw into a single rare card. But she is already very fun, and I look forward to seeing what more balanced version of The Fool will look like in the full game.

Diungkapkan bahwa other than that, the testing branch now has two new modes: blitz, a more bite-sized version where there's no map or gold, and dread, which appears to be an ascension+ mode for masochists. Could never be me.

#1079. Eternal Sword Pact tier list (November 2026) - Which class should you pick?

📅 15 Nov 2026

Eternal Sword Pact tier list (November 2026) - Which class should you pick?

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/eternal-sword-pact/tier-list/

Berdasarkan laporan, no matter how hard developers try, it's very difficult to balance every class. Eternal Sword Pact is no different, and our tier list will tell you which came out of the oven a little too hot.

Berdasarkan laporan, updated on november 15th, 2026 - version: 6. 3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, inspired by the shan hai jing, a chinese text known in english as the classic of mountains and seas, eternal sword pact is an mmorpg featuring massive guild vs. Guild battles. The action takes place in a vast open world filled with characters inspired by mythology.

Players take on the role of the Demon Lord and embark on a journey across mountains and seas to unite the Demon Clan and defeat the mighty Demon God, Xie.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, eternal sword pact includes many classic mmo elements such as tactical combat, familiars, pvp, customisation, and a couple system. Of course, the game also features several classes, each with various skills and abilities.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are four available classes, and if you're not sure which one to choose, we've got you covered with our eternal sword pact tier list. In this article, you'll discover the strengths and weaknesses of each class, as well as how they perform in different situations.

But before we dive in, why not check out our Eternal Sword Pact code list? These redeem codes grant useful rewards like ingots and gems, so don't miss out.

With that said, let's jump into our Eternal Sword Pact tier list.

Diungkapkan bahwa dragon lancer is a powerful warrior specialised in fire-based attacks. It is both the perfect class for beginners and the top-ranked class in our Eternal Sword Pact tier list, as it deals massive damage, has strong durability, and is extremely fast. Its skills are effective for both single-target and AoE combat, allowing it to perform well in the middle of battle.

Berdasarkan laporan, on the other hand, dragon lancer does have a few weaknesses. Since its element is Fire, it is vulnerable to Water and Ice, so be careful when fighting these types of enemies. Although the class is quite fast, it needs to be at close range, which can be risky and may not suit players who prefer to stay safe in the back.

Overall, Dragon Lancer truly shines in boss fights, against elite enemies, and in PvP.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, spiritfox is a graceful class that uses floral magic attacks. This mage can also transform, becoming even stronger when it is in the heart of battle. It uses an umbrella to fight, deals strong damage, and excels at mid-range. Its burst damage is excellent, allowing it to take out groups of enemies quickly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, be careful when playing spiritfox, though. It has relatively low health, so it's safer to stay at mid-range, especially when the mage is not transformed. Even though its skills are powerful, they can be a bit slow to cast, so this class requires some practice to master.

Once mastered, Spiritfox shines in both PvE and PvP.

Diungkapkan bahwa lunarborn is an archer class, so it's designed for ranged combat. Its bow deals solid damage while keeping it safe at the back, and its skills can be used for both single enemies and groups. It is a very safe and easy class to play, making it a good pick for beginners.

Diungkapkan bahwa of course, it has some obvious weaknesses. It also needs some space to move properly, which can sometimes be tricky. Lunarborn needs to stay away from the frontline due to its playstyle, so close-range combat should be avoided. Finally, it may take a while for him to defeat stronger enemies.

Lunarborn shines in PvE against groups of enemies, especially early in the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa sword sage is a swordsman class focused on melee combat and combos. It is actually a very strong class, wielding a blade and using Frost-based skills. Its versatility allows it to be effective against both single enemies and groups, and it can summon a shield to protect itself and its allies. It is also a fast class.

So, why is it ranked so low on our Eternal Sword Pact tier list? Because this class is difficult to master.

Diungkapkan bahwa first of all, it must stay in close range, making it more dangerous to play than mage classes. Its damage is lower than that of the Dragon Lancer, and it requires perfect timing. And that concludes our Eternal Sword Pact tier list! All of these classes are really fun to play and powerful, so before choosing, you should consider your preferred playstyle. Once mastered, Sword Sage shines in most fights, both for dealing damage to enemies and protecting allies. Don't forget that some classes are harder to master than others.

We've also got a few other lists for you to peruse, including a Legend of Elements tier list and MU: Pocket Knights tier list.

#1080. 8 Long JRPGs That Are Best Played in Switch 2 Handheld Mode

📅 15 Nov 2026

8 Long JRPGs That Are Best Played in Switch 2 Handheld Mode

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/long-jrpgs-that-are-best-played-in-switch-2-handheld-mode/

Sebagaimana diketahui, murillo zerbinatto is a jrpg enthusiast, writer, and editor. He has played over 300 RPGs during his gaming career, with 90% of them being JRPGs.

Berdasarkan laporan, many jrpgs are long by nature, whether because of seamless exploration, a narrative packed with colorful dialogue, or a post-game that increases our playtime considerably. The more adulthood knocks at the door, the less time we have to dedicate to our favorite hobby, and well, if that hobby involves playing JRPGs as mine does, you know you are in a bind.

As we approach the end of 2026, our lives are going to get even busier as the days pass, so why not add a hundred hour adventure or two to the mix?.

Diungkapkan bahwa one way to keep up with jrpgs is to buy a handheld console, which is becoming increasingly common. To ensure you have a packed catalog that gets new games every day, nothing beats having a Switch 2 at home. So, keeping portability, comfort, and time constraints in mind, I gathered some of the longest JRPGs best played in Switch 2 handheld mode.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when final fantasy xiv was first announced for switch 2, i was like: okay, neat! more ways to play. MMORPGs are, almost by nature, a repetitive endeavor, with dailies, beast tribe quests, crafting, gathering, events, and whatnot. Then, a friend of mine started the Free Trial, and it hit me after he shared his experience. As someone who has played the MMORPG for 13 years on PlayStation consoles, starting on PS3, I couldn't grasp the full potential of that announcement. Doing all that in handheld mode? It is the Will of the Light.

Diungkapkan bahwa ffxiv runs very well on switch 2, so it's worth it even for veterans or those just starting out. Grinding was never this satisfying. The only caveat is that you have to buy the base game plus expansions again and pay a separate monthly subscription using a token made by Nintendo. But once you surpass these hurdles, portable Eorzea awaits.

Diungkapkan bahwa i did a reverse process that left me a bit spoiled: i played persona 5 before playing persona 3, the portable version. That left me a bit tired of Tartarus, which felt too repetitive, even though I understood it was a product of its era. Persona 3 Reload improved the Tartarus dungeon crawling by removing random encounters and adding gimmicks like changing dungeon rules and even Shuffle Time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before each full moon in persona 3, there is a bunch of downtime, just evolving social links, doing daily chores, and increasing your protagonist's stats. They are all a joy to watch, but since they are less heavy-loaded than the main story, you can easily enjoy them wherever you want to take your Switch 2 and just enjoy handheld mode.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i remember perfectly when i started playing dragon quest xi and assumed i liked the slime franchise more than final fantasy. Still, Dragon Quest XI is so spectacular and such a stunning evolution of the Dragon Quest formula that I fell in love immediately. After advancing a bit further, I realized I still like Final Fantasy more. DQXI mixes the simplicity and classic feel of its predecessors while modernizing and expanding all features and mechanics, making it the most ambitious title ever made in the series.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, like every dragon quest, the jrpg features many, many side objectives, exploration, collectibles, and of course, a robust post-game. To this day, I don't know if Act 3 is canonical or post-game, but either way, expect hundreds of hours simply to complete the main campaign and much more if you want to do everything. And there is nothing better than doing all of that on Switch 2.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, normally, i'd recommend trails in the sky 1st chapter and 2nd chapter, because they are flawless jrpgs remakes that will guarantee you hundreds of hours of playtime. However, considering I have already recommended them countless times, and in the hope that some of you heeded my call, the next step would be to go to the next arc, Crossbell, featured in the duology Trails from Zero and Trails to Azure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, coincidentally, both recently received a switch 2 version, adding more quality-of-life features and visual upgrades. I recognize that the whiplash of coming from a full-fledged remake like the Trails in the Sky versions to the graphical style of Zero and Azure can be a bit shocking, but hear me out: if you don't mind that and manage to finish both, reaching the ending of Trails to Azure, your mind will be blown away, trust me. Plus, there is never a wrong time to meet the members of the Special Support Section.

Diungkapkan bahwa for when an open world feels like too much. Check out these JRPGs that don't feature an open world.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the biggest criticisms i read about fire emblem: fortune's weave was its runtime. Players are loving Nintendo's tactical JRPG, but constantly complain that even after 100 hours, it still doesn't feel close to the end. Honestly, it seems to me that this protest is not because they are not having fun or are tired of the game, but because Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave came out in a period packed with other games, and well, you want to play it all.

Berdasarkan laporan, but forget about that. There is no time limit on your fun, so just grab your weapons, choose your route, and enjoy your protagonist's story. Fortune's Weave introduces emblematic gameplay changes, freshening up the whole loop while still keeping elements Fire Emblem fans have learned to love and appreciate.

Diungkapkan bahwa honestly, i could put any xenoblade chronicles here, and it would fit. All of the games received, or will receive in the case of Xenoblade Chronicles 3, an enhanced version for the Nintendo Switch 2 that even added new content. And while all of them feature an immense open world you can explore from the get-go, if you want to play more leisurely in handheld mode, Xenoblade Chronicles X is the way to go.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, xenoblade chronicles x also has plenty of story and characters to get to know, but director tetsuya takahashi said his goal in creating the game was to test the wii u's technological capabilities with a gigantic world. And the madman did it. You will certainly spend much, much more time doing side content, installing probes, facing Nemeses, and flying around with your Skells than on the main story. And do you know the best way to do so? Yes, Switch 2 full-armed handheld mode.

Diungkapkan bahwa metaphor: refantazio, just like many atlus games, is an effortlessly long jrpg. With its calendar system, every day brings a new activity, keeping the experience fresh and engaging us without us even noticing. Then, whenever I got tired of roaming around a new city, I could go hunt some monsters, tackle a new dungeon, or watch some impressive story beats unfold in this political race.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the entire design of metaphor: refantazio is highly gripping, and i was completely consumed by the jrpg without even seeing the hours go by. Come to think of it, maybe suggesting playing Metaphor in handheld mode is a bit dangerous, because if I lost track of hours sitting in an uncomfortable chair, imagine if I could play it on my Switch 2 lying in bed with the air conditioning on. Okay, scratch that, too fun, too dangerous.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in its most recent fiscal report, square enix showed great profits and dedicated much of that success to the performance of final fantasy vii rebirth on switch 2. I understand that in terms of visual quality and performance the JRPG leaves a bit to be desired on Switch 2 compared to other platforms, but in overall experience, gameplay, and comfort, it certainly triumphs. The sprawling open world of Rebirth becomes much more practical when played in handheld mode, especially if you are hunting down minigame trophies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what took me the longest for the final fantasy vii rebirth platinum was getting high scores in a bunch of chocobo minigames, cactuar crush with aerith, and of course, chadley's challenges. That was because I had to stay glued to my TV on my PS5, whereas if I had done it on the couch, all leisurely while watching my son play or my wife watch another K-Drama, the experience would certainly have been much more pleasant. Mind you, story-related moments and cutscenes should have your full attention, especially during the Gold Saucer!.

Where do you even begin with JRPGs? These titles will provide a gentler welcome for newcomers.
