Berdasarkan laporan, you are at, i don't know, some sort of family dining experience. On the stage, there is a magician. There is a stage. "Don't show me, don't show me", exclaims the sorcerer. There is a dramatic pause, and then he reveals—from his own pocket—your card. You are called up, and made to select a card from a deck of 52. Polite applause.

Diungkapkan bahwa he keeps going: from his other pocket, your wallet. The magician removes his mask—he is you, and you are your wife. From his shirt, your wedding ring. Under his hat, your pet hamster, clutching in its teeth a love letter you wrote to your wife when you were first dating. Also, throughout this process, someone has given you a backpack and keeps adding exotic hammers to it.

This is what playing Queen's Domain feels like.

Diungkapkan bahwa developed, somehow, by a team of two developers, queen's domain is a game of constant discoveries. From the moment you wash ashore on the Isle of Neasied, the game just keeps unfurling. It is like some monstrous origami—you unfold one part only to find within it 10 more seemingly impossible sub-folds. Within those? You know it, baby: sub-sub-folds. We are through the looking glass here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all of queen's domain's levels are riddled with crevices, crannies, nooks, and hideaways. Going through them is an experience in seeing some distant ledge, suspiciously flat bit of wall, or oddly aligned geometry and asking yourself "Could I…?" You can. You almost always can, and the game's levels reward your ingenuity and curiosity with new weapons, stat buffs, and strange encounters with stranger NPCs.

Diungkapkan bahwa sometimes you unlock whole new regions. Sometimes this is not good. Requiescat in pace to all those who fell down a well and found themselves stranded forever in a beautiful but deadly zone they were approximately 40 levels too underpowered for.

Berdasarkan laporan, it is the best dark souls 1 since dark souls 1: unforgiving but almost never unfair, except when being unfair would be funny, and forever dazzling you with masterstrokes of interwoven level design. 16 hours in and hacking my way through a major dungeon, I pulled a lever only to open a door that spat me out right at the game's starting area. I suspect a cross-section of this game's goliath, entwined map would make for a killer bit of wall art.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, also, you kill like a billion things. Neasied and its sub-environs are filled with freaky creatures—including a fun screeching loot goblin—and it's up to you to put an end to them, which you do via the mechanism of your heaving sack of wunderwaffen. Here is where I warn you, reader: you might be a bit put off by the way Queen's Domain's combat functions at first.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it starts out stiff, stubborn, and idiosyncratic. Even basic enemies take a while to kill and you don't yet have all the tools to deal with them, mobility included. Meanwhile, mechanics like damage being commensurate with your stamina and every single enemy having a rock-paper-scissors-esque relationship to the game's damage types (they're weak to one, neutral to another, and resistant to a third) gives you a whole lot to think about as you try to figure out how to position yourself and swap between weapons without getting murdered.

Berdasarkan laporan, stick with it. It's the Morrowind thing: you need that first half hour (and it really is barely more than that) of struggle to appreciate the way your power scales as you unlock new weapons, acquire more abilities, and—most important—your understanding of the game deepens.

Berdasarkan laporan, and if that doesn't tempt you, how about this: you like pokémon? because it's pokémon, except your pokémon are spears and clubs and mauls. You level every weapon independently from your own character level, and when they get high enough, a lot of them literally evolve, like Squirtle, into something new and weird.

At one point in my playthrough, I got stuck in an area for like three hours (I missed something obvious), and didn't even mind; it gave me time to level all three of the game's starting weapons into their bizarre, magical final forms.

Berdasarkan laporan, i tell you, nothing has smitten me in 2026 like this. It is undoubtedly my personal game of the year, and it might be the first time I've felt that magic I first felt 13 years ago, ensconced in a first-year university flat, playing Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition on my PC for the first time.

#1082. Sonic 06 Is Now Playable On PC Thanks to Fans

📅 15 Nov 2026

Sonic 06 Is Now Playable On PC Thanks to Fans

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/sonic-the-hedgehog-2006-pc-port/

There are a lot of contenders for the 'worst' Sonic game: Sega's bizarre attempt at Mario Party with Sonic Shuffle; the missed opportunity of Sonic Forces and its custom character; or maybe the Kinect-exclusive Sonic Free Riders—but none are quite so infamous as Sonic 06.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and yet, for its 20th anniversary, fans have painstakingly worked to bring what the community calls "the worst sonic game in history" to pc, ending its two-decade streak of xbox 360 and ps3 exclusivity. Now, an entirely new audience can revisit this reviled corner of the Blue Blur's gaming legacy and leave just as annoyed and confused.

Berdasarkan laporan, marathon recompiled version 1. Typical recomp and emulation boilerplate; lest they risk the wrath of Sega lawyers. 0 launched on November 14, but as the team explains, you must provide your own legally acquired Xbox 360 copy to install the game. And no, I'm not talking about Takayuki Yagami.

You have to respect the dedication of Sonic fans to recompile what is widely regarded as the worst game in the entire franchise, but what's really impressive about Marathon Recompiled is that it's not another heap of vibecoded slop regurgitated by AI bros.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "marathon recompiled is an unofficial pc port of the xbox 360 version of sonic the hedgehog (2006) created through the process of static recompilation," the github description reads, citing ga2mer as the project's creator, isaac marovitz and squidbus as graphics programmers, hyper as developer of system level features—like achievement support—rei-san and desko as the developers behind several quality-of-life patches, ljstar as the project logo designer, and a number of others for localization. Crucially - no Claude credit.

Berdasarkan laporan, you might've noticed in that lineup that a couple of the devs worked on quality of life patches, but that doesn't mean that the game's original bugs have been patched out. Instead, bugs present on original hardware have been "intentionally preserved"—the idea is to archive Sonic's history, not sanitize it.

Berdasarkan laporan, with that being said, there are optional settings that can be enabled in the configuration file to patch several of the xbox 360 version's bugs and "other annoyances" if you so choose. Otherwise, the default experience strives to be as close to the original version as possible, and as such, bug reports that note issues present on original hardware will be rejected.

Bizarrely, Sonic X Shadow Generations producer Shun Nakamura wants to remake Sonic 06.

Berdasarkan laporan, so, if you download it, expect sonic 06 in all its glitchy glory, with slippery movement, sonic falling through floors, and paradoxically slow and clumsy controls. There's a reason this game has a 46 on Metacritic; to hear GameSpot say it, "Sonic the Hedgehog may share its name with the Genesis original, but this game is even more broken than most of the other recent Sonic games have been. ".

Sonic Unleashed has never come to PC, but this port from a fan might as well be an official release.

Try to land as close as possible, and you'll see the exclamation point diamond shape nearby. Follow it into the shack, and you'll find the map on the floor.

Berdasarkan laporan, the third map fragment, made available on nov. 15, is at Friendship Villa (formerly known as Rubber Resort):.

Berdasarkan laporan, the map is on the west side of the villa, south of the main building in a fenced-off area. Try to land as close as possible, and you'll see the usual quest market exclamation point nearby.

We'll update this guide as more map fragments get added to the game.

#1084. 10 Best Boss Fights in Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Best Boss Fights in Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/best-zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-boss-fights/

Diungkapkan bahwa covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

Alongside its completely revamped visuals and modernized gameplay designed around the Joy-Cons, one of the things I was most excited about when I finally got my hands on The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake was facing its bosses all over again.

Berdasarkan laporan, i've played the original countless times, and there are so many incredible boss fights throughout this adventure that the mere thought of experiencing them again with all these changes was almost too exciting to handle. Thankfully, despite my ridiculously high expectations, it managed to exceed them. Congratulations, Nintendo, all my childhood nightmares have officially been upgraded!.

Some of the original's most charming quirks from Zelda: Ocarina of Time didn't make the journey.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jokes aside, the remake does an incredible job of staying faithful to the original bosses while giving them enough visual and gameplay improvements to make these encounters feel fresh. And honestly, the excitement I felt when entering these arenas was just as strong as it was the first time around. And picking a favorite Ocarina of Time boss is still as difficult as picking just one Zelda game to call your favorite: there are simply too many amazing ones to choose from!.

Berdasarkan laporan, so, i decided to put together a ranking of the ten best boss fights in the new ocarina of time, including a few mini-bosses to make things even more interesting. Let's see which encounters managed to steal the spotlight. Naturally, there are lots of spoilers here if you haven't completed the remake or the original, so beware!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fighting gohma is actually pretty easy, i must say, but there's no denying that she makes a fantastic first impression as ocarina of time's opening boss. This is basically the first real test of your skills, giving you a taste of what's waiting for you throughout the rest of the adventure – and there's something incredibly satisfying about finally defeating your first major enemy.

Berdasarkan laporan, besides, her introduction is absolutely fantastic! you enter what appears to be an empty room, already anticipating the boss encounter because you know something is waiting for you. But there's nothing there. So, naturally, you look up. and surprise! Gohma is crawling across the ceiling, ready to ruin your day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, her imposing size makes the encounter even more memorable, especially when you realize she's trying to give birth to a bunch of smaller spiders just to make your life miserable. Lovely! The remake takes all these elements and makes them even more impressive with its updated visuals, giving Gohma a much more intimidating presence. Not bad for our first big fight.

What's not to love about fighting a giant blob of goo? I'll admit that I never found Morpha particularly exciting in the original game, but the remake completely changed my mind.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of my favorite things about this encounter is how quickly it goes from zero to one hundred. After surviving the Water Temple, you're probably expecting some terrifying aquatic monster, perhaps a giant shark or a creature covered in tentacles. Instead, you walk into the boss arena and find. a blob.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, things get considerably more interesting once the battle begins. Morpha uses its gelatinous body to create enormous tentacles that can grab Link and take a surprisingly painful chunk out of his health. And believe me, they're considerably faster this time around, so you'll want to keep moving.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, falling into the water is also something you should avoid at all costs, since the rest of morpha's body is lurking beneath the surface. It's a surprisingly stressful encounter, but also fun, especially because you have to use the Hookshot to pull Morpha's inner nucleus out of its tentacles and attack it. It's the only boss that requires you to use what is the coolest equipment in the game!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my first encounter with the iron knuckle in the remake was just as terrifying as i remembered it being in the original. This heavily armored enemy hits like a truck, and every successful attack can take a ridiculous amount of Link's health away. Even worse, its powerful strikes can send you flying across the arena, making it incredibly difficult to regain control of the situation.

Berdasarkan laporan, a big part of what makes this encounter so intimidating is that you're facing the iron knuckle as child link. You're considerably weaker than Adult Link, and you don't have access to the powerful equipment and abilities you've grown accustomed to using throughout your adventure. So suddenly, you're reminded that you're still a pretty vulnerable little kid, and this walking tank is more than happy to prove it!.

Diungkapkan bahwa the remake's improved visuals make the encounter even more impressive, giving the iron knuckle an intimidating presence that makes every swing of its enormous axe feel dangerous. It's a little like eating your grandmother's homemade food after worrying that something might have gone wrong with the recipe. Somehow, it turns out even better than you remembered.

Berdasarkan laporan, king dodongo is an enormous creature that spends most of the fight rolling around its circular arena, trying to crush link before eventually opening its mouth to unleash a fiery attack. What I love most about this boss is how clever its main weakness is. Since the creature seems so eager to swallow Link, let’s give it something else to eat, of course!.

So all you need to do is avoid its rolling attacks and throw a Bomb into its mouth whenever it opens it, and watching this enormous beast swallow an explosive and immediately regret its life choices never gets old.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's also a fantastic early boss because it makes you realize just how much bigger and more dangerous hyrule is compared to the relatively cozy kokiri forest. Nothing says “your adventure is officially getting more challenging” quite like fighting a creature thirty times your size over a pool of lava.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dead hand has always been one of the most nightmare-inducing enemies in the entire zelda franchise, and apparently, nintendo knows exactly how much we fear this thing. Because if there's one boss that the remake refuses to make less terrifying, it's this horrifying creature!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, just like with the iron knuckle, your first encounter with dead hand happens while playing as child link. And you can feel the tension building before it actually appears. Veteran players already know what's coming as soon as they enter the room and spot those creepy hands emerging from the ground. Once it finally reveals itself, things get considerably worse.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, its updated design makes its face even more disturbing, and watching it attempt to bite link with its enormous mouth is enough to make you question whether you accidentally launched a survival horror game instead of ocarina of time. I honestly don't know how Nintendo managed to make this thing even creepier, but I certainly won't be looking under my bed tonight.

Nintendo has expanded one of the original Zelda: Ocarina of Time's most heartbreaking side stories.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fighting an invisible enemy is already challenging enough. Fighting an invisible enemy while standing on top of a giant bongo drum that it's constantly playing? Now that's a completely different story.

Berdasarkan laporan, bongo bongo is easily one of the most creative boss encounters in ocarina of time, and its updated appearance takes the entire experience to another level. The idea of fighting this enormous, headless creature while trying to keep your balance on a drum is already wonderfully bizarre, but the atmosphere surrounding the encounter makes it even better.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the remake also makes some of its attacks noticeably faster, meaning you'll have even less time to react while trying to keep up with the rhythm of the fight. And since Bongo Bongo is literally drumming throughout the entire encounter, you can bet that things get pretty intense! It's such an unusual boss concept, and I love how the remake manages to preserve its original identity while making the entire battle feel even more chaotic.

Sebagaimana diketahui, facing dark link is one of the most memorable moments in the original ocarina of time, and the remake manages to make this encounter just as special. As you progress through the Water Temple, you'll find yourself fighting Dark Link (accompanied by a rather creepy-looking Dark Navi, by the way), which ends up being an unforgettable battle.

The symbolism behind this encounter is already fantastic, since what better way to challenge the Hero of Time than by forcing him to face a darker version of himself? But the remake takes things even further by giving Dark Link a new move that might just be the coolest animation I've seen in the entire game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whenever you try to attack him with the tip of the master sword, he can actually dodge your strike by jumping onto the blade and standing on it – yes, he literally uses your own sword as a platform to avoid being hit, and it's ridiculously stylish! i also swear the controller gives you a little vibration when he pulls off this move, which makes the moment even more satisfying. Or maybe I'm imagining things because I'm still trying to process how cool it looks. Either way, Dark Link remains one of the best highlights of this remake.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'll admit that phantom ganon has always been my favorite boss in the original ocarina of time, and a reason for that is the incredible atmosphere surrounding the forest temple. By the time you reach this dungeon, you've already seen what Ganondorf has done to Hyrule during his seven-year reign of terror, and there's a constant sense of dread surrounding his presence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, when you finally reach the boss room and see what appears to be ganondorf himself, it's a pretty intimidating moment! even if is a phantom version of him. What I love about it is that it uses a painting mechanic, where Phantom Ganon hides inside the painting and you must pay attention to spot him before he strikes you! Visually, it is a truly striking moment, and when he gets off the painting to face you off is amazing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also, the remake makes this encounter even more memorable by extending ganondorf's dialogue after the battle. Once the boss is defeated, the real villain appears and calls him a useless puppet, warning that he knows Link’s intentions and won’t let him accomplish them so easily.

Sebagaimana diketahui, twinrova just hits differently in the remake. The combination of their updated designs, new animations, and fully voiced cutscenes makes this battle feel considerably more special than it already was in the original. Gameplay-wise, the fight remains faithful to its original mechanics. You'll need to use the Mirror Shield to absorb the correct elemental attacks from Koume and Kotake before redirecting that energy toward the opposite witch. It's a clever mechanic that forces you to pay attention to both enemies while carefully timing your movements.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, what really makes this encounter shine is how expressive the two witches have become! their personalities come through much more clearly now, especially when you're managing to land a successful attack. Watching them react to your moves, get increasingly frustrated, and argue with each other is genuinely hilarious.

Sebagaimana diketahui, things get considerably more serious once they fuse into twinrova, turning the encounter into an even more intense battle involving both fire and ice. But the fun doesn't stop when the fight ends. The final interactions between the two witches are fantastic, and their newly voiced dialogue gives the entire sequence so much personality. Honestly, I could watch these two argue for hours.

Berdasarkan laporan, there was no way i could finish this list without giving the final boss encounter the top spot. Facing Ganondorf and, eventually, Ganon is the culmination of everything you've experienced throughout Ocarina of Time, and the remake manages to make this already iconic confrontation even more impressive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, his updated animations, additional moves, and much more expressive character model make every moment feel considerably more dramatic. You can really feel that you're facing the main villain who has been threatening Hyrule throughout your entire adventure, rather than just another boss waiting at the end of a dungeon.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and then, just when you think the battle is over, ganondorf transforms into ganon, giving you one final confrontation against an enormous beast that looks terrifying in the remake's updated visuals. It's the perfect way to bring the adventure to its conclusion and also to deliver the best-looking sequences of the entire game. Now, if you'll excuse me, I think I need to replay the entire game again.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake has only been out for a short while, and yet there are several mods that change major aspects of the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i could claim that i love real-time strategy games for their fast-paced decision-making. But what I truly love is building massive armies and wreaking havoc on an apocalyptic scale. So when I saw the trailer for Horu (via RPS), an in-development RTS that promises "hundreds of thousands of units" on screen, it went on the wishlist faster than you can say 'Zerg Rush'.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, horu is an upcoming strategy game inspired by total war and star wars: empire at war, aiming to blend the colossal battles of the former with the galaxy-scale strategy of the latter. It challenges players to establish their own interstellar empire, building vast space fleets and huge land armies to assume ultimate dominion of the cosmos.

Diungkapkan bahwa while it's the spectacle of horu that caught my attention, with clouds of spaceships trading laser fire and oceans of little men getting obliterated by artillery, there are a couple of more specific ideas and mechanics that also sound deeply exciting. Unlike the games that inspired it, Horu aspires to be fully real-time, with battles playing out simultaneously across the solar system. This includes both land and space battles, letting you do things like punch your dropships through an enemy's orbital fleet to land an army on the surface while the battle in space rages on.

Berdasarkan laporan, this sounds rad, but also like it might be challenging to keep track of. Thankfully, Horu promises a few mechanics to keep the scale manageable. This includes a "drop zone system" that lets you assign a drop zone on a planet and queue up a set of orders, which the assigned army will then carry out automatically.

Diungkapkan bahwa other planned features include world colonisation and development, the ability to build spy networks and conduct espionage missions, space magic that'll let you cast devastating spells on the battlefield, and a fully simulated economy and research tree. There's even a system that lets you create boarding parties to take control of enemy ships and add them to your fleet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, all of this built by a solo dev who goes by glassbeaver, who built his own custom engine to develop the game. Development has been underway for several years, but GlassBeaver has now taken the game to Kickstarter "to help fun the remaining assets, sound and music". The campaign is already halfway to reaching its goal of £16,685, so it looks likely to get over the finish line.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's no specific release date for horu yet, but glassbeaver plans for the game to launch at the end of 2027. The next 12 months are shaping up to be big for space strategy more broadly, with Dawn of War 4 due to launch in December, and Total War: Warhammer 40,000 expected sometime next year.

#1086. AO3 is Back Online After Two Long Weeks Without Clerith Fanfics

📅 15 Nov 2026

AO3 is Back Online After Two Long Weeks Without Clerith Fanfics

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/ao3-is-back-online-after-two-long-weeks-without-clerith-fanfics/

Diungkapkan bahwa the internet has spent the past two and a half weeks deprived of many important things, including easy access to stories in which cloud strife and aerith gainsborough get the ending their readers wanted. Fortunately for Clerith fans, Archive of Our Own (AO3) is finally back online.

Berdasarkan laporan, the volunteer-run fanfiction archive returned on sunday, november 15, after going offline on october 29. Its operator, the Organization for Transformative Works (OTW), says a security incident prompted the extended shutdown. AO3 is usable again, although it hasn’t quite returned to normal.

This is a detailed explanation about the limitations of Phoenix Down in Final Fantasy 7.

For anyone who hasn’t spent much time on AO3, it’s a huge collection of fan-written stories covering games, movies, books, television, and just about any other fictional universe you can name.

Berdasarkan laporan, some stories fill gaps in the original work; others toss canon aside altogether. In Final Fantasy 7’s case, the apparently immortal debate about Cloud’s love life is practically built for it. Even Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth director Naoki Hamaguchi refuses to settle the Aerith-or-Tifa question.

Sebagaimana diketahui, otw says it was able to reopen the archive before the far end of its four-week recovery estimate by switching off a handful of features. User and collection icons currently don’t appear, importing works from other websites is unavailable, and the only download option is HTML. No icons were deleted; they just aren’t being shown yet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, traffic is another problem. AO3 has warned that some users will see slow loading times or even the maintenance page as it manages demand. Refreshing and trying again is the recommendation, although it may take a little patience to get in.

Berdasarkan laporan, initially, the october 29 outage looked like ordinary maintenance. The situation changed when OTW disclosed evidence of a security incident and warned that recovery could take between two and four weeks. It has brought in a security firm to review the incident, but isn’t detailing its fixes while that work is underway.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the return also comes just after ao3’s seventeenth anniversary. Not a particularly fun way to celebrate, but at least readers can now get back to their bookmarks.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the bigger worries during the shutdown was what would happen to unfinished drafts. AO3 normally removes drafts after 30 days, which is a nasty surprise if you haven’t been able to log in for more than two weeks. OTW says it paused automatic deletion throughout the outage, and no drafts were lost.

Diungkapkan bahwa that pause will remain in place until november 29. The catch is that dates shown on existing drafts may still reflect their original deadlines, not the extension. Writers are being asked to review unfinished work and save or publish it before automatic deletion resumes.

Berdasarkan laporan, otw also says published works, bookmarks, kudos, and other archive data remain intact. The security side is less settled, though. That’s the good news. The organization says it has no reason to think its user database was compromised, but it can’t be ruled out.

Berdasarkan laporan, it recommends an ao3 password change, as well as on other sites if you’ve reused your ao3 credentials there. You can follow further updates on the official AO3 status page.

Sebagaimana diketahui, look, you don’t need to have read a single fanfic to understand the appeal. Games ask you to spend dozens, sometimes hundreds, of hours with fictional people. Once the credits roll, it’s hardly surprising that some players want to spend more time with them, or imagine things going differently.

Diungkapkan bahwa the final fantasy 7 fandom is an obvious example. The official story gives players scenes and choices to dissect. We have covered how central Tifa and Aerith are to Rebirth’s story, while a separate guide to Aerith’s relationship options shows how much attention players can pay to Cloud’s relationships. Fanfiction lets them carry the argument somewhere else, without waiting for Square Enix to settle anything.

Fanfiction lets them carry the argument somewhere else, without waiting for Square Enix to settle anything.

Diungkapkan bahwa beyond the romance, fans have been reimagining final fantasy 7’s cast in entirely different art styles for years. Writing an alternate ending or inventing a crossover isn’t so different in spirit. AO3 simply gives that kind of work a home, a tag system, and readers who actually go looking for it.

Berdasarkan laporan, after 17 days of an error page, that home is accessible again. If you left a story half-read on October 28, there’s finally a chance to find your place. Just don’t be surprised if everyone else had the same idea.

#1088. 8 Must-Play Open-World RPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules

📅 15 Nov 2026

8 Must-Play Open-World RPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/open-world-rpgs-real-life-schedules/

These maps will be there for you when you’re ready.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, raise your hand if this has ever happened to you: a friend texts you a screenshot of a map with 400 icons on it and the message “you’re going to love this game. (My hand is raised. Until you check your calendar and remember that you’ve got a dentist appointment, three work deadlines, and a birthday dinner to prepare for, so that map is going to have to stay unexplored for a minute. ” You’re excited — the map is detailed, the game looks great, and you do love it…for about 10 seconds. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you’re looking for open-world rpgs you can actually play with a busy schedule, start here. Remember this: Keep it to just one quest tonight. These eight games range from true open-world adventures you can finish in a few weekends to RPG giants like Mass Effect that can be made manageable if you play them one mission at a time. The rest of the map will still be there when you get back.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, two kings walk into a war. Cat Quest 2 is a 2D open-world action RPG set in a fantasy realm of cats and dogs where those kings are brought together against their will during a war between the cats of Felingard and the advancing dogs of the Lupus Empire, and both of them want their thrones back. One has whiskers. Neither wants to be there. One has a wagging tail. The humor — as you might expect — leans on delightfully pun-heavy wordplay.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can play solo by swapping between the canine and feline heroes whenever you like, or play in local co-op, where each player takes one animal. Fast travel keeps the map from eating your entire night, so you can chain a few quests and stop when dinner is ready. Grab nearby quests before you enter a dungeon, since many dungeons have quests attached and nobody wants to make the trip twice.

Berdasarkan laporan, let’s say you have half an hour, a fishing boat, and you’ve just noticed there’s something odd in the water. Dredge is a sinister fishing adventure that casts you as a down-on-their-luck fisherman exploring an eerie archipelago. The day-night cycle gives you a built-in stopping point: Head back to port when the light fades, sleep, sell your catch, and spend the money on upgrades to your vessel, skills, and knowledge. After your boat wrecks near the island town of Greater Marrow, you get a replacement vessel…and a debt to pay off. Days are for fishing and selling, but at night, strange things start to happen on the water. Think of this as an open-world game that’s made mostly of ocean: There’s always an island in the distance hiding a secret, and you get to pick which one to sail to next.

Berdasarkan laporan, a calm british narrator tells you the whole story of biomutant. Your task: Pick a faction, and then do something about those World Eaters. It is an open-world, post-apocalyptic Kung-Fu RPG where you create a gene-spliced hero in a world with a Tree of Life at its center. Four World Eaters are killing that all-important tree. This can be deceptive, since Biomutant is not a calm story. The Myriad want to unite the tribes and save it, while the Jagni want to crush their rivals and bring it down. There’s also a war brewing among the tribes dotting this world, and they disagree about what to do with the dying tree. New Game+ unlocks after the credits and lets you ally with any of the six tribes from the start, which makes a second run a good excuse to try the path you skipped.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you awake on a beach on an island called new wirral. Cassette Beasts is a monster-fusing open-world RPG with turn-based battles. You’ve been transported from Earth, and all you’ve got on you is a cassette player that grants you the ability to turn into various monsters. Your goal is to get back home with help from the other stranded people on the island. Good luck!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that cassette player will be extremely helpful: in addition to becoming a monster yourself, when that feels appropriate, you can fuse monsters in combat to create whatever the moment needs. (There are over 14,000 possible fusions!) After a short tutorial, you’re free to wander in any direction, choose your fights, and skirt around any that you’d rather skip. Pro tip: Campfires let you rest and serve as a return point after you save, so make one before you quit for the night.

Berdasarkan laporan, the gods of olympus are in prison. It’s got a flexible gear system with enough complexity to tweak your playstyle without overwhelming you, plus new skill tree paths to unlock. Immortals Fenyx Rising sets you loose on the Golden Isle, a vast open world of puzzles, cliffs to glide from, and monsters to fight. Zelda fans will also appreciate the Vaults of Tartaros, puzzle chambers scattered across the island. It borrows a lot of its free-feeling vibe from games like Breath of the Wild; there is a lot of climbing in this game. The hero sent to free them — you, but no pressure — is a winged mortal named Fenyx. Navigating one (or more) gives you a clean goal for a single gaming session. Fair warning: Every upgrade you get does feed into an “I’ll play for just a bit longer” loop, so determine your goals and decide when you’re going to stop before you start.

Berdasarkan laporan, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sea of stars has a world that feels simultaneously pocket-sized and expansive — and it’s packed with small delights to discover, even if it doesn't start out wide open. You play Valere and Zale, two Children of the Solstice fated to become Solstice Warriors, who fuse solar and lunar powers into Eclipse Magic to stop an evil alchemist called the Fleshmancer. The game takes inspiration from Chrono Trigger and even features music by the same composer, Yasunori Mitsuda.

Diungkapkan bahwa early on, the overworld does parcel out exploration in set routes, but as your characters grow and gain powers, you’ll get a boat, faster ways to travel, and more freedom to roam the world. That’s a good thing, because there’s so much to poke at: a card game called Wheels, fishing, cooking, a crypt honoring the game’s backers, and hidden chests. The story is a heartfelt tale of friendship, which keeps the mood approachable even when the world is in danger. Dungeon puzzles rarely ask you to stop and think for more than a few seconds, side quests are sparse, and a friendly character usually tells you where to go next, so you can return after a week away and still know your next move.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are 120 shrines nestled into the rolling green hills and treacherous fire pits of hyrule. They’re all self-contained, with a little reward at the end. Each usually takes between ten minutes and an hour (if you’re dealing with a trickier puzzle). This is the trick to playing Breath of the Wild, an admittedly gigantic and overwhelming game, on a schedule: Pick a shrine, clear it, do one or two things nearby that seem fun, and call it a day.

Diungkapkan bahwa in this game, link wakes up after 100 years with no memories, and a spirit tells him that princess zelda has been holding back calamity ganon the whole time. You cook meals and elixirs that grant bonuses such as extra strength or weather resistance, and your weapons and shields wear out, which keeps your loadout changing as you go. On paper it’s an open-world action-adventure, but its systems have a lot in common with an RPG. Try not to get distracted as you get stronger and do more things, though. Each shrine you clear earns a Spirit Orb, and you can trade four orbs for an extra heart or a boost to your stamina, so every shrine works like a small level-up. One shrine, one quick sidequest, that’s it — Hyrule will be there waiting for you next time.

Berdasarkan laporan, think of mass effect as a tv series with a great cast: every mission is an episode, every crewmate gets a loyalty mission of their own, and the story stays easy to leave and come back to at the end of any one of them. Mass Effect: Andromeda is the series’ open-world chapter. Each explorable planet is open-world, with its own hazards such as radiation, heat, and cold. If you’re looking for a galaxy to roam at your own pace, this one does reward patience. After a 600-year journey to the Heleus Cluster, you play Ryder, who inherits the role of Pathfinder. Stay the course on your first planet, Eos, since radiation will kill you if you wander off it, and skip the repetitive “tasks,” like mineral scanning, until you’re in the mood.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you’d rather have tighter, mission-by-mission storytelling, start with the first three mass effect games instead. Play one mission per night. Whatever you have time for. The original trilogy isn’t open-world in the strictest sense, but its missions are episodic, and the first game even lets you explore planets in the Mako when you have time and skip them when you don’t. Or two. The Normandy will wait.

Fans and developers remain confident that Mass Effect will return.

#1089. GTA 6 Streaming Guidelines In China Prohibit Car Theft, Murder, And Attacking Cops

📅 15 Nov 2026

GTA 6 Streaming Guidelines In China Prohibit Car Theft, Murder, And Attacking Cops

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/gta-6-chinese-streaming-guidelines-leak/

Diungkapkan bahwa chinese streaming regulations are notoriously strict, so much so that gta was banned from being shown on platforms like douyin, huya, bilibili, and pandatv. GTA 6 may be the exception, but with a laundry list of caveats that essentially turn Grand Theft Auto into a sightseeing simulator.

In China, livestreaming games that haven't received the necessary government approval is prohibited under national regulations introduced in 2022.

According to local media outlets such as IT Home (via Yahoo), a document titled 'Guidelines for Compliance During Livestreams of GTA 6' was reportedly leaked by a Douyin creator, and its URL originates from ByteDance's corporate domain, lending legitimacy to their claim.

Diungkapkan bahwa access to the document has been blocked, but not before its contents were shared to the internet. The guidelines stipulate that streamers must avoid revealing clothing or certain emojis, and must black out the screen during gory scenes, or adjust blood effects to appear gray or green (something that many games in China do already, such as PUBG and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive). Streamers must also avoid attacking bystanders, assaulting police officers, or, bizarrely, stealing cars.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, local outlets report that "the online rumor about 'securing streaming rights' has no basis in fact. " The document is simply a reminder of platform rules.

GTA 6’s Extended Look is so censored on Bilibili that a few scenes are almost unwatchable.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's unclear right now if gta 6 will even launch in china, as it does not yet have approval, and streaming unlicensed foreign games is explicitly prohibited. That doesn't necessarily mean the studio has obtained government approval, but it's the strongest evidence yet that GTA 6 will be permitted. Until we have official confirmation, of course, there's no guarantee that platforms like Douyin will be allowed to host GTA 6 videos. However, Rockstar did launch a verified Douyin account on November 12 to promote the game. At the very least, they appear to be preparing for approval, hence the leaked guidelines.

Berdasarkan laporan, if the game is allowed on chinese streaming platforms, it's hard to imagine what content creators can show. The story will undoubtedly feature confrontation with the police, and revealing scenes have already been shown in the trailer — with Jason and Lucia having a steamy shower together in the most recent trailer — so the experience will need to be heavily censored or frequently obscured by a black screen. Something that already happened to the Extended Look in China, making several scenes completely unwatchable.

Berdasarkan laporan, realistically, the most that streamers will be permitted to show is jason and lucia cruising through leonida, taking in the sights of vice city. That probably won't make for a very exciting viewing experience.

Even when GTA 6 is downloaded and ready to go on November 19, sharing spoilers risks landing you with a DMCA takedown.

#1090. The 2026 GOTY Race Could Be a Disaster for Indie Games

📅 15 Nov 2026

The 2026 GOTY Race Could Be a Disaster for Indie Games

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/goty-2026-game-awards-indie-big-walk-ai/

After three indie nominees last year, this year’s leading contender is in trouble.

Sebagaimana diketahui, last year was a watershed moment for indie games at the game awards. Three games were nominated for both Game of the Year and Best Independent Game: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Hades 2, and Hollow Knight: Silksong. Together, they made up half of the GOTY 2025 field.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some quibble with the definition of clair obscur, a sizable production, as an indie game. (For what it's worth, the studio that made it is independent, and its publisher Kepler Interactive was founded by a collective of indie studios; it's definitely culturally indie. ) But even if you excluded it, this was still the first time more than one game had crossed over between the indie and GOTY categories in the history of the awards.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you interpret this result as a sure sign that the game awards is taking indie games much more seriously, i'm afraid you might be disappointed. Balatro, 2024's indie nominee, was a massive viral hit. All three 2025 indie GOTY nominees were huge sellers, and two of them were high-profile sequels to critical darlings and popular favorites. These were not normal times. In previous years things were much more patchy. There was no indie nominee in 2023. The 2025 nominations flatter to deceive, and 2026 looks like it will be a different matter. In 2022, the lucky game was the distinctly slick and mainstream Stray. Prior to that, one indie game would typically break through every other year.

Berdasarkan laporan, increasing recognition of indie games among the critical community has been counterbalanced by the international expansion of the game awards jury. This expansion has tended to flatten the jury's taste, and tends to disadvantage indie developers who can't afford localization into multiple languages — not an issue for 2025's three big beasts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so we turn to the 2026 race. There have been some superb and well-reviewed indie games this year, as there are every year: Big Walk, Mina the Hollower, Zero Parades, Mewgenics, Cairn, Denshattack!, Mixtape. None of them have been hits on the scale of the last few indie nominees, however, nor have they penetrated the culture in the same way as 2025’s games.

Diungkapkan bahwa nevertheless, a nomination for one of them is still in prospect, because this year's goty slate is relatively weak, with many evenly matched titles fighting over the few nomination slots left after dead certs grand theft auto 6, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time, and resident evil requiem are accounted for. In those circumstances, there's a path to nomination for an indie game with a stellar critical reputation and strong support.

Diungkapkan bahwa the best candidates are mina the hollower and big walk, both critical darlings with 90-plus ratings on metacritic. Jury members have probably been playing it over time with their friend groups. As a multiplayer co-op game, Big Walk has had a longer tail in the conversation, and has more viral stickiness. Mina was more widely covered at launch, but didn't click with a big audience. It's been my pick of the two so far, and its case was buoyed by a win in the Critic's Choice category at this week's Golden Joystick Awards.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, also this week, developer house house made the disastrous admission that generative ai had been used to write some code for big walk. This will likely rule the game out of contention for several indie awards, like the IGF and Indie Game Awards. (The Indie Game Awards stripped Clair Obscur of its 2025 Game of the Year award over use of generative AI. ) Its impact on Big Walk's fortunes at The Game Awards is less clear.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the broad-church game awards jury is likely less swayed by ethical issues such as ai usage than small, indie-specialist juries. An added wrinkle is that the AI news hit toward the final stage of The Game Awards' two-step nomination process. That said, Big Walk will need the whole indie-fan coalition within The Game Awards jury to rally around it if it's going to get a nomination. Jury members offended by the AI usage would have to actively remove Big Walk nominations they'd already made, rather than just not make them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the controversy might not hurt big walk's chances as much as you might think, but it certainly doesn't help them. In a tight race for those final nominations, the leading indie contender just took a big knock. Can Mina the Hollower take up the mantle? Or will Big Walk's loss be some AAA title's gain — Control Resonant, perhaps, or 007 First Light? We'll find out soon enough.

What’s in pole position for gaming’s top prize? Let’s make some predictions.

#1093. 10 Games That Made Me Weirdly Passionate About Jobs I'd Never Want

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Games That Made Me Weirdly Passionate About Jobs I'd Never Want

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/games-that-made-me-weirdly-passionate-about-jobs-i-d-never-want/

Contributor at DualShockers, former Esports Insider DACH content lead, former Escapist Magazine Germany content lead, software engineering background.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some of my favourite games are, when you really think about it, just jobs. I have pressure-washed patios, stamped passports, hauled cargo across half of Europe and sold second-hand books out of a trailer, all of it voluntarily and in my free time. And boy, did I take every single one of them seriously!.

The Best Cozy Games That You Need to Play in Fall 2026 feature autumnal settings and the distinctive vibes of the season.

Berdasarkan laporan, the funny thing is that i wouldn't actually want any of these jobs. Some of them look like far too much hard work, others require a kind of patience I most definitely do not possess, and with one or two, I'm fairly certain I'd end up in prison. That is probably exactly what makes them so enjoyable from the safety of my sofa, so let's take a look at the ten games that made me weirdly passionate about jobs I'd never want.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i had sunk many hours into both powerwash simulator games long before i ever held an actual pressure washer. That finally changed earlier this year, and I'm pleased to report that watching grime disappear is just as satisfying in real life as it is on screen. On a warm summer's day, it's even quite fun.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, still, there's a lot to be said for staying warm, dry and cozied up on the sofa whilst doing it. The game has an almost meditative quality that I couldn't quite find with a real hose in my hands, and that's no accident. Lead designer Nick McCarthy has said that the team left out certain real-world inconveniences on purpose, and I'm grateful for every single one of them.

Berdasarkan laporan, futurlab released the sequel on 23 october 2025, bringing 38 new jobs to muckingham, online co-op for up to four players and new tools like an abseiling rig and a cherry picker. There are also two kittens named Bubbles and Squeak, which was frankly all the convincing I needed. As an actual career, though, it looks like an awful lot of work, so I'll stick to the version without the wet socks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, papers, please's premise is incredibly dark and difficult: you are manning a booth at the border of the fictional eastern bloc country of arstotzka. Make a mistake and you get a wage deduction. It's 1982, and as a border inspector, it is your responsibility to check passports, permits and anything else that gets slid across your desk. Your family, meanwhile, desperately needs that money. The game is, however, also tense and brilliant, and it also taught me that I would be entirely unsuited for the job.

Berdasarkan laporan, quite frankly, i'm just not enough of a bootlicker for it. I'm far too nice, and my first instinct is to wave everybody through, which is not something Papers, Please looks kindly upon. Being generous with your stamp sooner or later gets you killed by your own government, and it's hard to build a career on that.

Note: Lucas Pope worked on the Uncharted series at Naughty Dog before making a game that's almost entirely about paperwork.

Diungkapkan bahwa by its tenth anniversary in 2023, the game had sold over five million copies, so there are clearly plenty of people out there who are much better at saying no than i am. I have a lot of respect for them. I'd just rather not meet them at passport control.

Sebagaimana diketahui, running a late-night coffee shop in an alternative version of seattle sounds like a dream. Even more so when you consider that your visitors will consist of elves, orcs and mermaids that are living alongside humans. Coffee is the great connector here, since the need for a warm drink and someone to talk to is universal across every race. Toge Productions chose Seattle because Starbucks first opened there, and also because the rain sets the mood so well. It's easily one of the coziest games I own.

Sebagaimana diketahui, parts of this job would actually suit me extremely well: i enjoy good banter, i'm perfectly happy with small talk, and i seem to have the kind of approachable face that makes strangers trauma dump on me far more often than you'd expect. If being a barista was only about listening, I'd be employee of the month.

Berdasarkan laporan, unfortunately, you also have to make the coffee, and coffee talk is the game that showed me just how hilariously bad i am at latte art. Nothing I produce looks like it was made on purpose. So as much as I love the idea, I could never run a coffee shop of my own.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, note: creator mohammad fahmi sadly passed away in march 2022. He pitched the game as holding a warm cup of coffee by a window whilst it rains outside and lo-fi music plays in the background, which is exactly how it feels.

If you're looking for relaxing experiences with guaranteed quality, I recommend these ten little-known cozy games from famous developers.

Berdasarkan laporan, stardew valley is meant to be about running a cute little farm with cute little animals on it. The way I play it, with spreadsheets at the ready and more wiki tabs open than I'd like to admit, has very little to do with that. My approach is a lot closer to a general planning a war than a farmer enjoying the countryside.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the forensic intensity i bring to this game does scare me a little. Every day is planned, every crop has to earn its place, and my poor character hasn't had a quiet afternoon in years. If I ran a real farm like that, I'd work myself into a burnout before the first harvest.

Note: Eric Barone, better known as ConcernedApe, made Stardew Valley on his own over roughly four years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the game turned ten on 26 february 2026 and has sold around 50 million copies. I'd love to know how many of those players are peacefully watering their parsnips and enjoying the sunset, and how many are like me. I have my suspicions.

Berdasarkan laporan, something happens to me whenever i open euro truck simulator 2. Within minutes, I turn into a 60-year-old trucker who has been doing this for decades, completely locked in, with nothing on my mind except my cargo and the motorway ahead. I can't explain it, but it awakens something in me.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are two wolves inside of me: one is a sweet softie, and the other one is a fourth-generation trucker that graduated from the school of hard knocks, living and breathing 18-wheelers. Sadly for the second wolf, I'm really, really bad at parking, and truth be told, I'm no better at it in the game. That feels like a bit of a dealbreaker for a job that ends with reversing a trailer into a loading bay.

Berdasarkan laporan, scs software first released the game at retail in autumn 2012, before it arrived on steam on 16 january 2013. By its tenth birthday, it had sold over 13 million copies, and players had bought DLC more than 80 million times. Clearly, I'm not the only one with a trucker wolf, so at least I'm in good company.

Diungkapkan bahwa exterminauts is an upcoming co-op shooter from behaviour interactive, the studio behind dead by daylight, and it hands you several jobs at once. As part of a crew of three, you clock in, take on MegaCorp contracts, repair what's broken and exterminate alien pests along the way. It was revealed at gamescom Opening Night Live in August 2026 and is planned for 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, anyone who has watched me deal with a woodlouse or a spider knows that pest control isn't my calling. I'm quite a caring person, so I had a lot of fun with the healing side of things. I've also discovered that I'm alarmingly quick to shoot my own teammates, sometimes because they were being annoying, and sometimes entirely by accident.

Note: Friendly fire is on in Exterminauts, and swinging one of the bigger weapons around carelessly is enough to take a teammate down.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a colleague who keeps taking out the rest of the crew isn't much use to anyone, no matter how good her healing is. I can't imagine it going down well in a performance review, either. It's better for everyone if I stay off the payroll.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, subnautica is one of my favourite games of all time, which means i approach the deep ocean with a healthy dose of suspicion. Dave the Diver has done nothing but confirm that this is the correct attitude. You spend your days diving into the Blue Hole to catch fish, and the further down you go, the more things would like to eat you instead.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once the sun sets, the second job begins, and you help chef bancho run the sushi restaurant, serving customers and keeping the drinks coming. All of that after a full day of nearly being eaten by sharks! I’d be a horrible sushi tester on the basis of not liking fish, and I could also never be the waiter on the basis of lacking a good sense of balance.

Diungkapkan bahwa note: the restaurant is the idea of dave's friend cobra, a former arms dealer who now handles the business side of things. Naturally.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by september 2026, dave the diver had sold more than 10 million copies across all platforms, and i completely understand why. It's a wonderful game. It's also the best argument I've ever seen for staying on dry land and ordering takeaway.

A review of over the hill, a cozy exploration-focused driving game.

Diungkapkan bahwa kerbal space program puts you in charge of a space program run by the kerbals, little green aliens who are far braver than they have any right to be. You build rockets, launch them and watch most of them explode. I was oddly passionate about all of it, right up until the moment I finally made it into orbit.

Berdasarkan laporan, i'm very aware that the game doesn't end there. It had taken me so long to reach that one milestone, though, that my passion fizzled out on the spot, and I decided that my work here was done. That's quite unusual for me, as I'm normally someone who needs to tick off every last goal.

Diungkapkan bahwa a real head of a space program with that attitude wouldn't bode well for anyone. NASA worked with developer Squad on an asteroid mission update in 2014, and ESA followed with missions of its own in 2020, so the people who do this for a living are clearly made of sterner stuff than I am. I have a lot of respect for them, and I'm more than happy to watch from the ground.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, barbie rewind was developed by digital eclipse, published by atari and released on 12 november 2026. You get to decorate the DreamHouse with over 250 pieces of furniture and decor inspired by real Barbie playsets, from a classic pink vanity to a '90s inflatable chair. It is unfathomably fun. There are also 16 classic Barbie games from 1991 to 2007 included, one of which, Barbie: Vacation Adventure, had never been released before.

Diungkapkan bahwa truth be told, i think i'd make a good interior designer, and i think i'd enjoy it, too. In Barbie Rewind, you get to design to your heart's content, and nobody questions your choices. Ken, Teresa and Christie do pop in to ask for help, but none of them will ever tell you that your sofa is ugly.

Berdasarkan laporan, real clients are a different story. Even when something looks questionable at best, you have to go with the flow and keep them happy, and whilst you'd hope they trust your design decisions, there's absolutely no guarantee that they will. I don't think I have the temperament for that, and I'm fairly sure someone would end up wounded.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in tiny bookshop, you leave everything behind to sell second-hand books out of a little trailer in the seaside town of bookstonbury-by-the-sea. Each morning, you pick a spot, stock your shelves and wait for the locals to wander in. Many of the books are real ones, which I love.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i've worked in retail before, i'm quite a good salesperson, and i enjoy helping people find what they're looking for. The customers in Tiny Bookshop put that to the test, because a fair few of them behave as if it's their very first day on Earth. Not all of them, mind you, but enough of them describe the book they want so vaguely that it borders on nonsensical.

Diungkapkan bahwa on top of that, everyone in town seems to need a favour. Community is important, of course, but I'm trying to run a bookshop here, and I'd quite like to be left alone to do it! Over half a million players have fallen in love with Tiny Bookshop, and it won three German Developer Awards in 2025, so this one might just be a me problem. I'd still end up scaring all of my customers away.

Frontier Developments returns to the animal park with Planet Zoo 2.

#1094. ‘Rings of Power’ Stars Break Down 2 Major Deaths in Prime Video’s Lord of the Rings Series

📅 15 Nov 2026

‘Rings of Power’ Stars Break Down 2 Major Deaths in Prime Video’s Lord of the Rings Series

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/rings-of-power-season-3-deaths-interview/

The first batch of episodes include two major character deaths.

The first batch of episodes include two major character deaths.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the stakes are higher than ever in season 3 of the lord of the rings: the rings of power. D. Númenor is on the brink of civil war between the new king Pharazôn (Trystan Gravelle) and the Faithful loyal to the deposed queen Míriel (Cynthia Addai-Robinson). Sauron (Charlie Vickers) is working on forging the One Ring that will bring all of Middle-earth under his control, recruiting powerful Ring-servants to lead his orc armies. Payne and Patrick McKay made it clear that no one is safe this season by killing off two characters who have been part of the series from the beginning. Showrunners J. Polygon spoke to the actors about their last moments on set and their time in Middle-earth.

This article contains major spoilers for the first four episodes of The Rings of Power season 3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the story in númenor has involved a lot of family drama. His daughter Eärien (Ema Horvath) allied herself with Pharazôn and his son, Kemen (Leon Wadham), encouraging her father to renounce his faith and pledge loyalty to the new king. Captain Elendil (Lloyd Owen) is one of the leaders of the Faithful, a Númenórean group who believes in preserving the kingdom’s connection to the Elves and the Valar. She participated in the arrest of the Faithful’s leaders, though she helped her father escape.

Five years pass between the season 2 finale and the start of season 3, and they haven’t been kind to Eärien.

Berdasarkan laporan, “in season 1, i hope you get more of a sense of youth and hope,” horvath said. “This season, you start to feel her age and shame creeping in about what she's done, what she's been involved in. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa eärien seems to be loyal to pharazôn, and is even called in to help interrogate a man who tried to assassinate the king. But she actually helped the Faithful plan the attack, and she kills the captive to save him from being tortured and potentially revealing her secret.

Diungkapkan bahwa “the idea that even small actions matter is a pretty big theme in tolkien, and even though she's done some pretty horrible things, the way she's trying to right the ship still matters in this last episode, or in the last few years that she's been helping the faithful,” horvath said. “I think she’s an imperfect heroine. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, pharazôn’s chief advisor belzagar catches eärien sneaking into his room so she can send a message to her father, and he lays a trap that winds up with elendil being captured by kemen. When Pharazôn confronts her with the truth, Eärien leaps out a window to avoid being interrogated.

Diungkapkan bahwa “that's probably my favorite day that i've ever had on this job,” horvath said. I was really excited about that scene. I knew that she was going to die on the island, and I knew what her political leanings were going to be. He's always been the most important person in the room for her, and we've been in scenes together, but we've never gotten to really spar. “It's the first time I got to deliver lines to Trystan, who plays Pharazôn. I always knew what was coming. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the tragic story of the wood elf arondir (ismael cruz córdova) began in the first episode of the rings of power. A soldier guarding a village of men who are descended from allies of the Dark Lord Morgoth, Arondir fell in love with the human healer Bronwyn (Nazanin Boniadi). Bronwyn’s own son Theo (Nazanin Boniadi) was partially responsible for the destruction of their home after he discovered a magic sword hilt that led to the creation of Mordor. Bronwyn died offscreen from poison delivered by an Orc arrow, which prompted Arondir to dedicate himself to fighting the Orcs alongside Galadriel (Morfydd Clark).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in season 3, arondir wants to leave the fight to take care of theo, who took refuge in the númenórean colony of pelargir. The two finally meet again at Gundabad, where Arondir tries to persuade Theo to take off his ring and leave with him. In the meantime, Theo responds to Sauron’s call for Ring-servants and becomes a Nazgnagôl. He puts off their reconciliation to go on a dangerous mission with Galadriel to infiltrate the infamous prison of Gundabad. Theo seems to be on the brink of accepting the help, but when Sauron appears and compels him to kill Arondir.

Diungkapkan bahwa “he's appealing to the last bit of hope of his son, knowing that he's been quite corrupted,” córdova said. Until the last second, he's going to try to lead with love. It's a testament to Arondir. “Sauron is extremely powerful, and once he corrupts anything, it's very hard to fight against it. He's like, ‘I'm still going to face you. ’ I think he's a badass. I'm still not going to let my light be taken by the shadow, by the darkness. ”.

The dramatic scene was shot over the course of a week, though Córdova said he’d been preparing for it for months.

Berdasarkan laporan, “it was very emotional, but i felt quite supported by my castmates and by the crew,” he said. “I was going through a personal loss of a very dear loved one that same week, so the whole thing was quite charged, but I felt like I was in great hands. I knew what our director Sanaa Hamri had in store, and I trust her blindly, so I knew that the character was going to be honored in the way that he needed. ”.

Arondir leaves behind his surrogate son, Theo, and his pet dog, who stayed in Rivendell.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “he's just the most beautiful dog,” córdova said. Elves love and revere nature and all living things, so I think he'll be very well taken care of. “He was a pain in the ass, but he was such a lovely dog to shoot with. ”.

Córdova loved shooting with the dog so much that he went to some extreme lengths to get him in more shots.

Berdasarkan laporan, “he did not want to stay still,” he said. “He did not want to do what he needed to do. He was such a cutie. He was a little pain in the butt, but I loved him. Just shoot me from this side. But I really wanted him to be there so I said, ‘Bring the tube of chicken paste we're using, and I'll just make it work. ’ They did and I smeared my entire face and my neck on that side with the paste that he loved. ”.

Peter Jackson's trilogy inspired a generation of fantasy films, but Hollywood often copied its scale instead of its humanity.
