#1095. 10 Survival Games That Don’t Make Hunger Their Whole Personality

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Survival Games That Don’t Make Hunger Their Whole Personality

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/survival-games-that-don-t-make-hunger-their-whole-personality/

Contributor at DualShockers, former Esports Insider DACH content lead, former Escapist Magazine Germany content lead, software engineering background.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, survival games have had a hold on me for years now. There’s truly nothing like crash-landing somewhere hostile with nothing but the clothes on your back, punching a tree, and slowly building something that resembles a home. What I could absolutely do without, though, is the little drumstick icon that starts flashing at me roughly ten minutes into every new world.

From Rain World's terrifying sights to Subnautica's oceanic survival, these are the 10 Best Open World Survival Games.

Berdasarkan laporan, look, i get it. Hunger is realistic, and in some games, it genuinely adds to the experience. But far too often, it feels like a chore that’s been bolted on because that’s just what survival games do, and I’m not being funny, but I didn’t plan an entire expedition just to turn around because my character fancies a snack.

Berdasarkan laporan, thankfully, not every developer feels the same way. Some have turned food into a reward rather than a punishment, some have made hunger completely optional, and a few have decided that your character doesn’t need to eat at all. They’re all still survival games, and some of them are pretty brutal, so let’s take a look at my favourites that found far more interesting ways to try and kill you.

Berdasarkan laporan, valheim is pretty much the poster child for survival games that do food differently. There’s no hunger meter, and you will never starve to death, no matter how long you go without eating. Instead, you can have up to three different foods active at once, with each of them boosting your maximum health and stamina before slowly wearing off.

Berdasarkan laporan, skipping a meal won’t hurt you, but it will leave you with a measly 25 health and 50 stamina, healing a single hit point every ten seconds. Considering a single troll can flatten you in a matter of seconds, that’s more than enough motivation to get cooking. Food becomes part of your preparation, just like repairing your gear before a big boss fight, rather than something you need to do just to stay alive.

Note: Iron Gate reworked the entire food system with the Hearth & Home update back in 2021, and truth be told, not everyone was thrilled about it at the time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after more than five years in early access and over 17 million copies sold, valheim finally hit 1. Eating is still optional. 0 on 9 September 2026, together with the Deep North biome. Heading into the Mistlands on an empty stomach, however, is a mistake you’ll only make once.

Diungkapkan bahwa keen games, the frankfurt studio behind portal knights, didn’t exactly hide where its inspiration came from. Ahead of Early Access, the team said that Enshrouded would have no hunger meter, no thirst meter and no sleep meter, and that Valheim was the closest comparison for how food would work. And honestly? It shows, in the best possible way.

Diungkapkan bahwa food in enshrouded is all about buffs. You get three food slots, and only one food of each type can be active at a time, which nudges you towards mixing and matching rather than just shovelling roasted meat into your mouth. Some meals boost your health, others your melee or magic damage, and it ends up feeling much more like putting together an RPG build than ticking off a survival chore.

Berdasarkan laporan, note: about six months into early access, keen games added an optional survival difficulty that brings the hunger bar back. On that setting, it can actually kill you.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i think that’s the perfect compromise. If you want the classic experience, it’s there for you, but if you don’t, you’ll never have to think about it. More than five million players had already wandered into Embervale before the 1. 0 release on 15 October 2026, so I’m clearly not the only one who appreciates that.

Sebagaimana diketahui, terraria has never had a hunger meter. Sure, food exists, but it gives you the Well Fed buff, a lovely little boost to your stats rather than something standing between you and certain death. You can spend hundreds of hours digging, building and taking down bosses without ever having to think about lunch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that changed, sort of, with the 1. 4. Re-Logic teamed up with Klei Entertainment for a crossover with Don’t Starve Together, and the result was The Constant, a secret world seed that brings in hunger, Don’t Starve-style shading and darkness that actively hurts you. 3 update. Hunger works in stages, and if you ignore it for long enough, you will start starving.

Diungkapkan bahwa note: the whole crossover started with a reddit ama for terraria’s 10th anniversary, where the team said don’t starve together was the franchise they’d most like to collaborate with. Klei just so happened to be reading.

Diungkapkan bahwa i absolutely love this approach. Nobody is forced into it, but it’s there as an opt-in challenge for anyone who wants it. The fact that you need to type in a secret seed to even get hunger tells you everything you need to know about how essential it is to the Terraria experience.

Players will need to be extra careful when exploring in these open-world and survival games.

Diungkapkan bahwa astroneer has a pretty simple take on survival: you need oxygen, and that’s about it. Your shelter provides you with both power and oxygen, so as long as you stay within range, you’re absolutely fine. The moment you wander off, though, your meter starts to drop, which is where tethers come in to carry that oxygen with you.

Berdasarkan laporan, what i love is how that one mechanic shapes everything else. Your tether lines double as breadcrumbs, so you always have a way back home, and the tension only really kicks in when you’re deep in a cave and very much off the grid. It’s survival with all of the tension and none of the snack breaks, and that’s exactly why I keep going back to it.

Diungkapkan bahwa system era softworks released astroneer into early access in december 2016, before launching the full game in february 2019. Sadly, co-founder and lead artist Paul Pepera passed away in March 2017, before the game was finished. His distinctive low-poly style still defines Astroneer to this day, and by March 2022, the game had been purchased nearly four million times.

Berdasarkan laporan, no man’s sky doesn’t have a hunger meter, a thirst meter or anything that even resembles sleep. What it does have is life support and hazard protection, and both of those need topping up whilst you explore planets that are, more often than not, actively trying to kill you. Some players will argue those are just hunger and thirst with different names, and fair enough, but in practice it feels completely different.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you’re not foraging for berries. You’re mining oxygen and sodium, refining resources and keeping your exosuit running whilst dodging toxic rain or extreme temperatures. Instead of pulling you away from exploring, your survival is tied directly into it.

Diungkapkan bahwa food did eventually find its way into the game with a full cooking system, letting you turn ingredients into dishes that restore life support or hazard protection. There’s even a food critic, Cronus, who will rate your culinary creations and reward you with nanites. It’s completely optional, slightly absurd and exactly the kind of thing No Man’s Sky does best.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, subnautica does have hunger and thirst in its default survival mode, so this one comes with a little asterisk. When you start a new game, though, you can pick Freedom mode instead, which is identical to Survival, just without hunger and thirst. You’ll still have to manage your oxygen, your health and your nerves, and trust me, that is more than enough.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, plenty of players recommend freedom as the best way to experience subnautica for the first time, and i’d have to agree. Inventory space is already tight, and every slot you don’t fill with fish is a slot you can use for resources. That way, you can fully focus on exploring the oceans of planet 4546B, which are, quite frankly, terrifying enough on their own.

Diungkapkan bahwa note: freedom mode isn’t a late addition, either. It has been there almost from the start, and PC Gamer’s preview in January 2015, just weeks into Early Access, already listed it alongside Survival.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unknown worlds launched the full game on 23 january 2018, celebrating with a livestream from the monterey bay aquarium. By then, nearly two million people already owned it. Considering what lurks in the deeper parts of Subnautica, I personally would’ve picked a slightly less fishy location.

These games are sure to keep fans of the Subnautica series entertained.

Diungkapkan bahwa satisfactory is a factory-building game first and a survival game a very distant second, but it still drops you onto an alien planet full of wildlife that would love nothing more than to take a bite out of you. What it doesn’t do is make you eat. Food is purely there to heal you, and the planet’s edible flora are more like a first aid kit than an actual meal.

Berdasarkan laporan, paleberries heal 10 hp, beryl nuts a little less, and the bacon agaric mushroom heals 20. Eventually, you can even process them into inhalers, because of course the answer to everything in Satisfactory is automation. The only real hunger in this game is your factory’s endless appetite for more power, more iron and more conveyor belts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, note: ada, your ever-so-helpful ai companion, refers to the bacon agaric as amanita lardum. Whether it actually tastes like bacon remains a mystery.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, coffee stain studios released satisfactory 1. And the big reveal in the release date trailer? A flushable toilet. 5 million copies sold. 0 on 10 September 2024, after over five years in Early Access and 5. We all have our priorities.

Diungkapkan bahwa starbound, chucklefish’s sci-fi sandbox, lets you decide on your relationship with food right at character creation. Casual mode removes the need to eat entirely, Survival mode adds a hunger meter, and Hardcore combines hunger with permadeath for anyone who enjoys suffering. There’s no switching later on, so you’d better know what you want before you start.

Diungkapkan bahwa interestingly, hunger had actually been taken out during development, and was only brought back for the 1. In those, food rots over time, and you will starve if you ignore it. 0 release on 22 July 2016, specifically for the Survival and Hardcore modes. In Casual, food still heals you and grants buffs, so cooking never feels pointless.

Berdasarkan laporan, i really appreciate a game that respects the fact that some of us just want to build a pretty space station and go planet-hopping in peace. Not every adventure needs a ration plan. Starbound can still be pretty challenging in other ways, but in Casual mode, the biggest threat on a new planet is the local wildlife, not your rumbling stomach.

There are so many great co-op games coming out today, and many allow players to just explore and relax together.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pacific drive is a survival game where you don’t need to eat, drink or sleep. Instead, almost all of the survival pressure lands squarely on your station wagon. You patch up panels, swap out tyres, keep the battery charged and the tank full, all whilst driving through the bizarre, anomaly-filled Olympic Exclusion Zone.

Berdasarkan laporan, seth rosen, who led the game’s design, has been pretty open about the fact that a lot of his choices were aimed at smoothing out the things that bugged him about survival games. He even had pages of notes on turning radiation damage into an exposure meter, but ultimately decided against it, since you already have your hands full taking care of the car without another time pressure and distraction. As Rosen put it, the car’s health is generally a better indicator of how a run is going than your own.

Sebagaimana diketahui, note: creative director and ceo cassandra dracott’s 1989 buick estate was the primary reference car during early development. Her parents’ Volvo station wagon, which became the car she drove from the moment she could drive, played a part, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ironwood studios released pacific drive on 22 february 2024, and it sold over a million copies within a year. There’s even a television adaptation in development, and I truly have no idea how they’re planning to make a car the main character. I cannot wait to find out.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lego fortnite launched on 7 december 2023 with a fairly traditional hunger system. You could already switch it off when creating a world, but for anyone who kept it on, it wasn’t exactly a great time. Within two weeks, Epic patched it to make snacks more filling, because food simply wasn’t reducing hunger by enough. In hindsight, it was the first sign that hunger and LEGO minifigures weren’t the most natural pairing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in mid-2024, epic added cozy mode, which turned hunger, temperature and stamina off by default. That should’ve been the end of it, but Epic eventually went one step further and removed hunger from Odyssey altogether. Food and potions still exist and give you buffs, but there’s no meter to keep topped up anymore.

Note: Not everyone was happy about it, with some players saying the change made the game feel a little too arcade-like.

Sebagaimana diketahui, personally, i think it was the right call for a game that lives inside fortnite and attracts plenty of younger and newer players. Odyssey is all about building villages, exploring and fighting off the occasional Storm-Wild creature. Nobody needed to stop every few minutes to hunt down yet another LEGO berry.

These survival games are the best to come back to and explore to your heart's content solo or with friends time and time again.

#1096. Treyarch Lays Off Call of Duty Zombies Mastermind Craig Houston After 20 Years

📅 15 Nov 2026

Treyarch Lays Off Call of Duty Zombies Mastermind Craig Houston After 20 Years

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/treyarch-lays-off-call-of-duty-zombies-mastermind-craig-houston-after-20-years/

Contributor at DualShockers, former Esports Insider DACH content lead, former Escapist Magazine Germany content lead, software engineering background.

Craig Houston, the writer behind much of Call of Duty’s Zombies storyline, has been laid off by Treyarch after around 20 years at the studio.

As the development of Black Ops 7 winds down, Treyarch has indicated that they'll make big changes to Zombies in their future Call of Duty games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he shared the news himself on friday via x and linkedin, and i have to say, it’s a rather graceful message considering the circumstances. Houston said he was proud and privileged to have worked alongside so many talented people, many of whom will remain friends for life, before thanking fans for their enthusiasm, support and kind words over the years. On X, he posted it alongside a video celebrating 30 years of Treyarch, featuring footage from many of the games he worked on, which makes the whole thing feel a little more bittersweet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he didn’t go into the reasons, but it appears to be part of the huge xbox restructuring announced earlier this year, which is set to affect 3,200 jobs. Treyarch sits under Activision Blizzard, which in turn is owned by Xbox, so it isn’t a huge surprise that the cuts have reached the studio. Still, seeing a name like his on the list stings, especially if you’ve spent any amount of time shooting zombies with your friends at 2 in the morning.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for those who don’t know him by name, and i suspect that’s quite a few people, houston has been at treyarch since 2006. His first Call of Duty there was Call of Duty 3, where he worked as a video editor, which is a pretty humble start for someone who would go on to shape one of the series’ biggest modes. From World at War in 2008 onwards, he was the main writer for Zombies, whilst also writing for Treyarch’s campaigns.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he is credited as a writer and designer on black ops 1 through 4, and later as part of the design and creative development teams on the likes of cold war, black ops 6 and black ops 7. Interestingly, he isn’t credited on this year’s Modern Warfare 4.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, zombies obviously wasn’t a one-man show, with jimmy zielinski, jason blundell and kevin drew all being a big part of how the mode evolved. Houston’s writing is what a lot of fans point to when they talk about why they fell in love with the characters, though. He also wrote the jingles for the original perks introduced in Verrückt, which is one of my favourite details in all of this. If you’ve ever caught yourself singing along to a vending machine whilst a horde closes in on you, that one’s on him.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the response since friday has been lovely to see. Former Treyarch developer Tony Flame replied to Houston’s post calling him a legend and saying it was an honour to work with him, adding that he created a truly special experience that will live on for millions of fans. Over on Reddit, one fan described him as a great guy, noting that you can tell how much he loves the story and characters he writes simply by how excited he gets when talking about them in promo material.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, many fans argue that houston never quite got the recognition he deserved. In the wake of this announcement, many people admitted they hadn’t really been aware of him until after Black Ops 3, despite him having been there since the very beginning, and I think that’s true for a lot of us players. We tend to know the directors and the faces from the trailers, whilst the people writing the lines we end up quoting for years stay in the background. Zombies a mode spawned out of passion, and it’s hard to see someone fundamentally involved with that leave.

Berdasarkan laporan, truth be told, this is the part of the xbox restructuring that i find hardest to get my head around. Twenty years of knowing a story inside out, including every timeline, every character and every twist, isn’t something a studio can simply hire back in. Of course, I don’t know the reasoning behind this particular decision, and Houston himself hasn’t said a bad word about Treyarch. It is, however, a reminder that these layoff numbers are made up of people, some of whom have been shaping the games we love for the last two decades.

Berdasarkan laporan, houston hasn’t said what he plans to do next. Whatever it ends up being, I hope it involves writing, and ideally a jingle or two.

#1097. 10 Open-World Games You Can Finish in 10 Hours & Under

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Open-World Games You Can Finish in 10 Hours & Under

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/open-world-games-you-can-finish-in-10-hours-under/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, elena chapella is a writer for dualshockers. Previously an award-winning journalist, Elena is passionate about writing what she loves.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when any gamer hears about open world games, they immediately (safely) assume that the game would proceed to take hours upon hours to complete. However, that’s not always the case with open world games.

In fact, some of these games can be completed in less than 10 hours.

If you enjoy exploration-focused titles that are free of filler, we recommend the ten fastest open-world games to 100%.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for players who are wanting a one-and-done experience with an open world game, being able to beat it within the same day or two days maximum, these games scratch that itch. You’re able to hop in and complete the game practically quicker than you can download it, and it’s just the right amount of content to tide you over until the next game.

While others are diving into open world games to sink hundreds upon hundreds of hours into them, you can rest assured that these games won’t eat up your schedule.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the thing about outer wilds is that the world itself is the final boss, with players only having a limited amount of time in order to save the universe – but it’s not done on its own. The game’s DLC, Echoes of the Eye, is about 10 and half hours long, obviously shorter for faster players.

Berdasarkan laporan, the dlc doesn’t replace anything in the game, but it’s rather a separate and self-contained location, more than ready for players to dive in and unravel its secrets. This way, if players are wanting a taste of Outer Wilds without going through the whole game, they can easily do so.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is especially the case if you’ve already beaten the game/solved the mystery of the main story. Since there isn’t really any replayability, the DLC offers a whole new mystery altogether – in a way, it’s like you’re playing the game for the first time all over again, and it can be solved pretty quickly.

Thankfully, there are also even more DLCs if you want more mystery, but they aren’t anywhere near as condensed as Echoes of the Eye.

There’s something particularly special about Shadow of the Colossus: the game is labelled as an open world, but many players would walk away from it thinking that it’s a semi-open world due to just how empty the world itself is.

Diungkapkan bahwa of course, that’s typically a bad thing for open worlds, but the unique thing about shadow of the colossus is that it would not work without that emptiness. Combine this with a linear order for the bosses themselves (which are platforming puzzles as well), a vague yet compelling story and a genuinely cool premise, and you’ve got a game that’s as fun as it is challenging.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of my students refers to the game as “rated t for teen mario,” and i'm bound to agree, if that helps get the idea across. And just like Mario, the game can be beaten pretty quickly: about 7 hours, in fact.

With that in mind, if this is a game that interests you, be prepared to spend most of those 7 hours climbing rather than fighting; you’re going to love it regardless.

Right now, The Legend of Zelda once again has the gaming community in a complete buzz thanks to the fantastic reception to the Ocarina of Time Remake.

Berdasarkan laporan, the series is continuously revolutionary, constantly evolving and redefining the open world genre as we know it. However, many tend to forget that open world Zelda didn’t start with Breath of the Wild, it started with the very first entry in the entire franchise.

Berdasarkan laporan, the nice part about the game is that it’s not long at all (especially when compared to its sequels that will come over the next few decades) – averaging only at about 8 hours to beat the game. Players who want a traditional Zelda experience in a short amount of time can’t find any other game that would be a better fit.

And as the game comes up on its 40th anniversary, it’s all the more reason to dive into where it all began.

Sebagaimana diketahui, obviously, both red dead redemption games are massive, telling all kinds of stories jam-packed in a rich world of historical fiction, so it would take a while to beat either entry. However, the first game’s DLC, Undead Nightmare, is a fantastic stand-alone story that only takes about 6 and a half hours to complete.

Sebagaimana diketahui, undead nightmare takes everything you love about the classic red dead redemption, but with a twist: suddenly, everyone is trying to survive a zombie apocalypse that came about practically overnight. The world and everything you can do within it, naturally, is related to this instead of your standard robberies and bounties.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since the world is so condensed, the dlc goes by much quicker than most, but it’s an absolute blast from start to finish. In fact, it’s widely considered to be one of the greatest DLCs of all time, simply for how refreshingly unique and fun it is.

With that in mind, the fact that this game can be completed quicker than a standard work shift just makes it all the better.

Of all the Assassin's Creed games, the shortest mainline entry (non-DLC game) is easily Assassin's Creed: Rogue, clocking in at about 11 hours to be beaten (again, it’s much quicker than that for veteran AC fans and seasoned gamers as a whole).

Surprisingly, the game has one of the more unique stories that the series has seen, focusing on an Assassin named Shay Patrick Cormac literally going rogue, slaughtering the brotherhood he knows and siding with the Templars.

And the best part of the story is the fact that the modern-day segments are thankfully incredibly short – the segments that drag and feel like a chore in all the other titles in the franchise don’t bog down this game.

Berdasarkan laporan, overall, it’s the perfect bite-sized game for assassin’s creed content, regardless of if you’re a fan or even brand new to the series. It’s truly one of a kind, especially for a series like AC.

From the titans of Xenoblade to the lawns of Santa Destroy, these Wii open-world games prove curiosity always pays off if you’re willing to get lost.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you were given 10 hours to simply explore new york city and soak it all in, you wouldn’t even be an eighth of the way through your journey before you reach that time. The fact that Marvel's Spider-Man brought in NYC on a similar (still scaled down) scale cemented the game’s timeframe as you continue to whip around as The Friendly Neighborhood himself.

Berdasarkan laporan, yet, you don’t have anywhere near as many superhero duties in spider-man: miles morales, so obviously, it will take you a lot less time. It would take about 8 hours, in fact.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since you’re playing the game as miles morales (duh) while peter parker is still around and kicking, you’re basically a superhero in training. This training will have you busy constantly taking down bad guys and saving the day, serving as the sole Spider-Man in NYC for several hours until Peter comes back from vacation with MJ.

Or you could just swing around New York City doing whatever you want for that timeframe, you’d get the same amount of enjoyment.

Diungkapkan bahwa just because a game is a horror game doesn’t mean it can’t also be open world, and in dredge, our open world is a vast, dangerous ocean. Even then, it’s nowhere near as dangerous as it will be once your sanity drains due to the Lovecraftian terrors you’ll encounter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it sounds horrifying, but it’s actually the coziest fishing game you’d ever imagine. You fish, fill out your encyclopedia, discover aberrations with the marine life and upgrade your ship, but the real fun comes from the simplest mechanic: sorting the fish into your boat. Seriously, the inventory management is the most addictive part of the whole game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nice part is that it’s wrapped up quickly, too, taking only about 9 and a half hours to complete – but trust me, you’re going to willingly sink far more hours into the game (and your ship). And if that doesn’t sound like enough content in the game for how much I sing its praises, it also has two equally dense and fun DLCs.

When it comes to short, yet full open world games, you cannot get any better of an experience than with DREDGE.

The lovely thing about Eastshade isn’t just how stunning of a game it is, but also the fact that it can be beaten pretty quickly and pretty easily – just around 9 hours.

Berdasarkan laporan, the whole game is about finding the most beautiful spots in the game to paint them (using a photography mechanic), so those entire 9 hours are filled with genuine beauty. Of course, since it’s open world, there are side quests (artwork commissions) and other things to do, but you’re going to be far more caught up in how pretty the world is.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and for those who love subtle, environmental storytelling, this world is full of it. You can learn more while you’re out and about exploring in it, or from the various other characters that you can talk to.

It’s one of the few open world games that keeps you busy without actively stressing you out; since, after all, the point of the game is to relax you, you’re going to find yourself in a comfortable state of bliss while playing.

If you’ve ever wanted to feel like you’re driving a pod around Tatooine (like any Star Wars fan would), you would have a fantastic time with Sable.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game seems pretty surface-level and simple: just ride around on your sand-speeder and enjoy the game’s lovely art style, but once you start playing, you’ll see it’s a lot deeper than you’d expect. It’s supposed to be about the protagonist’s self-discovery on their home planet, but by the end of your adventure, you’re going to feel like you’ve gone on a self-discovery of your own.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the game can be completed in about 7 and a half hours, it’s actually better if you take your time with the exploration – that’s the game’s strongest component, after all. Why not take the time to enjoy a world as pretty and interesting as this one?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s not perfectly polished; it’s actually pretty janky of a game at times, but if anything, it makes you love the game and all the charm it has even more. At the same time, if some of the previously mentioned jank (charm) is a little too much, then rest assured that you can get through this game very, very quickly.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a short hike is just that: short. It’s not the kind of short where it’s on the shorter end of a long game, no, the game is only about an hour and a half long. If you try to complete every single element within it to 100% the game, you’re looking at about 4 hours, an incredibly tiny open world game.

Berdasarkan laporan, the premise of the game is simple: you’re hiking up a mountain. If you run into anyone or anything on the way there, you’re more than welcome to interact with them, but it’s optional if you’re wanting to just get to the top. Considering how short the game is, I’d recommend not skipping anything if you can help it, just to get the richest experience you can.

Berdasarkan laporan, don’t rush through this hike, either. The game is already short enough, and there is so much enjoyable content that you don’t want to miss out on while on the way to the top.

But as we’ve learned with games like these: it’s not about the destination, it’s about the journey, so don’t be afraid to go on that journey.

#1098. 10 Deltarune Moments That Feel Totally Different When You Replay Earlier Chapters

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Deltarune Moments That Feel Totally Different When You Replay Earlier Chapters

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/deltarune-moments-that-feel-totally-different-when-you-replay-earlier-chapters/

Diungkapkan bahwa michael manning (he/him) has been enamored with video games since he first played the sonic classic collection as a child. With decades of experience in gaming and a full tour as a Gaming Journalist, Michael is ready to step up to the plate. From AAA to the smallest passion projects, his motto is that every piece of ar.

Sebagaimana diketahui, deltarune is a game that thrives not only on its narrative, but also on the individual mysteries set up by every cliffhanger and loose thread. As in any good story, major revelations have not only affected fans’ expectations for the future, but also their understanding of earlier events.

Thanks to fantastic use of irony and follow-through, some of the smallest moments in Deltarune’s earlier chapters have been completely recontextualized, and we’ll be talking about the wildest here.

Berdasarkan laporan, as we wait for chapter 6, it’s important to lay out everything we know and everything that’s become clearer since the game’s initial demo release. They say hindsight is 20/20, so let’s see how it serves us going forward.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ralsei’s recitation of the prophecy is one of the first major setup moments in deltarune, both as a fairly cliché story setup and a direct threat for the party to fight back against later. Since chapter 4, the Prophecy’s legitimacy and exact wording have been under heavy scrutiny.

Diungkapkan bahwa knowing that ralsei knows everything destined to happen down to the minute details makes his narration and people-pleasing more unsettling than charming. Susie’s heavy relevance to the darkest parts of its story sets her romantic yearning for Noelle up as a major red flag, ripe for getting ripped down by the grimmer chapters to come.

Diungkapkan bahwa susie’s portion of the prophecy is vague enough that it might not even be about her, whether that’s through a misstep by ralsei or deliberate sabotage from an outside force. The Prophecy itself is far from set in stone, ironically, and subverting it is already becoming a major objective of the party.

This is a detailed and all purpose hub for Toby Fox's episodic Deltarune.

Diungkapkan bahwa throughout king’s fight at the tail end of the chapter, he spends most of his dialogue praising the roaring knight, assigning all his work and progress to their support. This was the very first mention we got of the Knight, and at the time most assumed they were some kind of fixture of the card kingdom.

We’ve gathered much more info on the Roaring Knight since, but King’s speech is the only case we have of them actually interacting with someone without hostility.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in every other appearance, they’ve been a snarling aggressor with cruel laughter as their only method of communication. Hearing that they not only aligned with King but inspired him does a lot for their threat, establishing them as more than just a beast.

Berdasarkan laporan, the weird route was already unsettling enough when it dropped during deltarune’s second chapter, adding a touch of that no mercy dread undertale was infamous for. Despite this, the route felt rather self-contained until chapter 4 gave players a chance to lock it in.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now that chapter 5 has arrived and given us a massive follow-through, playing through chapter 2’s weird route feels even worse. Knowing how far it goes and seeing exactly what goes on to shatter Noelle’s psyche make the metanarrative pain hit all the harder.

Sebagaimana diketahui, spamton’s shadow crystal fight is a massive tonal shift from the rest of the chapter on the main route, especially at the very end. The battle takes a lot of notes from Undertale’s Mettaton battles, with Spamton straight up taking on a form extremely similar to Mettaton NEO.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the actual text of the battle is all about spamton trying to transcend his limits, which all sounds very familiar to anyone who has seen chapter 5’s weird route dialogue. Combined with the constant discussion of Heaven and his angelic design, Spamton’s fight feels very different from what we originally thought.

Berdasarkan laporan, angels specifically are feeling more and more relevant the longer the game goes, both to symbolize the player and the larger figures controlling the prophecy. For a goofy salesman, Spamton feels far more relevant than ever expected.

As Deltarune's size and popularity only grows, many people wonder if they should play Undertale first, and they really should.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the shelter, the massive bunker at the southernmost tip of hometown’s map, has been mysterious since deltarune’s very first chapter, with each release slowly giving us more and more details about it. Over time, we’ve learned plenty. It is likely the site of whatever terrible accident happened to Dess; multiple members of the town are acting to keep it sealed, and most recently, Kris has access to it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, thanks to these facts, it is largely assumed to be some kind of central base for the knight and whoever is assisting it in the light world. This makes Kris’s access to it when they break our control all the more interesting. Kris is clearly willing to do something drastic, including working with those who directly oppose the party.

Berdasarkan laporan, after the most recent reveal of the strange flower seeds kris pocketed and likely took back to the bunker, it feels like we’re watching them teetering over a ledge with no way to help. If they’d even let us.

Berdasarkan laporan, tenna is a massive source of comedy in chapter 3, but he’s also the source of a very off-putting little tantrum towards the tail end of the chapter, right before his boss fight. In it, he laments not only the state of the Dreemurr family but specifically Kris, pointing out just how differently they’ve been acting over the course of the night.

Diungkapkan bahwa we know that the source of this difference is the player’s interference, but that dichotomy is a major stress point, both for kris and the player. Who knows what Kris really acts like and whether or not close friends like Susie, who met them after the swap, will actually care about them?.

On our end, we really don’t know what Kris is capable of or what they’re willing to do when the chips are down, and it adds a layer of dread to the entire scene.

From Cooking, to the Rhythm game, and even Susiezilla, this is How To S-Rank All Minigames in Deltarune Chapter 3.

After all the buildup and vague hints towards the Knight, their sudden reveal in chapter 3 was a massive surprise, and the small amount of characterization we’ve gotten for them has painted a picture of their true motives.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, most interestingly, the scene that plays when you beat the knight, where they seemingly knight kris, has been given extra weight by how clearly kris is standing in their corner. After fighting off the Flowers and pocketing the highly toxic seeds at the tail end of chapter 5, Kris is willing to go above and beyond, even considering harming themselves to align with the Knight’s goal.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is a horrifying setup for what chapters 6 and 7 could bring, especially with 5 being marketed as “one last happy adventure. ”.

Working your way through Noelle’s house at the start of chapter 4 was a great peek into her psyche after not getting much for her in chapter 3, while also allowing us to put together a bit more info on Dess Holiday herself.

Not only did we get plenty of extra scenes between Susie and Noelle, but we also got some more direct moments to see how exactly Kris acts without the Soul piloting them, making it clear that they can survive without it, at least for limited periods.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, most importantly, finally meeting hometown’s mayor, carol holiday, added a tension that immediately made her a candidate for the knight to many players. I won’t say I fully buy that theory, but she is officially on the table as an incredibly potent threat, alluding to both knowledge of and cooperation with Kris’s goal.

Berdasarkan laporan, chapter 4’s dark world was shockingly somber at times, setting a future tone while finalizing quite a few rules for how light world monsters and darkners can overlap. Namely, through Gerson’s inclusion, we learned that dead Darkners, at least monsters, can manifest in Dark Worlds if items with their dust are within a fountain’s range.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this opens the door for any missing or dead characters to potentially show up in the future, or for items connected deeply to certain characters to manifest either as them or similarly to them. I fully believe this is how we’ll get some extra context on Rudy after his “falling down” early in chapter 5, and that it will lead to massive drama going forward.

From the earliest launch of Deltarune, fans have assumed the strange voice that speaks to us during the character creator was Gaster, based on the speech pattern that it uses and the dialogue from the Deltarune Twitter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, following his extra dialogue in chapters 3 and 4, i grew extremely confident in that theory, and facts from both the normal and weird routes of chapter 5 have fully convinced me that we will meet the man who speaks in hands before deltarune is through. Given what happens to Onionsan via one of Gaster’s Goners and his clear significance in the “B-Side” cutscene in the Weird Route, he is by far our biggest mystery and one that fully recontextualizes every bit of dialogue we get from him.

Deltarune chapter 5 is, unsurprisingly, full of mysteries players are still trying to get their heads around.

Berdasarkan laporan, miniature designer and artist aly morrison has died, as confirmed by trish carden miniatures and design on facebook. Carden, Morrison's ex-wife and former partner in Marauder Miniatures, posted that, "Mharaid and I are heartbroken to announce the passing of Aly Morrison, a very much loved father, veteran wargames miniatures designer and friend to many around the tabletop and the world. Aly passed unexpectedly but peacefully this Wednesday, and will be sorely missed. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aly morrison began sculpting for citadel in 1983 as a freelancer before joining the studio full-time in 1986. He and Trish were then made stewards of Games Workshop's imprint Marauder Miniatures in 1988, where they had free reign to create quirky and characterful figures like the mohawked dwarf trollslayers and the giant with a whaler's beard and a booze barrel strapped to his waist that became archetypal parts of Warhammer.

Diungkapkan bahwa morrison also crafted the first miniatures for blood bowl players and drew the tokens to represent them in the board game's first edition. During his time at Games Workshop every faction from dark elves to space marines eventually benefited from his touch.

Berdasarkan laporan, he's also well-regarded as a painter, and his reliance on a dark wash with a hint of purple in it jokingly known as "aly's brown liquid" was legendary. He continued working on the recipe over the years, with a recent iteration described on his blog in 2020 if you want to whip some up yourself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, though marauder was eventually folded back into citadel, morrison continued at games workshop until his retirement earlier this year. Humble, magnanimous and with an incorrigible wit, to sit beside Aly and hear his wisdom and love of Warhammer miniatures design, was to be in the presence of a master. The company remembered him by saying, "Aly’s kindness and generosity as a mentor have left an indelible mark on the Warhammer Studio. No matter your level of experience, he always had something insightful to add, to help make the creation 'more Warhammer'. ".

#1101. 5 Funniest 'Peanuts' Comics About Dogs

📅 16 Nov 2026

5 Funniest 'Peanuts' Comics About Dogs

Tanggal: 16 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/5-funniest-peanuts-comics-about-dogs/

Starring Schroeder! (I kid, they’re all with Snoopy).

Diungkapkan bahwa broadly speaking, there are three types of peanuts comics. (And, let’s be honest, there are a good number of boring ones too. There are the funny ones, the sweet ones, and ones that are both funny and sweet. ) But, very generally speaking, those are the three types of good Peanuts comics: funny, sweet, and the ones that do both of those things.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i bring this up because my goal here is to find the five funniest peanuts comics about dogs. Not like, just Peanuts comics “starring Snoopy,” even though all of them do, but comic strips that are actually about dogs and the nature of dogs in general, if that makes sense. So that means no Flying Ace or Joe Cool stuff. I love those, but I wanted to define this one pretty narrowly about “dogs” (which, I guess, is still pretty broad).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i also wanted to just go for the funny ones. These aren’t the sweet “go hug your dog” Peanuts comics, or even the sweet/funny ones that check all the boxes for Snoopy fans. I was determined to just find funny, dog-themed Peanuts comics which illustrate Charles Schulz’s impressive abilities as a joke-writer.

Berdasarkan laporan, dogs do live a pretty enviable life. A lot of people wish life was that simple for them — I know I do. They have no jobs, people bring them food for free, and simple pleasures like stick-throwing are entirely fulfilling. Here, Snoopy addresses those feelings of jealousy many humans have towards dogs and basically says “Yeah, being a dog is pretty great. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from jan. 6, 1952, this is the first-ever Sunday strip of Peanuts. The comic had begun in 1950, running six days a week with its regular, four-panel daily strips, but its growing popularity brought it to Sundays.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in these early ones, snoopy didn't really have all of his more human-like personality traits that would become his signature. Instead, he was just a regular, adorable old dog, which is evidenced here when Snoopy does something that it’s hard to imagine him doing: biting Charlie Brown. It comes during a game of tag where a bunch of kids are running around, tagging each other. One of the kids tags Snoopy, then we see Charlie Brown shout “Ow!”.

Diungkapkan bahwa then we see charlie brown with the back of his shorts missing, with an angry expression as snoopy looks on innocently. Meanwhile, a kid named Patty — this is the original Patty, not Peppermint Patty — tells Charlie Brown, “Don’t get mad, Charlie Brown…. That’s just his way of tagging!”.

Berdasarkan laporan, what i love about this one is it seems like it could be about something deeper. All of a sudden, Snoopy snaps out of it and his life has meaning again. And then, after multiple panels that make Snoopy look like he’s going through a mid-dog-years crisis, Charlie Brown arrives with a full bowl of food. And because we all love Snoopy, it makes us all empathize with him and worry about him. Snoopy often acts like more of a human than a dog, and in this comic strip, he seems like he is a super-depressed human. Snoopy is experiencing some serious malaise, feeling like his life has no meaning at all. Snoopy may act like a man, but he’s all-dog.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i love how mad snoopy is in this one. He’s such a happy dog that we rarely see him in a bad mood, which is why this one is so funny and feels like he’s being a real dog here. Dogs hate to see their food bowls empty, and it’s hilarious to see Snoopy play that very dog-like emotion.

Sebagaimana diketahui, is this one too sweet? it is really funny, but i fear i’m breaking my own stupid rules here. I mean, it is about “dogs” and quite literally the “nature of dogs,” with Lucy talking about the reason for a distinctive dog behavior. Yet the sleepy Snoopy on top of Linus’ head is super cute. I just couldn’t resist this one. I guess it’s impossible to entirely separate the humor of Peanuts from its inherent sweetness.

Series creator Charlie Brooker is back, and he will write and executive produce the series alongside Bisha K. Diungkapkan bahwa “black mirror will return, and hopefully it’ll be more black mirror than ever,” brooker said in an interview with netflix’s tudum when the series was renewed this january. “I can confirm that Black Mirror will return, just in time for reality to catch up with it. Sebagaimana diketahui, black mirror is an anthology sci-fi series that began in 2011 on the british network channel 4 before moving to netflix. The series currently spans 33 episodes and a special across seven seasons. The show largely focuses on near-future dystopian scenarios, tapping into contemporary anxieties about our relationship with technology; "black mirror" refers to phone and computer screens. There’s also the experimental interactive film Black Mirror: Bandersnatch (which was admittedly more interesting in theory than practice).

Berdasarkan laporan, over the years, the show has divided critics, with some praising its trenchant observations on modern society while others find its messaging ham-fisted and numbingly cynical. Diungkapkan bahwa black mirror has won multiple times at the emmys, and “san junipero,” “uss callister,” and (somehow) black mirror: bandersnatch took home the outstanding television movie award for consecutive years from 2017 to 2019. Since then, some argue the series has declined with its fifth and sixth seasons. Considering that the phrase “It’s like we’re living in a Black Mirror episode” has become increasingly common, it will be interesting to see if the series can stay ahead of the times.

#1105. XBOX Celebrates 25 Years With New Update Resurrecting Classic Boot-Up Sequence

📅 16 Nov 2026

XBOX Celebrates 25 Years With New Update Resurrecting Classic Boot-Up Sequence

Tanggal: 16 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/xbox-celebrates-25-years-new-update-resurrecting-classic-boot-up-sequence/

Greg has more than than 10 years of experience in video game journalism, covering some of the biggest games on the 8th and 9th generations of console.

Big anniversaries often come with a healthy dose of nostalgia, and XBOX is certainly not letting fans down with their latest announcement, which is sure to stir a wistful longing for simpler times in gaming.

Most players remember their first consoles, or the excitement of tearing open a new one on birthdays or Christmases–the enduring excitement of plugging it in for the first time and hearing the techy tones of the numerous iconic boot-up sequences.

PlayStation nostalgiacore content often goes viral, harping on about the ethereal start-up sounds of the PlayStation 2, while many fans rave about the perfection of the Gamecube’s legendary unfolding animation.

However, Microsoft is reminding gamers that they had a few iconic boot-up animations too, with a new update bringing them back to modern consoles and giving fans the feels.

Sebagaimana diketahui, microsoft just announced on x that it is resurrecting its classic boot-up sequences from xbox eras gone by in a new update, set to celebrate 25 years of gaming on the platform. Returning are all original sequences from XBOX’s first days as a console juggernaut, with the dramatic green X from 2001 making its comeback, as well as the iconic XBOX 360 intro.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fans will remember these fondly from the days when halo was the biggest game in the world, or when they first dived into call of duty zombies for the first time. For younger fans, the XBOX One sequence will also be available, allowing them to relive their first XBOX era.

Could we soon be playing OG Xbox and 360 titles on Game Pass with quality of life updates?.

Microsoft is also rolling out two additional XBOX 360 boot-up animations as part of the update, allowing players to customize their start-up experience to whichever design suits them best.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the update is rolling out imminently to all xbox series x/s owners as a thanks for their support. Players can change their desired boot-up sequences in their console settings, with quite a variety to now choose from.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while microsoft may be trying to remind fans of brighter days when it was winning the console wars, xbox ceo asha sharma hasn’t had an easy ride thus far after taking the helm earlier this year. As a complete newcomer to the games industry, Sharma has worked hard to immerse herself in the complex culture of video games in a somewhat trial by fire experience.

She certainly entered the role with high hopes for XBOX, notably saying she hoped the platform could “reach 1 billion people” daily, which raised a few eyebrows in the industry.

Microsoft is reminding gamers that they had a few iconic boot-up animations too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the company has been working hard (and secretively) on its xbox series x/s successor, titled project helix, which they hope will further bridge the gap between console and pc—something which microsoft has been striving to achieve for years now. Layoffs have plagued the company and its studios, however, with thousands of roles being cut under its vast umbrella, leading to resentment from fans and industry professionals.

However, some have rallied behind the company due to its recent partnerships with studios like Kojima Productions, best known for its auteur leader and brain behind Metal Gear Solid, Hideo Kojima.

Diungkapkan bahwa xbox recently announced a years-long collaboration with kojima and will see exclusive titles come to the platform, including the horror title od and the proposed gaming-tv crossed physint. The partnership comes after Kojima’s deal with XBOX rival, PlayStation, fell apart due to funding constraints.

Xbox still plans on releasing one more console generation soon with the upcoming Project Helix.

#1106. 6 Upcoming Sci-Fi Movies, Ranked by Hype

📅 16 Nov 2026

6 Upcoming Sci-Fi Movies, Ranked by Hype

Tanggal: 16 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/upcoming-sci-fi-movies-ranked-by-hype/

The next wave of sci-fi TV is looking out of this world.

Diungkapkan bahwa science fiction has always been one of the most exhilarating genres to experience on the big screen, and today we’re entering another massive era for theatrical spectacle. Studios like Warner Bros. , Disney, and Legendary have given filmmakers, VFX artists, and visionary directors the canvas to explore everything from humanity's distant future to planets in galaxies far, far away. Fortunately, the next few years of sci-fi cinema look just as — if not more — promising.

Berdasarkan laporan, as studios double down on high-stakes bets, pouring absurd budgets into sprawling worlds and complex narratives like dune: part three and avengers: doomsday, speculative fiction remains hollywood’s ultimate proving ground for event-sized storytelling. To see what’s most exciting on the near horizon, here are the biggest upcoming sci-fi movies ranked by hype.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s always a gamble betting on a mid-budget sci-fi concept in a release calendar dominated by legacy ip, even with keanu reeves at the center of it. Directed by Deadpool’s Tim Miller, Shiver has been pitched as Edge of Tomorrow meets The Shallows. Reeves plays an as-yet unnamed smuggler who gets trapped in a deadly time loop in the middle of the shark-infested Caribbean Sea after a job goes sideways.

Berdasarkan laporan, even in the age of original sci-fi spectacles like everything everywhere all at once and severance, the lack of any built-in franchise awareness or even a massive marketing blitz behind it makes shiver sit outside almost everyone’s hype level at the moment, especially in the face of such massive juggernauts on the horizon. Still, watching Miller pair R-rated action choreography with a high-concept time-loop premise in the same vein as Looper, all while letting Reeves carry the story, makes Shiver one of the more fascinating wildcards on the slate, especially if you’re a John Wick fan.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at this point, legendary's monsterverse has settled comfortably into its wild identity, built primarily on ridiculous kaiju matchups. Director Grant Sputore, who takes over for Adam Wingard this go-around, is gearing up to steer the franchise into cosmic territory. Following the events of Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire, the next installment looks ready to take things past the stratosphere, both literally and figuratively. Even with the limited amount of story details, it’s clear SpaceGodzilla will emerge as the franchise's next big bad, which would mark a significant escalation for the sixth film in the series.

Diungkapkan bahwa the monsterverse isn’t exactly the most cerebral science fiction franchise around, and nowhere close as jaw-dropping as minus zero, but it has become one of hollywood's most dependable sources of blockbuster entertainment. You can’t deny there’s something undeniably exciting about seeing kaiju go toe-to-toe, wreaking havoc across some of the world’s most beautiful cities. The idea of a threat from the stars crashing into the MonsterVerse makes Godzilla x Kong: Supernova particularly intriguing, though not quite Star Wars-level intriguing.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s not an overstatement to say star wars is in rough shape right now. Following the poor reception of The Mandalorian and Grogu, the franchise is in dire need of structural reinvention before one of cinema’s most beloved sci-fi properties falls into full-blown creative obsolescence. At least Star Wars: Starfighter looks like a promising breath of fresh air, bypassing the Skywalker Saga to jump five years past The Rise of Skywalker.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, set to hit theaters on the 50th anniversary weekend of the original 1977 film, shawn levy’s standalone entry stars ryan gosling as a cynical rogue pilot alongside mia goth, amy adams, and matt smith. The story sees Gosling's character taking a young Jedi child under his wing, giving the film a chance to explore a more personal mentor-student dynamic set against a galactic adventure. In the wake of countless Disney Plus spin-offs that never quite stuck the landing, Levy has his work cut out for him, especially with the film carrying the weight of the much-maligned sequel trilogy with it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after spending nearly three decades stuck in development hell, the incredibles director is finally bringing his long-gestating passion project to the silver screen. Set in an alternate retro-futuristic megacity as imagined from 1939, the animated sci-fi noir follows Raymond Gunn (Sam Rockwell), the last human private investigator as he is pulled into a murder conspiracy involving extraterrestrial visitors and multimedia superstar Venus Nova (Scarlett Johansson).

Sebagaimana diketahui, director brad bird has tapped a laundry list of additional stars to back the voice ensemble, from alan tudyk to michelle rodriguez, and it looks like the exact kind of stylized swing mainstream animation rarely takes anymore. It already reminds me of Satoshi Kon’s unfinished final project, Dreaming Machine, which was also set in a retro-futuristic society like Ray Gunn’s Metropia. Watching Bird blend hard-boiled detective fiction with mid-century pulp sci-fi is an exciting prospect, and you won’t have to wait long to see it. Ray Gunn releases in theaters on December 4 ahead of its debut on Netflix later that same month.

Diungkapkan bahwa denis villeneuve has already pulled off what filmmakers thought was impossible by turning frank herbert’s dense prose into twin modern sci-fi classics. Dune: Part Three is poised to ring in even more hype and acclaim as it pulls in new players and villains into the overarching conflict. Adapting Dune Messiah, the third installment picks up with Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) sitting on the Golden Lion Throne, forced to reckon with the fanatical fallout of his holy war across the imperium.

Sebagaimana diketahui, jason momoa returns as the ghola hayt, a resurrected clone of fallen atreides swordmaster duncan idaho, and is joined by robert pattinson as the shape-shifting conspirator scytale. Villeneuve's closing chapter on Dune is undoubtedly one of the most ambitious and exciting sci-fi events of the year, but it lands on the same day as Marvel’s Avengers suit up to take on one of their toughest foes yet.

Diungkapkan bahwa opening on the same "dunesday" weekend, the russo brothers’ return to marvel isn’t pure hard sci-fi in the traditional sense, yet its multiversal stakes make it the loudest pop-culture collision on the calendar. Built around reality-bending incursions and a crossover that pulls the Avengers, The Fantastic Four, and the Fox-era X-Men into one universe-shattering event, Avengers: Doomsday is easily one of the most anticipated comic book blockbusters in years. Bringing Robert Downey Jr. back into the fold as Victor Von Doom is a swerve unlike any other, but one that will prove the most exciting to witness as he collides with Marvel’s pantheon of heroes on-screen later this year.

Diungkapkan bahwa the multiversal saga has had more than its fair share of missteps, leaving plenty of skeptics wondering if marvel can actually recapture its infinity war and endgame momentum. Love it or hate it, nothing else on the release schedule commands a bigger mainstream footprint than watching Marvel’s architects try to pull off the biggest crossover event Hollywood has seen yet. And, in the wake of that surprise VisionQuest post-credit scene, the hype is at a fever pitch.

Escape From Tarkov Reveals Top Down Spin-Off

Tanggal: 16 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/escape-from-tarkov-reveals-top-down-spin-off/

Diungkapkan bahwa escape from tarkov is celebrating its first anniversary since leaving what once felt like eternal early access last november. Now that the hard part of the journey is over, Battlestate Games and director Nikita Buyanov are looking at the future, and that means new games.

As reported by Grant Taylor-Hill of Insider Gaming, the next chapter for the Escape From Tarkov developer is still going to be an extraction shooter, but it will be a lot different from the game that started it all.

Nikita Buyanov told Insider Gaming that part of the future for the Escape From Tarkov creator lies on mobile.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to buyanov, this game will “look and feel like tarkov. ” Details are scarce for the time being, but it has now been confirmed that the next game will be a mobile-based, top-down extraction shooter set in the world of Escape From Tarkov.

Ubisoft reportedly has a new Rainbow Six: Vegas game in the works, with a third entry considered more likely than a remake.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although it may sound strange to someone who’s only familiar with ‘classic’ tarkov, the concept has been thoroughly validated through team soda’s escape from duckov. The game, endorsed by Battlestate Games, is an avian-themed parody of Escape From Tarkov, with an engaging gameplay loop and endearing art style.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to buyanov, this game will “look and feel like tarkov. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, games like hotline miami, the original helldivers, and the intravenous series have shown you can deliver plenty of grittiness and tense action with a top-down perspective. The medium’s possibilities are endless, so it is up to Battlestate Games to work out how to capture the magic of Escape From Tarkov and bring it to mobile.

A release date for the Escape From Tarkov mobile spin-off has not been announced yet, but you can probably expect it before the elusive hideout management app for the core game.

Battlestate Games is also currently working on a single-player title, which some players have assumed to be a substitute for the Russia 2028 project that’s currently on hold.

Shortly after delivering Escape From Tarkov to the world in its final form, Nikita Buyanov announced his next project, Fragmentary Order.

According to the Russian auteur, Fragmentary Order is “almost there,” and marketing materials shared by the game’s official page certainly seem to reflect that.

The game takes Escape From Tarkov’s hardcore shooter mechanics into the one place that hasn’t been corrupted by capitalism, and expands the kind of corporate-infused chaos from Tarkov into the entire solar system.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pre-orders are already open for fragmentary order, divided between candidates ($44. 99) and Founders tiers ($79. 99). Both versions grant access to closed alpha testing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, besides buyanov, other escape from tarkov alumni are also making a name for themselves in new projects. Tarkov veterans Dmitry Ogorodnikov, Jean Tyulegenov, and German Terekhov have moved on to found Nomion Games and are currently working on a cyberpunk shooter titled Rush is Real.

The art direction has been handed over to Croatian 3D artist Space Meerkat, who is famous for his elaborate cyberpunk concepts.

Rush is Real does not have a release window yet, but you can follow development updates here.

With no particular preamble, Asha Sharma revealed that MachineGames has begun work on the next mainline Wolfenstein title.

Explore the top 10 bosses in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, ranked by challenge, design, and excitement.

From fire-breathing dragons to giant spiders to wicked witches, Ocarina of Time features a diverse lineup of boss battles that adds to every dungeon's unique charm, making this one of the best games in The Legend of Zelda series.

Sebagaimana diketahui, many of the bosses force players to use the items obtained in their respective dungeons in ocarina of time. But overall, many of them feature such clever designs and battles that have made exploring the dungeons worthwhile. In fact, the bosses are so great that Nintendo has allowed players to fight them again in the remake’s Hall of Fallen Foes.

Berdasarkan laporan, no boss in this game is the same, and some are far better than others. While Zelda fans may be familiar with them from the original game, some of the bosses have been given some enhancements in the remake. So now, here are all the bosses in Ocarina of Time ranked from worst to best.

Berdasarkan laporan, nintendo made the water temple in ocarina of time much easier and enjoyable for gamers in the remake, but the aquatic boss fight still feels dry. There’s nothing visually noteworthy about Morpha, as it’s essentially a giant blob of water with an amoeba inside it. The player simply has to use the Longshot to pull out Morpha’s core and strike it repeatedly. Though the remake gives Morpha some more dynamic attacks, many can agree that Dark Link was a much more interesting battle in the Water Temple.

Diungkapkan bahwa this giant, fire-breathing dinosaur takes over the cavern in which gorons harvest their rock roast, forcing link to go in and take it out. Though it is a fearsome presence, King Dodongo loses points for being just a bigger version of the regular Dodongo. At the same time, the boss battle is very straightforward, as Link must repeatedly throw bombs into the beast's mouth before hitting its weak spot. At least it features its own theme song rather than the traditional boss music.

Sebagaimana diketahui, lord jabu-jabu has some truly weird things in his stomach, from a giant octopus to electric jellyfish to fleshy elevators. But what really takes the cake is the dungeon's boss, Barinade: a giant, tentacled blob that shoots lightning bolts. To defeat it, Link must use the boomerang to sever its tentacles and strike its core, all while avoiding its giant jellyfish and electric blasts.

Diungkapkan bahwa barinade is one of the wildest battles in ocarina of time and the remake improves the experience by putting it in a dark, neon-lit chamber. It also adds another bit of protection for the boss' weak point, making the fight a more challenging test of the player's skill, timing, and patience.

Berdasarkan laporan, deep inside the deku tree, link encounters his first boss in the form of gohma. The buildup to this fight is straight out of a horror movie, with Link noticing dirt falling from above before seeing a giant, one-eyed spider crawling above him. Given that it's the first boss fight of the game, it doesn't offer a huge challenge. The fight itself is pretty simple, as Link must use the Fairy Slingshot to shoot the monster's exposed eye. Nevertheless, it serves as a strong preview to the other horrors Link must face throughout Hyrule.

Berdasarkan laporan, this ancient lava dragon was revived by ganondorf to eat the gorons of death mountain. Link faces Volvagia in the heart of the Fire Temple, and their battle is nothing short of glorious. With the Megaton Hammer, Link must break open the dragon's skull as it pops out from the lava pits, turning this boss fight into a fiery game of Whac-A-Mole.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, volvagia poses an especially challenging fight, spewing fire at link and sending boulders crashing down from the ceiling. At the same time, the game doesn't make this a linear battle, as the player can also use the Fairy Bow to shoot the dragon's exposed skull. Ultimately, this boss fight cranks up the heat with a thrilling environment and concept that allows players to get creative.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite its silly name, bongo bongo is no laughing matter. This phantom shadow beast scorched Kakariko Village after escaping its prison at the Bottom of the Well. After Link chases it into the Shadow Temple, the Hero faces him on top of a giant drum in the middle of a toxic lake.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this boss fight builds an eerie atmosphere with bongo bongo’s monstrous moaning and spooky lair. It also forces the player to use their resources wisely in order to come out on top. They must evade and shoot the demon's giant hands, wear the Hover Boots to move steadily across the beating drum, and use the Lenses of Truth to see and strike its head.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the first boss as adult link, the hero of time faces phantom ganon, an evil spirit that resembles the demon king. The boss of the Forest Temple cleverly hides inside multiple paintings in its chamber, forcing Link to shoot the right Phantom Ganon with the Fairy Bow.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but after a few hits, the boss changes tactics, challenging link to a game of dead man’s volley, in which he must use his sword to knock an energy ball back at him. It’s a thrilling and inventive boss battle that culminates in a haunting cutscene where the real Ganondorf threatens Link, building up hype for the game’s final boss.

Diungkapkan bahwa the surrogate mothers of ganondorf, komue and kotake, known collectively as twinrova, take control of the spirit temple after young link retrieves the silver gauntlets. Seven years later, after making Link fight one more Iron Knuckle, the two witches grow in size and battle him using their powers over fire and ice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the age of ganon is over. It's Twinrova's turn to rule.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the boss fight features an incredibly cool concept, in which link deflects magic lasers back at twinrova using the mirror shield. Also, unlike most of the game’s bosses, Twinrova actually transforms, with both witches fusing into one giant, superpowered sorceress. It feels especially rewarding taking down Twinrova after seeing them brainwash Nabooru for seven years. The remake also adds another intrguing layer to this fight by having the witches spare Young Link beforehand, thinking he wouldn’t be worth killing, making their defeat a result of their own arrogance.

Diungkapkan bahwa after lowering the barrier around ganondorf’s tower and battling several monsters, link comes face-to-face with the demon king himself at the top of his castle. However, Ganondorf's magic prevents Navi from reading his weakness, forcing the player to figure it out for themselves. Ultimately, this fight makes the player use what they learned fighting Phantom Ganon and deflect Ganondorf’s magic back at him, all before shooting him with Light Arrows.

Berdasarkan laporan, after everything ganondorf made link and his friends endure throughout the story, the game pays off this build up by letting the player give the villain an incredible beatdown. The remake heightens the challenge by having Ganondorf remove more portions of the floor during the fight. It seems as though Nintendo knew many veteran Zelda players would be playing this game and wanted to make things more exciting for them. And boy, did it work.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ocarina of time saved the best for last. After Link and Zelda escape Ganondorf’s Castle before its collapse, the duo see the Demon King has survived the wreckage. Then, in a blind rage, the villain transforms into his final form, a giant, hulking pig demon with two massive swords.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the final boss is perfect based on atmosphere alone. The game fills the player with incredible dread and excitement as Link fights Ganon in the ruins of his castle, all while a dark storm hangs over them. The player can feel the weight of Hyrule on their shoulders as it seems like they're fighting at the end of the world.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the remake makes some clever deviations from the original game by giving ganon new weak points and new attacks during the second phase. It also features more gripping cinematics that give Zelda a more active role during the battle. Overall, the remake's final boss delivers a much more epic climax to Link and Zelda's war with Ganon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.
